这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出利用稀疏自编码器来改进 CLIP 模型的微调过程，使其在保持稳健性的同时变得更加可解释。

Abstract

Large-scale pre-trained vision-language models like CLIP demonstrate remarkable zero-shot performance across diverse tasks. However, fine-tuning these models to improve downstream performance often degrades robustness against distribution shifts. Recent approaches have attempted to mitigate this trade-off, but often rely on computationally expensive text-guidance. We propose a novel method for robust fine-tuning, SAE-FT, which operates only on the model's visual representations. SAE-FT regularizes changes to these representations by penalizing the addition and removal of semantically meaningful features identified by a Sparse Autoencoder trained on the pre-trained model. This constraint prevents catastrophic forgetting and makes the fine-tuning process interpretable, enabling direct analysis of semantic changes. SAE-FT is both mechanistically transparent and computationally efficient, matching or exceeding state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet and its associated distribution shift benchmarks. Code is publicly available at: this https URL .

item.title: PersonaFingerprint: Measuring Persona Inference on Modern Websites with LLM-Driven Browsing
item.author: Chuxu Song, Hao Wang, Richard Martin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文识别并量化了现代网络设置中一种新的隐私风险：攻击者仅通过数据包长度和到达时间序列即可推断用户的个人身份。研究构建了基于大语言模型的多智能体浏览框架，在受控个人身份约束下与真实网站交互并收集加密流量数据。研究在封闭集和开放世界设定下形式化了个人身份指纹识别，并评估了现有模型是否已包含个人身份信息。实验显示，在混合网站流量中，个人身份推断准确率约为84%，且通过轻量级多任务目标可以提升至约80%，同时保持约93%的网站分类性能。

背景: 传统的网站指纹识别主要关注从加密流量元数据推断用户访问了哪个网站。

目的: 识别并量化现代网络设置中一种新的隐私风险：攻击者仅通过数据包长度和到达时间序列即可推断用户的个人身份。

方法: 构建了一个基于大语言模型的多智能体浏览框架，该框架在计算机使用代理与真实网站交互并收集加密流量痕迹时，强制执行可控的个人身份约束。

主要发现: 在10个现代网站和15个个人身份（加上开放世界类别）上，个人身份推断在混合网站流量中达到约84%的准确率；此外，一个轻量级的多任务目标可以将个人身份准确率提升至约80%，同时保持约93%的基线网站分类性能。

结论: 在现代网站上，加密流量元数据不仅会泄露用户访问了哪个网站，还会泄露他们如何浏览以及是谁在浏览。

翻译: 本文识别并量化了现代网络设置中一种新的隐私风险：攻击者仅通过数据包长度和到达时间序列即可推断用户的个人身份。研究构建了基于大语言模型的多智能体浏览框架，在受控个人身份约束下与真实网站交互并收集加密流量数据。研究在封闭集和开放世界设定下形式化了个人身份指纹识别，并评估了现有模型是否已包含个人身份信息。实验显示，在混合网站流量中，个人身份推断准确率约为84%，且通过轻量级多任务目标可以提升至约80%，同时保持约93%的网站分类性能。

Abstract

Website Fingerprinting (WFP) has traditionally focused on inferring which website a user visits from encrypted traffic metadata such as packet sizes and timing. In this paper, we identify and quantify a new privacy risk in modern web settings: an adversary can infer a user's persona using only packet-length and inter-arrival-time sequences. To study this risk at scale, we build an LLM-driven multi-agent browsing framework that enforces controllable persona constraints while a computer-use agent interacts with real websites and collects corresponding encrypted traffic traces. We formalize persona fingerprinting under both closed-set and open-world settings and further evaluate whether persona information is already embedded in representations learned by existing WFP models and can be amplified at low cost. Across 10 modern websites and 15 personas (plus an open-world class), persona inference achieves about 84% accuracy on mixed-site traffic; moreover, a lightweight multi-task objective can boost persona accuracy to around 80% while retaining strong site classification performance (about 93% baseline). Our results show that, on modern websites, encrypted traffic metadata can leak not only which site a user visits, but also how they browse and who is browsing.

item.title: PAGER: Bridging the Semantic-Execution Gap in Point-Precise Geometric GUI Control
item.author: Wei, Jingxuan, Bai, Xi, Liu, Shan, Jia, Caijun, Sun, Zheng, Xu, Xinglong, Li, Siyuan, Sun, Linzhuang, Yu, Bihui, He, Conghui, Tan, Cheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了PAGE Bench基准和PAGER代理，以解决GUI任务中的精确几何构建问题，通过拓扑感知的规划和像素级执行，显著提高了任务成功率。

背景: 大型视觉语言模型在GUI代理中取得了进展，但依赖于宽容的区域容忍范式。精确几何构建打破了这一假设，因为局部坐标误差可能引发级联拓扑故障。

目的: 识别精确敏感的GUI任务，需要点级精度、几何感知验证和鲁棒性。提出PAGE Bench和PAGER方法来基准测试和解决这一问题。

方法: PAGER代理将构建分解为依赖结构规划和像素级执行。通过像素接地监督调优建立可执行动作语法，并通过精度对齐强化学习缓解曝光偏差。

主要发现: 存在显著的语义执行差距：通用多模模型动作类型准确率超过88%，但任务成功率低于6%。PAGER将任务成功率提高了4.1倍，步骤成功率从低于9%提高到超过62%。

结论: PAGER在点精确GUI控制方面建立了新的最先进水平。

翻译: 大型视觉语言模型显著推进了GUI代理的发展，使其能够在网络、移动和桌面界面上执行交互。然而，这些进展很大程度上依赖于宽容的区域容忍范式，其中同一组件内的许多邻近像素仍然有效。精确的几何构建打破了这一假设：动作必须落在连续画布空间中的点，而不是宽容的区域。由于几何原语携带本体论依赖关系，局部坐标误差可能引发级联拓扑故障，从而扭曲下游对象并使最终构建无效。我们将此范式识别为精确敏感的GUI任务，需要点级精度、几何感知验证以及对依赖驱动误差传播的鲁棒性。为了对此进行基准测试，我们介绍了PAGE Bench，包含4,906个问题和超过224K个过程监督、像素级GUI动作。我们进一步提出了PAGER，一个拓扑感知代理，它将构建分解为依赖结构规划和像素级执行。像素接地监督调优建立了可执行动作语法，而精度对齐强化学习通过状态条件几何反馈缓解了展开引起的曝光偏差。实验揭示了显著的语义执行差距：通用多模模型可以超过88%的动作类型准确率，但任务成功率仍低于6%。PAGER缩小了这一差距，比最强的评估通用基线任务成功率高出4.1倍，并将步骤成功率从GUI专用代理的低于9%提高到超过62%，为点精确GUI控制建立了新的最先进水平。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决在点精确几何 GUI 控制中弥合语义与执行之间的鸿沟。这个问题很重要，因为现实中许多 GUI 操作需要精确的坐标点击，而目前的系统很难准确理解指令并执行。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 提供的文本仅包含论文的元数据信息，未包含正文内容，因此无法得知作者的设计思路及是否借鉴了现有工作。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了 PAGER，旨在弥合点精确几何 GUI 控制中的语义-执行鸿沟。

Abstract

Large vision-language models have significantly advanced GUI agents, enabling executable interaction across web, mobile, and desktop interfaces. Yet these gains largely rely on a forgiving region-tolerant paradigm, where many nearby pixels inside the same component remain valid. Precise geometric construction breaks this assumption: actions must land on points in continuous canvas space rather than tolerant regions. Because geometric primitives carry ontological dependencies, a local coordinate error can induce cascading topological failures that distort downstream objects and invalidate the final construction. We identify this regime as precision-sensitive GUI tasks, requiring point-level accuracy, geometry-aware verification, and robustness to dependency-driven error propagation. To benchmark it, we introduce PAGE Bench, with 4,906 problems and over 224K process-supervised, pixel-level GUI actions. We further propose PAGER, a topology-aware agent that decomposes construction into dependency-structured planning and pixel-level execution. Pixel-grounded supervised tuning establishes executable action grammar, while precision-aligned reinforcement learning mitigates rollout-induced exposure bias through state-conditioned geometric feedback. Experiments reveal a pronounced Semantic-Execution Gap: general multimodal models can exceed 88% action type accuracy yet remain below 6% task success. PAGER closes this gap, delivering 4.1x higher task success than the strongest evaluated general baseline and raising step success rate from below 9% for GUI-specialized agents to over 62%, establishing a new state of the art for point-precise GUI control.

item.title: Flash-GRPO: Efficient Alignment for Video Diffusion via One-Step Policy Optimization
item.author: He, Xiaoxuan, Fu, Siming, Xue, Zeyue, Wang, Weijie, He, Ruizhe, Li, Yuming, Yin, Dacheng, Dong, Shuai, Huang, Haoyang, Wang, Hongfa, Duan, Nan, Zhuang, Bohan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Flash-GRPO是一种单步训练框架，在低计算预算下优于全轨迹训练，显著提高训练效率。

背景: Group Relative Policy Optimization对于对齐视频扩散模型与人类偏好至关重要，但训练14B参数模型通常需要数百个GPU天，现有方法通过滑动窗口子采样训练步数降低成本，但会从根本上损害优化，表现出严重的不稳定性且无法达到全轨迹性能。

目的: 提出Flash-GRPO，一种单步训练框架，旨在在低计算预算下实现比全轨迹训练更好的对齐质量，同时显著提高训练效率。

方法: Flash-GRPO解决了两个关键挑战：1. 等时分组通过强制提示词间的时间一致性来消除时间步混淆的方差，将策略性能与时间步难度解耦；2. 时间梯度修正中和了导致不同时间步间梯度幅度差异巨大的时间相关缩放因子。

主要发现: 在1.3B到14B参数模型的实验中验证了Flash-GRPO的有效性，展示了在保持一致稳定性的同时大幅训练加速，并实现了最先进的对齐质量。

结论: Flash-GRPO在低计算预算下实现了比全轨迹训练更好的对齐质量，并显著提高了训练效率。

翻译: Group Relative Policy Optimization对于对齐视频扩散模型与人类偏好至关重要，但训练14B参数模型通常需要数百个GPU天。现有方法通过滑动窗口子采样训练步数降低成本，但会从根本上损害优化，表现出严重的不稳定性且无法达到全轨迹性能。我们提出了Flash-GRPO，一种单步训练框架，在低计算预算下优于全轨迹训练的对齐质量，同时显著提高训练效率。Flash-GRPO解决了两个关键挑战：等时分组通过强制提示词间的时间一致性来消除时间步混淆的方差，将策略性能与时间步难度解耦；时间梯度修正中和了导致不同时间步间梯度幅度差异巨大的时间相关缩放因子。在1.3B到14B参数模型的实验中验证了Flash-GRPO的有效性，展示了在保持一致稳定性的同时大幅训练加速，并实现了最先进的对齐质量。

Abstract

Group Relative Policy Optimization has emerged as essential for aligning video diffusion models with human preferences, but faces a critical computational bottleneck: training a 14B parametered model typically demands hundreds of GPU days per experiment. Existing efficiency methods reduce costs through sliding window subsampling training timesteps, but fundamentally compromise optimization, exhibiting severe instability and failing to reach full trajectory performance. We present Flash-GRPO, a single-step training framework that outperforms full trajectory training in alignment quality under low computational budgets while substantially improving training efficiency. Flash-GRPO addresses two critical challenges: iso-temporal grouping eliminates timestep-confounded variance by enforcing prompt-wise temporal consistency, decoupling policy performance from timestep difficulty; temporal gradient rectification neutralizes the time-dependent scaling factor that causes vastly inconsistent gradient magnitudes across timesteps. Experiments on 1.3B to 14B parameter models validate Flash-GRPO's effectiveness, demonstrating substantial training acceleration with consistent stability and state-of-the-art alignment quality.

item.title: Constrained latent state modeling: A unifying perspective on representation learning under competing constraints
item.author: Gwenolé Quellec
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出约束潜在状态建模（CLSM）作为统一视角，旨在解决当前潜在表示学习中的碎片化问题。

背景: 现代机器学习中的潜在表示学习面临挑战，现有方法依赖于不同的假设，且通常从约束不足的目标中学习，导致表示的歧义和结构不明确。

目的: 提出约束潜在状态建模（CLSM）作为统一视角，明确潜在状态应满足的核心属性，并分析这些属性之间的内在权衡。

方法: 识别核心属性包括预测充分性、最小性、时间一致性、观测兼容性、对干扰因子的不变性和结构约束，并展示这些属性通过基本权衡相互耦合。

主要发现: 现有建模方法可以解释为 enforcing 不同约束子集，从而占据共同设计空间的不同区域；缺乏可识别性等挑战是约束不足 formulations 的结果。

结论: CLSM 提供了一个原则性框架，使设计选择明确化，分析权衡，并指导开发更具可解释性、鲁棒性和任务对齐的潜在状态模型。

翻译: 从复杂数据中学习潜在表示是现代机器学习的核心，涵盖时间、多模态和部分观测系统。在这些设置中，表示被更好地理解为捕捉潜在系统动态的潜在状态，而不仅仅是观察的压缩摘要。然而，当前的方法仍然碎片化，依赖于对这些状态应该代表什么的不同——且通常隐含的——假设。我们认为这种碎片化反映了更根本的限制：潜在表示通常从约束不足的目标中学习，这些目标未能指定有意义潜在状态应满足的属性。因此，多个表示可以满足相同的目标，导致其结构和解释的歧义。虽然许多潜在原则已被单独探索，但它们的相互作用尚未被明确形式化。在这项工作中，我们提出了约束潜在状态建模（CLSM）作为统一视角。我们识别了一组核心属性——预测充分性、最小性、时间一致性、观测兼容性、对干扰因子的不变性和结构约束——并表明它们通过基本权衡内在耦合。通过这个视角重新审视主要的建模家族，我们表明现有方法可以解释为 enforcing 不同约束子集，从而占据共同设计空间的不同区域。这一视角将缺乏可识别性等持久挑战重新构架为约束不足 formulations 的结果，而不是孤立的技术限制。更广泛地说，CLSM 提供了一个原则性框架，使设计选择明确化，分析权衡，并指导开发更具可解释性、鲁棒性和任务对齐的潜在状态模型。

Abstract

Learning latent representations from complex data is central to modern machine learning, spanning temporal, multimodal, and partially observed systems. In such settings, representations are better understood as latent states capturing underlying system dynamics, rather than as mere compressed summaries of observations. Yet current approaches remain fragmented, relying on distinct -- and often implicit -- assumptions about what these states should represent. We argue that this fragmentation reflects a more fundamental limitation: latent representations are typically learned from underconstrained objectives that fail to specify the properties that meaningful latent states should satisfy. As a result, multiple representations can satisfy the same objective, leading to ambiguity in their structure and interpretation. While many of the underlying principles have been explored in isolation, their interactions have not been explicitly formalized. In this work, we propose constrained latent state modeling (CLSM) as a unifying perspective. We identify a set of core properties -- predictive sufficiency, minimality, temporal coherence, observation compatibility, invariance to nuisance factors, and structural constraints -- and show that they are intrinsically coupled through fundamental trade-offs. Revisiting major modeling families through this lens, we show that existing approaches can be interpreted as enforcing different subsets of constraints, thereby occupying distinct regions of a common design space. This perspective reframes persistent challenges such as lack of identifiability as consequences of underconstrained formulations, rather than isolated technical limitations. More broadly, CLSM provides a principled framework to make design choices explicit, to analyze trade-offs, and to guide the development of more interpretable, robust, and task-aligned latent state models.

item.title: Nearest-Neighbour Matching on Unbounded Supports and Covariate Shift Transfer
item.author: Simon Viel
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了具有缺失标签的多变量函数期望估计问题，提出了在最小化协变量支撑假设下的收敛率结果。

背景: 在迁移学习和平均处理效应等各个领域中，经常出现具有缺失标签的多变量函数期望问题。现有的非参数估计器通常基于最近邻匹配，但假设协变量位于$\ext{R}^d$中某些形状良好的紧致子集内，且密度有界远离零。

目的: 本文旨在展示在协变量支撑上只需最小化假设的情况下，即可实现通常的收敛率。

方法: 将协变量支撑上的假设替换为关于源分布和目标分布的条件，包括衡量两个概率测度之间可转移性的度量。

主要发现: 这些条件是通用的，可以应用于支撑在流形上的分布，并允许目标分布比源分布具有更重的尾部。此外，证明了任何估计器要实现良好的收敛率都需要这种可转移性的控制。

结论: 将结果应用于处理效应估计时，可以放宽对赋值概率必须远离零和一的假设。

翻译: 在迁移学习和平均处理效应等各个领域中，经常出现具有缺失标签的多变量函数期望问题。现有的非参数估计器通常基于最近邻匹配，但假设协变量位于$\ext{R}^d$中某些形状良好的紧致子集内，且密度有界远离零。本文旨在展示在协变量支撑上只需最小化假设的情况下，即可实现通常的收敛率。将协变量支撑上的假设替换为关于源分布和目标分布的条件，包括衡量两个概率测度之间可转移性的度量。这些条件是通用的，可以应用于支撑在流形上的分布，并允许目标分布比源分布具有更重的尾部。此外，证明了任何估计器要实现良好的收敛率都需要这种可转移性的控制。将结果应用于处理效应估计时，可以放宽对赋值概率必须远离零和一的假设。

Abstract

Expectations of multivariate functions with missing labels occur in various fields such as transfer learning and average treatment effects. Although non-parametric estimators based on nearest-neighbour matching are frequently used in this context, the existing literature assumes that the covariates live in some well-shaped compact subset of $\R^d$, with densities that are bounded away from zero. In this paper, we show that the usual rates of convergence can be achieved with minimal assumptions on the covariate supports. These assumptions are replaced with conditions on the source and target distributions, among which a measure of the tranferability between the two probability measures. We show that these conditions are general, can be applied to distributions supported on manifolds, and allow the target distribution to have a heavier tail than the source distribution. We also show that this control of the transferability is needed for any estimator to achieve good rates of convergence. Finally, applying our results to the estimation of treatment effects, we could relax the assumption that the assignment probabilities had to be bounded away from zero and one.

item.title: ITGPT: Generative Pretraining on Irregular Timeseries
item.author: Antoine Honoré, Ming Xiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为ITGPT的注意力架构，旨在处理多模态、不规则采样的时间序列数据，通过自监督学习和类似GPT的目标函数进行训练。

背景: 时间序列回归模型在处理大规模标记的多模态数据时面临挑战，特别是在数据不规则采样或包含缺失值的情况下。这在医疗保健和预测性维护等领域很常见，因为这些领域的数据来自不可靠的来源，且标记需要专家知识或昂贵的设备。

目的: 为了解决Transformer类大型语言模型在处理不规则采样的多模态时间序列数据时缺乏灵活性的问题，本文引入了ITGPT架构。

方法: ITGPT是一种基于注意力的架构，设计用于处理多模态、不规则采样的时间序列。它允许使用自监督学习损失和类似GPT的目标函数进行训练。

主要发现: ITGPT在TIHM数据集的医疗保健任务和CompX数据集的预测性维护任务中实现了最先进的性能，无需重采样、特征融合或显式数据插补。此外，当标签稀缺时，ITGPT通过自监督学习和GPT训练有效利用未标记数据，优于纯监督方法。

结论: ITGPT代表了高效利用大型非结构化时间序列数据集进行实际推理任务的重要一步。

翻译: 时间序列回归模型通常难以利用大规模标记的多模态数据，特别是当数据不规则采样或包含缺失值时。这在医疗保健和预测性维护等领域很常见，因为这些领域的数据来自不可靠的来源，且标记需要专家知识或昂贵的设备。基于Transformer的大型语言模型在文本等结构化数据上通过自监督学习和生成式预训练框架已被证明是有效的。然而，此类模型缺乏高效处理不规则采样的多模态时间序列数据的灵活性。在本文中，我们介绍了ITGPT，这是一种基于注意力的架构，旨在通过允许使用自监督学习损失和类似GPT的目标函数进行训练，来处理多模态、不规则采样的时间序列。我们在TIHM数据集的医疗保健任务和CompX数据集的预测性维护任务上评估了其性能。我们的结果表明，ITGPT实现了最先进的性能，无需重采样、特征融合或显式数据插补。此外，当标签稀缺时，ITGPT通过自监督学习和GPT训练有效利用未标记数据，优于纯监督方法。这代表了高效利用大型非结构化时间序列数据集进行实际推理任务的重要一步。

Abstract

Timeseries regression models often struggle to leverage large volumes of labeled multimodal data, particularly when the data are irregularly sampled or contain missing values. This is common in domains like healthcare and predictive maintenance, where data are collected from unreliable sources, and labeling requires expert knowledge or costly equipments. Transformer-based large language models have proven effective on structured data such as text through self-supervised learning (SSL) and generative pretraining (GPT) frameworks. However, such models lack the flexibility to efficiently process irregularly sampled multimodal timeseries data. In this paper, we introduce ITGPT, an attention-based architecture designed for handling multimodal, irregularly sampled timeseries by allowing training with both SSL losses and GPT-like objectives. We evaluate its performance on a healthcare task with the TIHM dataset, and a predictive maintenance task with the CompX dataset. Our results demonstrate that ITGPT achieves state-of-the-art performance without requiring resampling, feature fusion or explicit data imputation. Furthermore, when labels are scarce, ITGPT effectively leverages unlabeled data through SSL and GPT training, outperforming the purely supervised approach. This represents an important step towards efficiently using large and unstructured timeseries datasets for practical inference tasks.

item.title: AgriMind: An Ensemble Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Class Plant Disease Classification
item.author: Salma Hoque Talukdar Koli, Fahima Haque Talukder Jely
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AgriMind是一个用于自动化植物病害检测的系统，通过集成多个深度学习模型在PlantVillage数据集上训练，实现了高准确率。

背景: 在孟加拉国，植物病害检测主要依赖人工目测，扩展工作者需要在数百万个小型农场上检查叶片样本。

目的: 构建AgriMind系统以自动化植物病害检测过程。

方法: 使用ResNet50、EfficientNet-B0和DenseNet121的集成模型，在20638张PlantVillage图像上训练，涵盖15个辣椒、土豆和番茄病害类别。采用迁移学习，冻结ImageNet骨干网络，仅训练头部10个轮次。

主要发现: 集成模型在测试集上达到99.23%的准确率，错误率降低了三分之二。辣椒和土豆分类完美，番茄分类达到99.01%。在NVIDIA T4 GPU上运行速度为53 FPS。

结论: 集成模型表现优异，但能否实现实时移动端应用取决于TensorFlow Lite优化工作。

翻译: 摘要：在孟加拉国，植物病害检测在很大程度上仍然是人工进行的，扩展工作者需要在数百万个小型农场上目测叶片样本。我们构建了AgriMind来自动化这一过程：一个在20638张PlantVillage图像上训练的ResNet50、EfficientNet-B0和DenseNet121的集成模型，涵盖15个辣椒、土豆和番茄病害类别。使用冻结的ImageNet骨干网络和10个轮次仅头部训练的迁移学习使管道保持轻量级。单个模型在保留的测试集上达到96-97%，但平均它们的softmax输出将集成模型推至99.23%——错误率降低了三分之二。我们尝试将平均偏向最佳验证模型；结果适得其反。丢弃任何单个模型也会损害性能。辣椒和土豆分类完美；番茄有十个视觉上相似的类别，仍达到99.01%。在NVIDIA T4 GPU上，完整集成模型以53 FPS运行。这能否转化为实时移动端使用取决于TensorFlow Lite优化——这是我们尚未完成的工作。

Abstract

Plant disease detection is still largely manual in Bangladesh, where extension workers eyeball leaf samples across millions of smallholdings. We built AgriMind to automate this: an ensemble of ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, and DenseNet121 trained on 20,638 PlantVillage images across 15 pepper, potato, and tomato disease classes. Transfer learning with frozen ImageNet backbones and 10 epochs of head-only training keeps the pipeline lightweight. Individual models hit 96--97% on the held-out test set, but averaging their softmax outputs pushes the ensemble to 99.23% -- a two-thirds cut in error rate. We tried biasing the average toward the best validation model; it backfired. Dropping any single model also hurt. Pepper and potato classify perfectly; tomato, with ten visually similar classes, still reaches 99.01%. On an NVIDIA T4 GPU the full ensemble runs at 53 FPS. Whether that translates to real-time mobile use depends on TensorFlow Lite optimization -- work we have not yet completed.

item.title: VideoSeeker: Incentivizing Instance-level Video Understanding via Native Agentic Tool Invocation
item.author: Yiming Zhao, Yu Zeng, Wenxuan Huang, Zhen Fang, Qing Miao, Qisheng Su, Jiawei Zhao, Jiayin Cai, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Yukun Qi, Yao Hu, Xiaolong Jiang, Feng Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为VideoSeeker的新范式，通过视觉提示实现实例级视频理解，将代理推理与实例级视频理解任务无缝集成，使模型能够主动感知和检索相关视频片段。

背景: 现有的大型视觉语言模型在需要精确时空定位的实例级视频理解任务中面临重大挑战，主要依赖文本提示进行人机交互，但文本提示难以提供精确的空间和时间参考，导致用户体验不佳。此外，当前方法通常将视觉感知与语言推理解耦，且推理围绕语言而非视觉内容进行，限制了模型主动感知细粒度视觉证据的能力。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在精确时空定位、文本提示局限性以及视觉感知与语言推理解耦方面的挑战，提出VideoSeeker这一新范式，以实现实例级视频理解。

方法: 构建了四个阶段的完全自动化数据合成管道以生成大规模高质量实例级视频数据；通过冷启动监督和强化学习训练，将工具调用和主动感知能力内化到模型中；无缝集成了代理推理与实例级视频理解任务。

主要发现: 实验表明，该模型在实例级视频理解任务上比基线平均提高了13.7%，超越了强大的闭源模型如GPT-4o和Gemini-2.5-Pro，并在通用视频理解基准测试中显示出有效的可迁移性。

结论: VideoSeeker通过视觉提示和代理推理的集成，成功实现了实例级视频理解，并在性能上显著优于现有模型，证明了其有效性和可迁移性。

翻译: 大型视觉语言模型在视频理解方面取得了显著进展，但在需要精确时空定位的实例级视频理解任务中面临重大挑战。现有方法主要依赖文本提示进行人机交互，但这些提示难以提供精确的空间和时间参考，导致用户体验不佳。此外，当前方法通常将视觉感知与语言推理解耦，推理围绕语言而非视觉内容进行，限制了模型主动感知细粒度视觉证据的能力。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了VideoSeeker，一种通过视觉提示实现实例级视频理解的新范式。VideoSeeker将代理推理与实例级视频理解任务无缝集成，使模型能够主动感知和检索相关视频片段。我们构建了一个四个阶段的完全自动化数据合成管道，以高效生成大规模、高质量的实例级视频数据。我们通过冷启动监督和强化学习训练，将工具调用和主动感知能力内化到模型中，构建了一个强大的视频理解模型。实验表明，我们的模型在实例级视频理解任务上比基线平均提高了13.7%，超越了强大的闭源模型如GPT-4o和Gemini-2.5-Pro，并在通用视频理解基准测试中显示出有效的可迁移性。相关数据集和代码将公开发布。

Abstract

Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown significant progress in video understanding, yet they face substantial challenges in tasks requiring precise spatiotemporal localization at the instance level. Existing methods primarily rely on text prompts for human-model interaction, but these prompts struggle to provide precise spatial and temporal references, resulting in poor user experience. Furthermore, current approaches typically decouple visual perception from language reasoning, centering reasoning around language rather than visual content, which limits the model's ability to proactively perceive fine-grained visual evidence. To address these challenges, we propose VideoSeeker, a novel paradigm for instance-level video understanding through visual prompts. VideoSeeker seamlessly integrates agentic reasoning with instance-level video understanding tasks, enabling the model to proactively perceive and retrieve relevant video segments on demand. We construct a four-stage fully automated data synthesis pipeline to efficiently generate large-scale, high-quality instance-level video data. We internalize tool-calling and proactive perception capabilities into the model via cold-start supervision and RL training, building a powerful video understanding model. Experiments demonstrate that our model achieves an average improvement of +13.7% over baselines on instance-level video understanding tasks, surpassing powerful closed-source models such as GPT-4o and Gemini-2.5-Pro, while also showing effective transferability on general video understanding benchmarks. The relevant datasets and code will be released publicly.

item.title: ReAlign: Generalizable Image Forgery Detection via Reasoning-Aligned Representation
item.author: Qing Huang, Zhipei Xu, Xuanyu Zhang, Xiangyu Yu, Jian Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ReAlign是一个轻量级框架，通过对比学习将大语言模型生成的推理文本蒸馏为高效的图像伪造检测器，在准确性和泛化能力上优于现有方法。

背景: AI生成图像的兴起对数字真实性提出了挑战，现有方法分为非大语言模型基础和基于大语言模型两类，各有优劣。

目的: 研究大语言模型生成推理文本的内在价值和潜力，并利用其作为泛化和语义误差敏感性的来源。

方法: 提出ReAlign框架，利用GRPO优化的LLM生成高质量推理文本，并通过对比学习将其蒸馏为轻量级检测器，采用联合优化策略整合对比损失和分类损失。

主要发现: ReAlign继承了推理文本表示的泛化能力和语义敏感性，且计算高效、轻量，在处理现代生成模型产生的高保真伪造时表现优异。

结论: 实验结果表明，ReAlign在准确性和泛化方面持续优于现有最先进检测器。

翻译: The rise of AI-generated images (AIGIs) poses growing challenges for digital authenticity, prompting the need for efficient, generalizable image forgery detection systems. Existing methods, whether non-LLM-based or LLM-based, exhibit distinct advantages and limitations. While non-LLM-based models offer efficient low-level artifact detection, they often lack semantic understanding. Conversely, LLM-based methods provide strong semantic reasoning and explainability but are computationally intensive and less sensitive to subtle visual artifacts. Moreover, the true contribution of explanatory reasoning texts to forgery detection performance remains unclear. In this work, we investigate the intrinsic value and potential of LLM-generated reasoning texts, considering it a source of generalization and semantic-error sensitivity. Based on these findings, we propose ReAlign, a novel framework that distills high-quality reasoning texts generated by a GRPO-optimized LLM into a lightweight AIGI detector via contrastive learning. ReAlign effectively inherits the generalization ability and semantic sensitivity capability of reasoning textual representations, while remaining efficient and lightweight for deployment. Moreover, ReAlign adopts a tailored joint optimization strategy that integrates contrastive loss for image-text alignment and classification loss for accurate forgery discrimination. Experimental results on AIGCDetectBenchmark, AIGI-Holmes, and our newly constructed UltraSynth-10k demonstrate that ReAlign consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art detectors in both accuracy and generalization, particularly when facing complex, high-fidelity forgeries from modern generative models.

Abstract

The rise of AI-generated images (AIGIs) poses growing challenges for digital authenticity, prompting the need for efficient, generalizable image forgery detection systems. Existing methods, whether non-LLM-based or LLM-based, exhibit distinct advantages and limitations. While non-LLM-based models offer efficient low-level artifact detection, they often lack semantic understanding. Conversely, LLM-based methods provide strong semantic reasoning and explainability but are computationally intensive and less sensitive to subtle visual artifacts. Moreover, the true contribution of explanatory reasoning texts to forgery detection performance remains unclear. In this work, we investigate the intrinsic value and potential of LLM-generated reasoning texts, considering it a source of generalization and semantic-error sensitivity. Based on these findings, we propose ReAlign, a novel framework that distills high-quality reasoning texts generated by a GRPO-optimized LLM into a lightweight AIGI detector via contrastive learning. ReAlign effectively inherits the generalization ability and semantic sensitivity capability of reasoning textual representations, while remaining efficient and lightweight for deployment. Moreover, ReAlign adopts a tailored joint optimization strategy that integrates contrastive loss for image-text alignment and classification loss for accurate forgery discrimination. Experimental results on AIGCDetectBenchmark, AIGI-Holmes, and our newly constructed UltraSynth-10k demonstrate that ReAlign consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art detectors in both accuracy and generalization, particularly when facing complex, high-fidelity forgeries from modern generative models.

item.title: MIND: Decoupling Model-Induced Label Noise via Latent Manifold Disentanglement
item.author: Dayong Ren
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MIND的框架，旨在解决预训练模型在自动标注中产生的系统性标签噪声问题。

背景: 基于预训练专家和基础模型的自动标注范式在数据密集型应用中占主导地位，但引入了模型诱导的标签噪声这一关键挑战。这种噪声不同于经典鲁棒学习中的随机噪声，源于标注者的归纳偏差，表现为与局部特征流形紧密耦合的系统误差。

目的: 解决现有方法在处理这种结构性噪声模式时的不足，特别是现有方法依赖于全局转换矩阵导致欠拟合，而学习实例特定矩阵在数学上难以处理的问题。

方法: 提出了模型诱导噪声解耦框架MIND，通过潜在流形解耦将高维噪声流形分解为可处理的、依赖于子空间的组件。具体使用了潜在解耦估计器LDE，动态将样本投影到具有一致误差模式的潜在结构簇中，从而实现噪声可识别性。

主要发现: 在从CIFAR-100上的受控噪声到大规模现实世界3D数据集（如S3DIS、ScanNet）上的结构性压力测试中，MIND显著优于最先进的方法，并有效纠正了视觉语言模型（如OpenSeg）的零样本幻觉。

结论: MIND证明了其作为基础模型鲁棒蒸馏框架的潜力，能够有效处理复杂的基准测试并修正模型产生的错误。

翻译: 基于预训练专家和基础模型驱动的自动标注范式主导了数据密集型应用。然而，它引入了一个关键挑战：模型诱导的标签噪声。与经典鲁棒学习中的随机噪声不同，这种噪声源于标注者的归纳偏差，表现为与局部特征流形紧密耦合的系统误差。现有方法依赖于全局转换矩阵，在这些结构性模式上欠拟合，而学习实例特定矩阵在数学上仍然难以处理。我们提出了模型诱导噪声解耦（MIND），这是一个理论上扎实的框架，解决了这一两难困境。我们证明，高维噪声流形可以通过潜在流形解耦分解为可处理的、依赖于子空间的组件。具体来说，我们的潜在解耦估计器（LDE）动态地将样本投影到具有一致误差模式的潜在结构簇中，从而实现噪声可识别性，而无需地面实况锚点。为了严格评估鲁棒性，我们采用了一个分层协议：从CIFAR-100上的受控噪声转移到大规模现实世界3D数据集（S3DIS、ScanNet）上的结构性压力测试，其中误差模式明确与几何流形耦合。经验上，MIND在这些复杂基准测试中显著优于最先进的方法，并有效纠正了视觉语言模型（如OpenSeg）的零样本幻觉，突显了其作为基础模型鲁棒蒸馏框架的潜力。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决模型诱导的标签噪声问题。由于输入文本未明确说明该问题的重要性，因此无法回答。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

The paradigm of learning from automatic annotations driven by pre-trained experts and Foundation Models dominates data-hungry applications. However, it introduces a critical challenge: model-induced label noise. Unlike stochastic noise in classical robust learning, this noise stems from annotator inductive biases, manifesting as systematic errors tightly coupled with local feature manifolds. Existing methods relying on global transition matrices underfit these structural patterns, while learning instance-specific matrices remains mathematically intractable. We propose Model-Induced Noise Decoupling (MIND), a theoretically grounded framework addressing this dilemma. We demonstrate that the high-dimensional noise manifold can be decoupled into tractable, subspace-dependent components via Latent Manifold Disentanglement. Specifically, our Latent Decoupling Estimator (LDE) dynamically projects samples into latent structural clusters with consistent error modes, facilitating noise identifiability without ground-truth anchor points. To rigorously evaluate robustness, we adopt a hierarchical protocol: moving from controlled noise on CIFAR-100 to a structural stress test on large-scale real-world 3D datasets (S3DIS, ScanNet), where error patterns explicitly couple with geometric manifolds. Empirically, MIND significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on these complex benchmarks and effectively corrects zero-shot hallucinations from Vision-Language Models (e.g., OpenSeg), highlighting its potential as a robust distillation framework for Foundation Models.

item.title: Towards Foundation Models for Relational Databases with Language Models and Graph Neural Networks
item.author: Jingcheng Wu, Ratan Bahadur Thapa, Mojtaba Nayyeri, Lucas Etteldorf, Max Finkenbeiner, Fabian Leeske, Steffen Staab
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种结合BERT编码器和图神经网络（GNN）的混合架构，用于处理关系数据库中的深度学习任务。

背景: 关系数据库存储了大量结构化信息，对复杂预测应用至关重要。然而，现有的深度学习方法通常通过手动特征工程将数据库展平为单个表格，忽略了关系上下文。

目的: 结合深度学习在关系数据上的优势，提出一种混合架构，以同时捕捉行内语义和关系上下文。

方法: 提出了一种混合架构，包括一个微调的BART编码器用于捕捉行内语义，以及一个基于GraphSAGE的GNN用于处理关系实体图（REGs）以注入关系上下文。

主要发现: 在RelBench上的实验表明，GNN显著丰富了BART的行嵌入，在driver-dnf任务上达到了67.40的ROC-AUC。该性能与LightGBM（68.86）和RDL（72.62）具有竞争力，但与最先进的KumoRFM（82.63）仍有差距。

结论: 轻量级混合语言模型-图神经网络架构为关系数据库基础模型提供了一条有前景且资源高效的路径。

翻译: 关系数据库存储了世界上大部分结构化信息，对驱动复杂的预测应用至关重要。然而，关系数据上的深度学习进展仍然有限，因为传统方法通过手动特征工程将数据库展平为单个表格，丢弃了关系上下文。关系深度学习（RDL）通过将数据库建模为关系实体图（REGs）用于图神经网络（GNN）来解决这个问题，但仍然针对特定任务和数据库。为了结合这两种范式的优势，我们提出了一种混合架构，结合微调的BART编码器以捕捉行内语义，以及基于GraphSAGE的GNN处理REGs以注入关系上下文。在RelBench上的实验表明，GNN显著丰富了BART的行嵌入，在rel-f1数据集的driver-dnf任务上达到了67.40的ROC-AUC。该性能与监督基线如LightGBM（68.86）具有竞争力，并将与RDL（72.62）的差距缩小到5.22点，尽管与最先进的KumoRFM（82.63）仍有显著差距。这些结果表明，轻量级混合LM-GNN架构为关系数据库基础模型提供了一条有前景且资源高效的路径。

Abstract

Relational databases store much of the world's structured information, and they are essential for driving complex predictive applications. However, deep learning progress on relational data remains limited, as conventional approaches flatten databases into single tables via manual feature engineering, discarding relational context. Relational deep learning (RDL) addresses this by modeling databases as relational entity graphs (REGs) for graph neural networks (GNNs), but remains task- and database-specific. To combine the strengths of both paradigms, we propose a hybrid architecture combining a fine-tuned BART encoder to capture intra-row semantics with a GraphSAGE-based GNN over REGs to inject relational context. Experiments on RelBench show that the GNN substantially enriches BART's row embeddings, achieving a ROC-AUC of 67.40 on the driver-dnf task from the rel-f1 dataset. This performance is competitive with supervised baselines such as LightGBM (68.86) and narrows the gap to RDL (72.62) to within 5.22 points, though a substantial gap remains to state-of-the-art foundation models such as KumoRFM (82.63). These results suggest that lightweight hybrid LM-GNN architectures offer a promising and resource-efficient path towards foundation models for relational databases.

item.title: Towards Trustworthy and Explainable AI for Perception Models: From Concept to Prototype Vehicle Deployment
item.author: Till Beemelmanns, Shayan Sharifi, Manas Mehrotra, Ayushman Choudhuri, Lutz Eckstein
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种可信AI感知模块，该模块具有鲁棒性、忠实可解释性和校准的不确定性估计，并在原型车辆上进行了部署。

背景: 深度神经网络已成为自动驾驶感知的主流解决方案，但其不透明性违背了可信AI准则，并 complicates 安全保证、调试和人工监督。虽然存在安全可解释AI的理论框架，但针对3D场景理解的可信AI具体实现仍然稀缺。

目的: 解决3D场景理解中可信AI具体实现稀缺的问题，提出一种可信AI感知模块。

方法: 基于基于Transformer的检测器，在推理时从注意力机制中推导解释，并使用基于扰动的一致性测试来验证其忠实性。此外，集成了不确定性估计和校准模块，并应用了增强鲁棒性的训练方法。

主要发现: 实验表明具有忠实的显著性行为、提高了鲁棒性以及校准良好的不确定性估计。

结论: 在原型车辆上部署了这些可信AI元素，并提供了一个XAI界面来可视化文档工件、模型不确定性状态和显著性图，证明了在实时中进行可信感知监控的可行性。

翻译: 深度神经网络已成为自动驾驶感知的主流解决方案，但其不透明性违背了新兴的可信AI准则，并 complicates 安全保证、调试和人工监督。虽然存在安全可解释AI的理论框架，但针对3D场景理解的可信AI具体实现仍然稀缺。我们通过提出一种可信AI感知模块来解决这个问题，该模块具有惊人的鲁棒性、集成了忠实的可解释性以及校准的不确定性估计。基于基于Transformer的检测器，我们在推理时从注意力机制中推导解释，并使用基于扰动的一致性测试来验证其忠实性。我们进一步集成了不确定性估计和校准模块，并应用了增强鲁棒性的训练方法。实验表明具有忠实的显著性行为、提高了鲁棒性以及校准良好的不确定性估计。最后，我们在原型车辆上部署了这些可信AI元素，并提供了一个XAI界面来可视化文档工件、模型不确定性状态和显著性图，证明了在实时中进行可信感知监控的可行性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文探讨了如何将可信和可解释的AI应用于感知模型，并实现了从概念到原型车部署的转化。

Abstract

Deep Neural Networks have become the dominant solution for Autonomous Driving perception, but their opacity conflicts with emerging Trustworthy AI guidelines and complicates safety assurance, debugging, and human oversight. While theoretical frameworks for safe and Explainable AI (XAI) exist, concrete implementations of Trustworthy AI for 3D scene understanding remain scarce. We address this gap by proposing a Trustworthy AI perception module that is remarkably robust, integrates faithful explainability, and calibrated uncertainty estimates. Building on a transformer-based detector, we derive explanation from the attention mechanism at inference time and validate their faithfulness using perturbation-based consistency tests. We further integrate an uncertainty estimation and calibration module, and apply robustness-enhancing training methods. Experiments show faithful saliency behavior, improved robustness, and well-calibrated uncertainty estimates. Finally, we deploy these Trustworthy AI elements in a prototype vehicle and provide an XAI Interface that visualizes documentation artifacts, model uncertainty state, and saliency maps, demonstrating the feasibility of trustworthy perception monitoring in real time. Supplementary materials are available at https://tillbeemelmanns.github.io/trustworthy_ai/ .

item.title: SiFo: Wireless Foundation Model for Low-Overhead Site-Specific CSI Feedback
item.author: Cheng-Jie Zhao, Zhaolin Wang, Zongyao Zhao, Yuanwei Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SiFo是一种无线基础模型框架，用于低开销的特定站点信道状态信息（CSI）反馈。它通过预训练和轻量级校准解决了现有方法在扩展性上的问题，实现了高效的CSI捕获和频谱效率提升。

背景: 在3GPP NR中，Type-II反馈虽然表达能力强，但需要大量参考信号开销、UE端搜索和反馈。现有的基于学习的特定站点反馈虽然能降低在线成本并保留高质量子空间表示，但通常需要为每个新站点训练专用神经网络，限制了大规模部署时的扩展性。

目的: 为了解决现有特定站点设计在部署数量大时扩展性受限的问题，提出SiFo框架。其目的是通过预训练和轻量级校准，实现跨源站点预训练模型对目标站点的适应，从而在保持本地适应性的同时转移通用传播知识。

方法: SiFo首先在多个源站点上预训练CSI反馈模型，然后通过轻量级校准适应目标站点。具体做法是：少量目标站点用户报告低维参考信号接收功率（RSRP）指纹，并将其基于全CSI的子空间标签存储为校准内存。在线运行时，通过相同的SSB探测和RSRP报告程序将服务用户与校准用户匹配，利用附近的校准样本提供特定站点的子空间指导，而无需更新模型参数。

主要发现: 1. 在相同的特定站点标记预算下，SiFo比单独训练的特定站点学习基线实现了更高的CSI捕获效率；2. SiFo仅使用在线SSB探测期间收集的RSRP测量值，就接近了高开销的3GPP NR Type-II反馈参考；3. 在有限的特定站点数据下，SiFo将高CSI捕获效率和低开销转化为有效的频谱效率提升。

结论: SiFo成功实现了跨站点传播知识的转移和本地适应的保留，在多个城市场景的数值结果中证明了其有效性，能够以低开销实现高CSI捕获效率，并最终提升频谱效率。

翻译: SiFo是一种基于无线基础模型的框架，旨在实现低开销的特定站点信道状态信息（CSI）反馈。在3GPP NR中，Type-II反馈提供了一种基于码本的CSI表示，但它需要大量的参考信号开销、UE端搜索和反馈。基于学习的特定站点反馈可以通过利用与部署相关的传播结构来降低这些在线成本，同时保留高质量的子空间表示。然而，现有的特定站点设计通常为每个新站点训练一个专用的神经网络，这在部署数量很大时限制了扩展性。SiFo通过在源站点之间预训练CSI反馈模型，并通过轻量级校准适应目标站点，解决了这一扩展性问题。少量目标站点用户报告低维参考信号接收功率（RSRP）指纹，并将其基于全CSI的子空间标签存储为校准内存。在在线运行期间，通过相同的SSB探测和RSRP报告程序将服务用户与校准用户匹配，因此附近的校准样本提供特定站点的子空间指导，而无需更新模型参数。因此，SiFo转移了通用传播知识，同时保留了本地适应。在十个城市场景中的数值结果表明，SiFo（i）在相同的特定站点标记预算下，比单独训练的特定站点学习基线实现了更高的CSI捕获效率，（ii）仅使用在线SSB探测期间收集的RSRP测量值，就接近了高开销的3GPP NR Type-II反馈参考，（iii）在有限的特定站点数据下，将高CSI捕获效率和低开销转化为有效的频谱效率提升。

Abstract

SiFo, a wireless foundation model-based framework, is proposed for low-overhead site-specific channel state information (CSI) feedback. In 3GPP NR, Type-II feedback provides an expressive codebook-based CSI representation, but it requires substantial reference-signal overhead, UE-side search, and feedback. Learning-based site-specific feedback can reduce these online costs while retaining high-quality subspace representation by exploiting deployment-dependent propagation structure. However, existing site-specific designs typically train a dedicated neural network for each new site, which limits scalability when the number of deployments is large. SiFo addresses this scalability issue by pretraining a CSI feedback model across source sites and adapting it to a target site through lightweight calibration. A small set of target-site users reports low-dimensional reference signal received power (RSRP) fingerprints, and their full-CSI-based subspace labels are stored as calibration memory. During online operation, a served user is matched to calibrated users through the same SSB probing and RSRP reporting procedure, so nearby calibration samples provide site-specific subspace guidance without updating model parameters. SiFo therefore transfers common propagation knowledge while retaining local adaptation. Numerical results across ten city scenarios demonstrate that SiFo (i) achieves higher CSI-capture efficiency than separately trained site-specific learning baselines under the same target-site labeled budget, (ii) approaches the high-overhead 3GPP NR Type-II feedback reference using only RSRP measurements collected during online SSB probing, and (iii) converts the high CSI-capture efficiency and low overhead into effective spectral efficiency improvement under limited target-site data.

item.title: Look Before You Leap: Autonomous Exploration for LLM Agents
item.author: Ye, Ziang, Shi, Wentao, Liu, Yuxin, Wang, Yu, Cai, Zhengzhou, Shi, Yaorui, Gu, Qi, Cai, Xunliang, Feng, Fuli
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对大型语言模型代理在陌生环境中因过早利用先验知识而失败的问题，本文提出了一种名为探索检查点覆盖率的可验证指标，并开发了探索-先行动范式来提升代理的探索能力。

背景: 大型语言模型代理在陌生环境中往往因过早利用先验知识而失败，缺乏自主探索能力。

目的: 形式化并量化自主探索能力，并开发一种训练策略和范式来提升代理的探索能力。

方法: 引入探索检查点覆盖率作为可验证指标；开发了一种训练策略，交替进行任务执行和探索；提出了探索-先行动范式，将信息收集与任务执行解耦。

主要发现: 标准任务导向强化学习训练的代理表现出狭窄和重复的行为；学习系统地探索对于构建可泛化和现实世界就绪的代理是必要的。

结论: 系统地学习探索对于构建通用且现实世界就绪的代理至关重要。

翻译: 基于大型语言模型的代理经常在陌生环境中因过早利用而失败：一种在获得足够环境特定信息之前就根据先验知识行动的倾向。我们确定自主探索是构建适应性代理的关键但未被充分探索的能力。为了形式化和量化这种能力，我们引入了探索检查点覆盖率，这是一个可验证的指标，衡量代理发现关键状态、对象和 affordances 的广度。我们的系统评估表明，使用标准任务导向强化学习训练的代理始终表现出狭窄和重复的行为，阻碍下游性能。为了解决这一局限性，我们开发了一种训练策略，交替进行任务执行和探索回放，每种类型的回放都由其对应的可验证奖励进行优化。基于这种训练策略，我们提出了探索-先行动范式，它将信息收集与任务执行解耦：代理首先利用交互预算获取基础环境知识，然后利用它来解决任务。我们的结果表明，学习系统地探索对于构建可泛化和现实世界就绪的代理是必要的。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出了一种名为“先看后跳”的自主探索策略，旨在提升大语言模型代理在采取行动前观察环境的能力，从而提高探索效率。

Abstract

Large language model based agents often fail in unfamiliar environments due to premature exploitation: a tendency to act on prior knowledge before acquiring sufficient environment-specific information. We identify autonomous exploration as a critical yet underexplored capability for building adaptive agents. To formalize and quantify this capability, we introduce Exploration Checkpoint Coverage, a verifiable metric that measures how broadly an agent discovers key states, objects, and affordances. Our systematic evaluation reveals that agents trained with standard task-oriented reinforcement learning consistently exhibit narrow and repetitive behaviors that impede downstream performance. To address this limitation, we develop a training strategy that interleaves task-execution rollouts and exploration rollouts, with each type of rollout optimized by its corresponding verifiable reward. Building on this training strategy, we propose the Explore-then-Act paradigm, which decouples information-gathering from task execution: agents first utilize an interaction budget to acquire grounded environmental knowledge, then leverage it for task resolution. Our results demonstrate that learning to systematically explore is imperative for building generalizable and real-world-ready agents.

item.title: Second-Order Multi-Level Variance Correction for Modality Competition in Multimodal Models
item.author: Yishun Lu, Wes Armour
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为ML-FOP-SOAP的多级方差校正二阶优化框架，用于解决自回归下一词训练中的模态竞争问题，提高样本效率和训练速度。

背景: 自回归下一词训练为图像生成和文本理解提供了统一形式，但模态竞争导致优化不稳定并限制了大规模批次的扩展。

目的: 构建一个稳健的优化器框架，以稳定多模态对齐的优化过程，并提高样本效率和训练速度。

方法: 提出ML-FOP-SOAP框架，包含Fisher正交投影以抑制方差诱导的模态冲突，以及分层折叠策略以在低微步开销下捕获细粒度方差。

主要发现: 二阶预条件（特别是SOAP）比一阶优化器（如AdamW）更稳定；该方法在Janus和Emu3上在两种模态上均取得一致增益；在批大小8192下训练稳定；相比AdamW，样本效率提高最多1.4倍，加速训练最多1.5倍。

结论: ML-FOP-SOAP为扩展多模态基础模型提供了一个稳健的优化器。

翻译: 自回归下一词训练为图像生成和文本理解提供了统一形式，但也产生了强烈的模态竞争，导致优化不稳定并限制了大规模批次的扩展。我们表明，像AdamW这样的第一阶优化器容易受到跨模态梯度异质性的影响，而二阶预条件，特别是SOAP，为多模态对齐提供了更稳定的基础。基于这一见解，我们提出了ML-FOP-SOAP，一个具有多级方差校正的二阶优化框架。我们的Fisher正交投影抑制了由方差引起的模态冲突，减少了视觉生成和文本理解之间的权衡。为了在大梯度累积下使其具有实用性，我们引入了一种分层折叠策略，以低微步开销捕获细粒度方差。在Janus和Emu3上的实验显示，在两种模态上均取得一致增益，并且在批大小8192下训练稳定。与AdamW相比，我们的方法将样本效率提高了最多1.4倍，将时钟训练时间加速了最多1.5倍，为扩展多模态基础模型提供了一个稳健的优化器。

Abstract

Autoregressive next-token training offers a unified formulation for image generation and text understanding, but it also creates strong modality competition that destabilizes optimization and limits large-batch scaling. We show that first-order optimizers such as AdamW are vulnerable to cross-modality gradient heterogeneity, while second-order preconditioning, particularly SOAP, provides a more stable basis for multimodal alignment. Building on this insight, we propose \emph{ML-FOP-SOAP}, a second-order optimization framework with Multi-Level Variance Correction. Our Fisher-Orthogonal Projection suppresses variance-induced modality conflicts, reducing the trade-off between visual generation and textual understanding. To make this practical under large gradient accumulation, we introduce a hierarchical folding strategy that captures fine-grained variance with low micro-step overhead. Experiments on Janus and Emu3 show consistent gains across both modalities and stable training at batch size 8192. Compared with AdamW, our method improves sample efficiency by up to $1.4\times$ and accelerates wall-clock training by up to $1.5\times$, offering a robust optimizer for scaling multimodal foundation models.

item.title: Formal Methods Meet LLMs: Auditing, Monitoring, and Intervention for Compliance of Advanced AI Systems
item.author: Parand A. Alamdari, Toryn Q. Klassen, Sheila A. McIlraith
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了AI治理中的一个特定维度，即如何监控和审计AI产品和服务在整个AI开发生命周期中的表现，从部署前测试到部署后审计。

背景: 为了应对黑箱高级AI系统，特别是大型语言模型，需要开发能够执行离线审计和在线运行时监控的技术。

目的: 提出结合形式化方法和最先进机器学习的技术，使AI产品和服务开发者以及第三方开发者/评估者能够对产品特定的、时间延展的行为约束（如安全约束、规范、规则和法规）进行审计和监控。

方法: 利用线性时态逻辑（LTL）的形式语法和语义，提出采样方法进行预测监控，并引入在运行时干预的监视器以预防和缓解违规行为。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，所提出的审计和监控技术在检测时间延展的行为约束违规方面优于LLM基线方法；小模型标签员的表现可与前沿LLM裁判相媲美；预测和干预监视器显著降低了基于LLM的代理的违规率，同时保持了任务性能。

结论: LLM的时间推理能力随着事件距离、约束数量和命题数量的增加而显著下降。

翻译: 本文探讨了AI治理的一个特定维度，即如何在整个AI开发生命周期中监控和审计AI产品和服务，从部署前测试到部署后审计。结合形式化方法和最先进的机器学习，我们提出了一种技术，使AI产品和服务开发者以及第三方AI开发者和评估者能够对产品特定的、时间延展的行为约束（如安全约束、规范、规则和法规）进行离线审计和在线运行时监控，特别是针对黑箱高级AI系统，如大型语言模型。我们还提供了预测监控的实用技术，如基于采样的方法，并引入了在运行时干预的监视器，以预防和缓解预测到的违规行为。实验结果表明，通过利用线性时态逻辑（LTL）的形式语法和语义，我们提出的审计和监控技术在检测时间延展的行为约束违规方面优于LLM基线方法；使用我们的方法，即使是小模型标签员也能匹配或超过前沿LLM裁判。我们的预测和干预监视器显著降低了基于LLM的代理的违规率，同时保持了任务性能。我们进一步通过对照实验表明，随着事件距离、约束数量和命题数量的增加，LLM的时间推理准确性显著下降。

Abstract

We examine one particular dimension of AI governance: how to monitor and audit AI-enabled products and services throughout the AI development lifecycle, from pre-deployment testing to post-deployment auditing. Combining principles from formal methods with SoTA machine learning, we propose techniques that enable AI-enabled product and service developers, as well as third party AI developers and evaluators, to perform offline auditing and online (runtime) monitoring of product-specific (temporally extended) behavioral constraints such as safety constraints, norms, rules and regulations with respect to black-box advanced AI systems, notably LLMs. We further provide practical techniques for predictive monitoring, such as sampling-based methods, and we introduce intervening monitors that act at runtime to preempt and potentially mitigate predicted violations. Experimental results show that by exploiting the formal syntax and semantics of Linear Temporal Logic (LTL), our proposed auditing and monitoring techniques are superior to LLM baseline methods in detecting violations of temporally extended behavioral constraints; with our approach, even small-model labelers match or exceed frontier LLM judges. Our predictive and intervening monitors significantly reduce the violation rates of LLM-based agents while largely preserving task performance. We further show through controlled experiments that LLMs' temporal reasoning shows a pronounced degradation in accuracy with increasing event distance, number of constraints, and number of propositions.

item.title: Breaking the Finite-Sample Barrier in Entropy Coupling
item.author: Shahab Asoodeh, Jun Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了边际约束观测之间的依赖关系如何打破有限样本界限，引入了最小列表熵耦合和最小条件熵的概念，并揭示了独立观测与依赖观测在消除不确定性上的差异。

背景: 传统的基于独立观测的模型无法描述边际约束观测之间依赖关系对有限样本界限的影响。

目的: 形式化依赖观测现象，并研究在给定离散边际分布下，观测样本如何消除剩余不确定性。

方法: 引入最小列表熵耦合和最小条件熵，建立依赖观测模型；提出贪婪算法以计算最小列表熵耦合；在分布匹配表示学习和随机提取中应用该框架。

主要发现: 独立观测使剩余不确定性呈指数级减少，而依赖观测可以在有限样本后完全消除不确定性；在温和支撑假设下，零熵状态可在 O(log(1/P_min)) 个观测内实现。

结论: 依赖观测模型揭示了零熵状态的充分必要条件及结构准则；该框架可用于形式化分布匹配表示学习和随机提取中的有限样本极限。

翻译: Dependence among marginally constrained observations can break a finite-sample barrier. To formalize this phenomenon, we introduce the minimum list entropy coupling H(P||Q_1,...,Q_m), the minimum conditional entropy H(X|Y_1,...,Y_m) over all joint distributions with prescribed discrete marginals X~P and Y_i~Q_i. Unlike classical formulations based on independent observations, our model allows Y_1,...,Y_m to be arbitrarily dependent while keeping each marginal fixed. This enlarged coupling space reveals a sharp dichotomy: independent observations reduce residual uncertainty exponentially, whereas dependent observations can eliminate it exactly after finitely many samples. We characterize this zero-entropy regime through necessary and sufficient conditions and give concrete structural criteria under which it occurs. In particular, under mild support assumptions, zero entropy is achieved with O(log(1/P_min)) observations, where P_min is the minimum nonzero mass of P. We also develop a greedy algorithm with monotone approximation guarantees for computing H(P||Q_1,...,Q_m). Finally, we show that the same framework formalizes finite-sample limits in distribution-matching representation learning and randomness extraction, where zero entropy corresponds to exact recovery and exact extraction.

Abstract

Dependence among marginally constrained observations can break a finite-sample barrier. To formalize this phenomenon, we introduce the \emph{minimum list entropy coupling} $H(P\|Q_1,\dots,Q_m)$, the minimum conditional entropy $H(X|Y_1,\dots,Y_m)$ over all joint distributions with prescribed discrete marginals $X\sim P$ and $Y_i\sim Q_i$. Unlike classical formulations based on independent observations, our model allows $Y_1,\dots,Y_m$ to be arbitrarily dependent while keeping each marginal fixed. This enlarged coupling space reveals a sharp dichotomy: independent observations reduce residual uncertainty exponentially, whereas dependent observations can eliminate it exactly after finitely many samples. We characterize this zero-entropy regime through necessary and sufficient conditions and give concrete structural criteria under which it occurs. In particular, under mild support assumptions, zero entropy is achieved with $O(\log(1/P_{\min}))$ observations, where $P_{\min}$ is the minimum nonzero mass of $P$. We also develop a greedy algorithm with monotone approximation guarantees for computing $H(P\|Q_1,\dots,Q_m)$. Finally, we show that the same framework formalizes finite-sample limits in distribution-matching representation learning and randomness extraction, where zero entropy corresponds to exact recovery and exact extraction.

item.title: DexJoCo: A Benchmark and Toolkit for Task-Oriented Dexterous Manipulation on MuJoCo
item.author: Wang, Hanwen, Zhao, Weizhi, Wang, Xiangyu, Huang, Siyuan, Lin, He, Zheng, Boyuan, Xu, Rongtao, Wang, Gang, Mu, Yao, Wang, He, Fan, Lue, Li, Hongsheng, Zhang, Zhaoxiang, Tan, Tieniu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了DexJoCo基准和工具包，包含11个基于功能导向的任务，用于评估灵巧手的工具使用、双臂协调、长时序执行和推理能力。

背景: 现有灵巧手基准缺乏反映灵巧手相对于平行夹爪独特操作能力的任务，以及全面的评估流程。

目的: 提出DexJoCo基准和工具包，用于任务导向的灵巧操作，并评估现代模型在多样化设置下的表现。

方法: 开发了低成本数据收集系统，收集了1.1K轨迹，支持域随机化；在视觉和动力学随机化、多任务训练和动作头适应等多样化设置下对现代模型进行基准测试。

主要发现: 通过广泛的经验分析，识别了当前策略在灵巧操作中的重要见解和常见局限性，突出了灵巧手机器人学习的关键挑战。

结论: DexJoCo基准为系统评估灵巧操作能力提供了标准，并指出了未来研究的关键挑战。

翻译: Achieving human-level manipulation requires dexterous robotic hands capable of complex object interactions. Advancing such capabilities further demands standardized benchmarks for systematic evaluation. However, existing dexterous benchmarks lack tasks that reflect the unique manipulation capabilities of dexterous hands over parallel grippers, as well as comprehensive evaluation pipelines. In this paper, we present DexJoCo, a benchmark and toolkit for task-oriented dexterous manipulation, comprising 11 functionally grounded tasks that evaluate tool-use, bimanual coordination, long-horizon execution, and reasoning. We develop a low-cost data collection system and collect 1.1K trajectories across these tasks, with support for domain randomization to assess robustness. We benchmark modern models under diverse settings, including visual and dynamics randomization, multi-task training, and action-head adaptation. Through extensive empirical analysis, we identify several important insights and common limitations of current policies in dexterous manipulation, highlighting key challenges for future research in dexterous hand robot learning. Project page available at: this https URL

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决 MuJoCo 仿真环境中缺乏面向任务的灵巧操作基准和工具包的问题。这个问题很重要，因为灵巧操作是机器人技术的核心能力，缺乏标准基准使得研究人员难以公平比较不同算法的性能，从而阻碍了该领域的发展。

Abstract

Achieving human-level manipulation requires dexterous robotic hands capable of complex object interactions. Advancing such capabilities further demands standardized benchmarks for systematic evaluation. However, existing dexterous benchmarks lack tasks that reflect the unique manipulation capabilities of dexterous hands over parallel grippers, as well as comprehensive evaluation pipelines. In this paper, we present DexJoCo, a benchmark and toolkit for task-oriented dexterous manipulation, comprising 11 functionally grounded tasks that evaluate tool-use, bimanual coordination, long-horizon execution, and reasoning. We develop a low-cost data collection system and collect 1.1K trajectories across these tasks, with support for domain randomization to assess robustness. We benchmark modern models under diverse settings, including visual and dynamics randomization, multi-task training, and action-head adaptation. Through extensive empirical analysis, we identify several important insights and common limitations of current policies in dexterous manipulation, highlighting key challenges for future research in dexterous hand robot learning. item.title: IVGT: Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer for Neural Scene Representation
item.author: Yuqi Wu, Tianyu Hu, Wenzhao Zheng, Yuanhui Huang, Haowen Sun, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为IVGT的隐式视觉几何Transformer模型，用于从无姿态多视图图像中重建连贯的3D几何和外观。

背景: 从无姿态多视图图像重建连贯的3D几何和外观是计算机视觉中的一个基本但具有挑战性的问题。大多数现有的视觉几何基础模型通过回归像素对齐的点图来预测显式几何，往往存在冗余和几何连续性有限的问题。

目的: 提出IVGT，一种隐式视觉几何Transformer，用于从无姿态多视图图像中隐式建模连续且连贯的几何。

方法: IVGT在规范坐标系中学习连续的神经场景表示，支持在任何3D位置进行连续的空间查询。它检索局部特征，使用轻量级解码器预测有符号距离值和颜色。它允许直接提取连续且连贯的表面几何，从而能够从任意视角渲染RGB图像、深度图和表面法线图。IVGT通过多数据集联合优化进行训练，结合了2D监督和3D几何正则化。

主要发现: IVGT在跨场景的泛化方面表现出色，并在各种任务中实现了强大的性能，包括网格和点云重建、新视角合成、深度和表面法线估计以及相机位姿估计。

结论: IVGT能够从无姿态多视图图像中重建连贯的3D几何和外观，并支持多种下游任务。

翻译: 从无姿态多视图图像重建连贯的3D几何和外观是计算机视觉中的一个基本但具有挑战性的问题。大多数现有的视觉几何基础模型通过回归像素对齐的点图来预测显式几何，往往存在冗余和几何连续性有限的问题。我们提出了IVGT，一种隐式视觉几何Transformer，用于从无姿态多视图图像中隐式建模连续且连贯的几何。这种形式在规范坐标系中学习连续的神经场景表示，并支持在任何3D位置进行连续的空间查询，检索局部特征以使用轻量级解码器预测有符号距离值和颜色。它允许直接提取连续且连贯的表面几何，从而能够从任意视角渲染RGB图像、深度图和表面法线图。我们通过多数据集联合优化结合2D监督和3D几何正则化来训练IVGT。IVGT在跨场景的泛化方面表现出色，并在各种任务中实现了强大的性能，包括网格和点云重建、新视角合成、深度和表面法线估计以及相机位姿估计。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Reconstructing coherent 3D geometry and appearance from unposed multi-view images is a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision. Most existing visual geometry foundation models predict explicit geometry by regressing pixel-aligned pointmaps, often suffering from redundancy and limited geometric continuity. We propose IVGT, an Implicit Visual Geometry Transformer that implicitly models continuous and coherent geometry from pose-free multi-view images. This formulation learns a continuous neural scene representation in a canonical coordinate system and supports continuous spatial queries at any 3D positions, retrieving local features to predict signed distance (SDF) values and colors using lightweight decoders. It allows direct extraction of continuous and coherent surface geometry, enabling rendering of RGB images, depth maps, and surface normal maps from arbitrary viewpoints. We train IVGT via multi-dataset joint optimization with 2D supervision and 3D geometric regularization. IVGT demonstrates generalization across scenes and achieves strong performance on various tasks, including mesh and point cloud reconstruction, novel view synthesis, depth and surface normal estimation, and camera pose estimation.

item.title: WildTableBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Foundation Models on Table Understanding In the Wild
item.author: Huang, Junzhe, Sun, Xiaoxiao, Yang, Yan, Hou, Yuxuan, Zhang, Ruotian, Li, Sirui, Fan, Hehe, Yeung-Levy, Serena, Yu, Xin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: WildTableBench是一个针对自然场景表格图像的问答基准测试，包含402张高信息密度表格图像和928个问题，评估了21个前沿多模态基础模型的表现。

背景: 利用多模态基础模型分析表格图像在消费和企业场景中具有重要价值但面临挑战，当前评估主要依赖结构化文本表格或干净的渲染图像，忽略了自然场景表格图像的视觉复杂性。

目的: 介绍WildTableBench，这是首个针对自然场景表格图像的问答基准测试，旨在填补当前评估方法的空白。

方法: WildTableBench包含402张从在线论坛和网站收集的高信息密度表格图像，以及928个跨五个类别和17个子类型的手动标注和验证问题。

主要发现: 在WildTableBench上评估了21个前沿专有和开源多模态基础模型，只有1个模型超过50%的准确率，其余模型准确率在4.1%到49.9%之间。

结论: 诊断分析揭示了模型在结构感知和推理方面的持续弱点，这些结果和分析为当前模型能力提供了有用见解，并将WildTableBench确立为表格图像理解的有价值诊断基准。

翻译: 利用多模态基础模型分析表格图像是消费和企业场景中高价值但具有挑战性的应用。尽管其重要性不言而喻，当前的评估主要依赖于结构化文本表格或干净的渲染图像，导致对自然场景表格图像的视觉复杂性探索不足。此类图像具有多样的布局和不同的领域，需要复杂的结构感知和数值推理。为了填补这一差距，我们介绍了WildTableBench，这是首个针对自然场景表格图像的问答基准测试。WildTableBench包含402张从在线论坛和网站跨不同领域收集的高信息密度表格图像，以及928个跨五个类别和17个子类型的手动标注和验证问题。我们在该基准上评估了21个前沿专有和开源多模态基础模型。只有1个模型超过50%的准确率，而其余模型的准确率在4.1%到49.9%之间。我们进一步进行了诊断分析，以表征模型失败情况并揭示结构感知和推理方面的持续弱点。这些结果和分析为当前模型能力提供了有用见解，并将WildTableBench确立为表格图像理解的有价值诊断基准。

Abstract

Using multimodal foundation models to analyze table images is a high-value yet challenging application in consumer and enterprise scenarios. Despite its importance, current evaluations rely largely on structured-text tables or clean rendered images, leaving the visual complexity of in-the-wild table images underexplored. Such images feature varied layouts and diverse domains that demand sophisticated structural perception and numerical reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce WildTableBench, the first question-answering benchmark for naturally occurring table images from real-world settings. WildTableBench comprises 402 high-information-density table images collected from online forums and websites across diverse domains, together with 928 manually annotated and verified questions spanning 17 subtypes across five categories. We evaluate 21 frontier proprietary and open-source multimodal foundation models on this benchmark. Only one model exceeds 50% accuracy, while all remaining models range from 4.1% to 49.9%. We further conduct diagnostic analyses to characterize model failures and reveal persistent weaknesses in structural perception and reasoning. These results and analyses provide useful insights into current model capabilities and establish WildTableBench as a valuable diagnostic benchmark for table image understanding.

item.title: Long Context Pre-Training with Lighthouse Attention
item.author: Peng, Bowen, Ghosh, Subho, Quesnelle, Jeffrey
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Lighthouse Attention 是一种训练时使用的对称选择式分层注意力算法，旨在解决因果 Transformer 在极端序列长度下训练受限的问题。

背景: 因果 Transformer 在极端序列长度下的训练受到缩放点积注意力（SDPA）二次方时间和内存消耗的限制。

目的: 提出 Lighthouse Attention 算法，以实现更高效的训练过程。

方法: Lighthouse Attention 是一种训练时使用的对称选择式分层注意力算法，它包裹在普通 SDPA 周围，并在训练后期可以轻松移除。其分层选择是无梯度的，避免了复杂的反向传播核。该方法包含三个部分：1. 次线性的分层预处理和后处理步骤，用于序列的自适应压缩和解压缩；2. 对称压缩策略，同时池化查询、键和值，同时保持从左到右的因果性，从而显著提高并行性；3. 两阶段训练方法，在大部分时间使用 Lighthouse Attention 进行预训练，并在最后阶段通过短时间训练恢复全注意力模型。

主要发现: 初步的小规模 LLM 预训练实验表明，与其他设置匹配的情况下相比，该方法实现了更快的总训练时间和更低的恢复阶段后的最终损失。

结论: Lighthouse Attention 方法在训练效率和模型性能上均表现出有效性。

翻译: 在极端序列长度下训练因果 Transformer 受到缩放点积注意力（SDPA）的二次方时间和内存限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了 Lighthouse Attention，这是一种训练时使用的对称选择式分层注意力算法，它包裹在普通 SDPA 周围，并在训练后期可以轻松移除。我们的分层选择也是无梯度的，这使我们免于处理复杂且可能效率低下的反向传播核。我们的贡献分为三个方面：（i）一个次线性的分层预-后处理步骤，用于序列的自适应压缩和解压缩。（ii）一个对称压缩策略，同时池化查询、键和值，同时保持从左到右的因果性，这大大提高了并行性。（iii）一种两阶段训练方法，我们在大部分时间使用 Lighthouse Attention 进行预训练，并在最后阶段通过短时间训练恢复全注意力模型。我们运行了初步的小规模 LLM 预训练实验，与其他设置匹配的情况下相比，我们实现了更快的总训练时间和更低的恢复阶段后的最终损失。完整代码可在该 https URL 获取。

Abstract

Training causal transformers at extreme sequence lengths is bottlenecked by the quadratic time and memory of scaled dot-product attention (SDPA). In this work, we propose Lighthouse Attention, a training-only symmetrical selection-based hierarchical attention algorithm that wraps around ordinary SDPA and can be easily removed towards the end of the training. Our hierarchical selection is also gradient-free, which exempts us from dealing with a complicated and potentially inefficient backward pass kernel. Our contribution is three-fold: (i) A subquadratic hierarchical pre- and post-processing step that does adaptive compression and decompression of the sequence. (ii) A symmetrical compression strategy that pools queries, keys and values at the same time, while preserving left-to-right causality, which greatly improves parallelism. (iii) A two stage training approach which we pre-train for the majority of the time with Lighthouse Attention and recover a full attention model at the end with a short training. We run preliminary small scale LLM pre-training experiments that show the effectiveness of our method compared to full attention training with all other settings matched, where we achieve a faster total training time and lower final loss after the recovery phase. Full code is available at: this https URL

item.title: Boosting Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Randomly Selected Few-Shot Guidance
item.author: Yan, Kai, Schwing, Alexander G., Wang, Yu-Xiong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FEST的算法，该算法通过使用少量演示样本，在强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）中实现了高效的样本利用。

背景: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）在利用思维链展开来开发大型语言模型方面取得了成功，但在解决正确展开难以生成的高难度问题时，样本效率低下。

目的: 为了解决RLVR在困难问题上样本效率低的问题，以及现有演示引导RLVR方法需要大量数据的问题，本文提出了一种仅需少量演示样本的算法。

方法: FEST是一种FEw-ShoT演示引导RLVR算法，它仅使用128个随机选择的演示样本。其成功依赖于三个关键组件：监督信号、在线策略信号，以及在少量演示SFT数据集上衰减权重以防止多轮训练过拟合。

主要发现: FEST算法在多个基准测试中表现优于基线方法，即使使用的数据量远少于基线方法，其性能也能与使用完整数据集的基线方法相匹配。

结论: FEST算法证明了仅使用少量演示样本即可在RLVR任务中取得优异性能，且三个关键组件（监督信号、在线策略信号和衰减权重）对于算法的成功至关重要。

翻译: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）在利用思维链展开来开发大型语言模型方面在数学和编程等许多任务上取得了巨大成功。然而，RLVR在正确展开难以生成的高难度问题上样本效率低下。先前的工作提出通过演示引导的RLVR来解决这个问题，即在RL失败时进行监督微调（SFT）；然而，SFT通常需要大量数据，获取这些数据可能很昂贵。在本文中，我们提出了FEST，一种FEw-ShoT演示引导RLVR算法。它仅使用从SFT数据集中随机选择的128个演示就取得了令人满意的结果。我们发现三个组件对于成功至关重要：监督信号、在线策略信号，以及在少量演示SFT数据集上衰减权重以防止多轮训练过拟合。在多个基准测试中，FEST的性能优于使用较少SFT数据的基线方法，甚至匹配了使用完整数据集的性能。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决强化学习中奖励难以验证的问题，通过随机选择的少样本指导来增强学习效果。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为它能提高强化学习系统的效率和可靠性，使学习过程更加准确和可控。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种利用随机选择的少样本指导来增强具有可验证奖励的强化学习性能的方法。

Abstract

Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has achieved great success in developing Large Language Models (LLMs) with chain-of-thought rollouts for many tasks such as math and coding. Nevertheless, RLVR struggles with sample efficiency on difficult problems where correct rollouts are hard to generate. Prior works propose to address this issue via demonstration-guided RLVR, i.e., to conduct Supervised FineTuning (SFT) when RL fails; however, SFT often requires a lot of data, which can be expensive to acquire. In this paper, we propose FEST, a FEw-ShoT demonstration-guided RLVR algorithm. It attains compelling results with only 128 demonstrations randomly selected from an SFT dataset. We find that three components are vital for the success: supervised signal, on-policy signal, and decaying weights on the few-shot SFT dataset to prevent overfitting from multiple-epoch training. On several benchmarks, FEST outperforms baselines with magnitudes less SFT data, even matching their performance with full dataset.

item.title: Aligning Latent Geometry for Spherical Flow Matching in Image Generation
item.author: Meral, Tuna Han Salih, Oktay, Kaan, Yesiltepe, Hidir, Akan, Adil Kaan, Yanardag, Pinar
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于潜在流匹配的图像生成方法，通过将潜在变量投影到固定半径的球面上，并使用球面线性插值替代线性插值，从而在保持扩散架构不变的情况下，显著提高了ImageNet-256的FID分数。

背景: 现有的潜在流匹配方法通常沿着线性路径将高斯噪声传输到变分自编码器的潜在空间，但两个端点都集中在薄的球壳中，即使经过预处理对齐半径，欧几里得弦也会离开这些球壳。

目的: 为了解决现有方法中潜在变量集中在球壳且欧几里得路径会离开球壳的问题，研究旨在通过分解潜在标记的径向和角度分量，发现感知和语义内容主要由方向携带，从而提出一种新的生成方法。

方法: 研究将数据潜在变量投影到固定标记半径上，使用高斯噪声的径向投影作为球面先验，冻结编码器并微调解码器，并用球面线性插值替代线性插值。

主要发现: 通过组件交换探测发现，解码后的感知和语义内容主要由方向携带，半径贡献较小；在匹配训练下，该方法在不同图像标记器上一致改善了类条件ImageNet-256的FID。

结论: 该方法在保持扩散架构不变、不需要辅助编码器或表示对齐目标的情况下，通过球面路径和纯角度速度目标，显著提升了图像生成的质量。

翻译: Latent flow matching for image generation usually transports Gaussian noise to variational autoencoder latents along linear paths. Both endpoints, however, concentrate in thin spherical shells, and a Euclidean chord leaves those shells even when preprocessing aligns their radii. By decomposing each latent token into radial and angular components, we show through component-swap probes that decoded perceptual and semantic content is carried predominantly by direction, with radius contributing much less. We therefore project data latents onto a fixed token radius, use the radial projection of Gaussian noise as the spherical prior, finetune the decoder with the encoder frozen, and replace linear interpolation with spherical linear interpolation. The resulting geodesic paths stay on the sphere at every timestep, and their velocity targets are purely angular by construction. Under matched training, the method consistently improves class-conditional ImageNet-256 FID across different image tokenizers, leaves the diffusion architecture unchanged, and requires no auxiliary encoder or representation-alignment objective.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决图像生成中球形流匹配的潜在几何对齐问题。文中未明确说明该问题的重要性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种对齐潜在几何以实现球形流匹配的图像生成方法。

Abstract

Latent flow matching for image generation usually transports Gaussian noise to variational autoencoder latents along linear paths. Both endpoints, however, concentrate in thin spherical shells, and a Euclidean chord leaves those shells even when preprocessing aligns their radii. By decomposing each latent token into radial and angular components, we show through component-swap probes that decoded perceptual and semantic content is carried predominantly by direction, with radius contributing much less. We therefore project data latents onto a fixed token radius, use the radial projection of Gaussian noise as the spherical prior, finetune the decoder with the encoder frozen, and replace linear interpolation with spherical linear interpolation. The resulting geodesic paths stay on the sphere at every timestep, and their velocity targets are purely angular by construction. Under matched training, the method consistently improves class-conditional ImageNet-256 FID across different image tokenizers, leaves the diffusion architecture unchanged, and requires no auxiliary encoder or representation-alignment objective.

item.title: PAGE-4D: VGGT-4D Perception via Disentangled Pose and Geometry Estimation
item.author: Kaichen Zhou, Yuhan Wang, Grace Chen, Xinhai Chang, Gaspard Beaudouin, Fangneng Zhan, Paul Pu Liang, Mengyu Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为PAGE-4D的模型，该模型能够处理动态场景，实现相机位姿估计、深度预测和点云重建，无需后处理。

背景: 现有的3D前馈模型如VGGT在静态数据集上训练，难以处理包含移动人类或雨伞等可变形物体的复杂动态现实场景。

目的: 为了解决现有模型在动态场景中的局限性，将VGGT扩展到动态场景，实现相机位姿估计、深度预测和点云重建。

方法: 提出了一种动态感知聚合器，通过预测动态感知掩码来解耦静态和动态信息，在位姿估计中抑制运动线索，在几何重建中放大它们。

主要发现: PAGE-4D在动态场景中始终优于原始VGGT，在相机位姿估计、单目和视频深度估计以及密集点图重建方面取得了更好的结果。

结论: PAGE-4D成功解决了多任务4D重建中任务间的固有冲突，实现了无需后处理的动态场景重建。

翻译: Recent 3D feed-forward models, such as the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), have shown strong capability in inferring 3D attributes of static scenes. However, since they are typically trained on static datasets, these models often struggle in real-world scenarios involving complex dynamic elements, such as moving humans or deformable objects like umbrellas. To address this limitation, we introduce PAGE-4D, a feedforward model that extends VGGT to dynamic scenes, enabling camera pose estimation, depth prediction and point cloud reconstruction - all without post-processing. A central challenge in multitask 4D reconstruction is the inherent conflict between tasks: accurate camera pose estimation requires suppressing dynamic regions, while geometry reconstruction requires modeling them. To resolve this tension, we propose a dynamics aware aggregator that disentangles static and dynamic information by predicting a dynamics-aware mask - suppressing motion cues for pose estimation while amplifying them for geometry reconstruction. Extensive experiments show that PAGE-4D consistently outperforms the original VGGT in dynamic scenarios, achieving superior results in camera pose estimation, monocular and video depth estimation, and dense point map reconstruction. Necessary code and additional demos are available at Link: https://page4d.github.io/. Keywords: VGGT-4D, 4D Perception, Dynamic Scene Reconstruction.

Abstract

Recent 3D feed-forward models, such as the Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), have shown strong capability in inferring 3D attributes of static scenes. However, since they are typically trained on static datasets, these models often struggle in real-world scenarios involving complex dynamic elements, such as moving humans or deformable objects like umbrellas. To address this limitation, we introduce PAGE-4D, a feedforward model that extends VGGT to dynamic scenes, enabling camera pose estimation, depth prediction and point cloud reconstruction - all without post-processing. A central challenge in multitask 4D reconstruction is the inherent conflict between tasks: accurate camera pose estimation requires suppressing dynamic regions, while geometry reconstruction requires modeling them. To resolve this tension, we propose a dynamics aware aggregator that disentangles static and dynamic information by predicting a dynamics-aware mask - suppressing motion cues for pose estimation while amplifying them for geometry reconstruction. Extensive experiments show that PAGE-4D consistently outperforms the original VGGT in dynamic scenarios, achieving superior results in camera pose estimation, monocular and video depth estimation, and dense point map reconstruction. Necessary code and additional demos are available at Link: https://page4d.github.io/. Keywords: VGGT-4D, 4D Perception, Dynamic Scene Reconstruction.

item.title: RouteProfile: Elucidating the Design Space of LLM Profiles for Routing
item.author: Xu, Jingjun, Pu, Hongji, Feng, Tao, Zhang, Haozhen, You, Jiaxuan, Liu, Ge
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了大型语言模型路由中模型配置文件设计的影响，提出了一种名为RouteProfile的通用设计空间，并评估了不同配置文件设计对路由性能的影响。

背景: 随着大型语言模型生态系统的扩展，不同模型在不同查询、基准和领域表现出不同的能力，这促使了LLM路由的发展。

目的: 研究LLM配置文件设计如何影响不同路由器的路由性能，以阐明配置文件在路由中的作用，将配置文件设计与路由器设计解耦，并实现路由系统的更公平比较和更原则性的发展。

方法: 将LLM配置文件视为异构交互历史的结构化信息集成问题，开发了名为RouteProfile的通用LLM配置文件设计空间，包含组织形式、表示类型、聚合深度和学习配置四个关键维度。

主要发现: 1. 结构化配置文件始终优于扁平配置文件；2. 查询级信号比粗粒度的领域级信号更可靠；3. 在可训练配置下，结构化配置文件对新引入模型的泛化能力提升最大。

结论: 该工作强调了LLM配置文件设计是未来路由研究的一个重要方向。

翻译: 随着大型语言模型生态系统的扩展，单个模型在不同查询、基准和领域表现出不同的能力，这促使了LLM路由的发展。虽然先前的工作主要集中在路由机制设计上，但LLM配置文件（捕捉模型能力）仍然未被充分探索。在这项工作中，我们提出：LLM配置文件设计如何影响不同路由器的路由性能？回答这个问题有助于阐明配置文件在路由中的作用，将配置文件设计与路由器设计解耦，并实现路由系统的更公平比较和更原则性的发展。为此，我们将LLM配置文件视为异构交互历史的结构化信息集成问题。我们开发了一个通用的LLM配置文件设计空间，名为RouteProfile，包含四个关键维度：组织形式、表示类型、聚合深度和学习配置。通过在标准和新LLM泛化设置下对三个代表性路由器进行系统评估，我们表明：1. 结构化配置文件始终优于扁平配置文件；2. 查询级信号比粗粒度的领域级信号更可靠；3. 在可训练配置下，结构化配置文件对新引入模型的泛化能力提升最大。总的来说，我们的工作强调了LLM配置文件设计是未来路由研究的一个重要方向。

Abstract

As the large language model (LLM) ecosystem expands, individual models exhibit varying capabilities across queries, benchmarks, and domains, motivating the development of LLM routing. While prior work has largely focused on router mechanism design, LLM profiles, which capture model capabilities, remain underexplored. In this work, we ask: How does LLM profile design affect routing performance across different routers? Addressing this question helps clarify the role of profiles in routing, disentangle profile design from router design, and enable fairer comparison and more principled development of routing systems. To this end, we view LLM profiling as a structured information integration problem over heterogeneous interaction histories. We develop a general design space of LLM profiles, named RouteProfile, along four key dimensions: organizational form, representation type, aggregation depth, and learning configuration. Through systematic evaluation across three representative routers under both standard and new-LLM generalization settings, we show that: (1) structured profiles consistently outperform flat ones; (2) query-level signals are more reliable than coarse domain-level signals; and (3) generalization to newly introduced models benefits most from structured profiles under trainable configurations. Overall, our work highlights LLM profile design as an important direction for future routing research.

item.title: STALE: Can LLM Agents Know When Their Memories Are No Longer Valid?
item.author: Chao, Hanxiang, Bai, Yihan, Sheng, Rui, Li, Tianle, Sun, Yushi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究提出了一个名为STALE的新基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型代理在处理隐含冲突时的能力，即当新证据出现时更新存储信念的能力。

背景: 当前的大型语言模型代理基准测试主要关注静态事实检索，忽视了当新证据出现时更新存储信念的能力。

目的: 为了评估大型语言模型代理在处理隐含冲突时的能力，即当新证据出现时更新存储信念的能力。

方法: 提出了STALE基准测试，包含400个专家验证的冲突场景，跨越100多个日常话题，并提出了一个三维探测框架，测试状态解决、前提抵抗和隐含策略适应。

主要发现: 前沿LLM和专用记忆框架在检索更新证据和采取行动之间存在普遍差距，即使最好的模型也仅达到55.2%的总体准确率。模型经常接受用户查询中嵌入的过时假设，并且难以识别用户状态的一个方面发生变化时应如何使相关记忆无效。

结论: 提出了CUPMem原型，通过结构化状态巩固和传播感知搜索加强写入时修订，表明显式状态裁决是构建稳健代理记忆的有希望的方向。

翻译: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地被期望保持连贯、长期的个性化记忆，然而当前的基准测试主要衡量静态事实检索，忽视了当新证据出现时更新存储信念的能力。我们确定了一个关键且未被充分探索的失败模式，即隐含冲突：即后来的观察结果在没有明确否定的情况下使早期记忆无效，需要上下文推断和常识推理来检测。为了严格评估这种能力，我们介绍了STALE，这是一个包含400个专家验证的冲突场景的基准测试（跨越三个探测维度的1200个评估查询），涵盖超过100个日常话题，上下文长达150K个令牌。我们提出了一个三维探测框架，测试状态解决（检测先前的信念已过时）、前提抵抗（拒绝错误预设过时状态的查询）和隐含策略适应（在下游行为中主动应用更新状态）。对前沿LLM和专用记忆框架的系统评估揭示了检索更新证据和采取行动之间存在普遍差距，即使最好的评估模型也仅达到55.2%的总体准确率。模型经常接受用户查询中嵌入的过时假设，并且难以识别用户状态的一个方面发生变化时应如何使相关记忆无效。为了建立状态感知记忆的初始基线，我们进一步提出了CUPMem，这是一个原型，通过结构化状态巩固和传播感知搜索加强写入时修订，表明显式状态裁决是构建稳健代理记忆的有希望的方向。

Abstract

Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to maintain coherent, long-term personalized memory, yet current benchmarks primarily measure static fact retrieval, overlooking the ability to revise stored beliefs when new evidence emerges. We identify a critical and underexplored failure mode, Implicit Conflict: a later observation invalidates an earlier memory without explicit negation, requiring contextual inference and commonsense reasoning to detect. To rigorously evaluate this capability, we introduce STALE, a benchmark of 400 expert-validated conflict scenarios (1,200 evaluation queries across three probing dimensions) spanning over 100 everyday topics with contexts up to 150K tokens. We propose a three-dimensional probing framework that tests State Resolution (detecting that a prior belief is outdated), Premise Resistance (rejecting queries that falsely presuppose a stale state), and Implicit Policy Adaptation (proactively applying updated states in downstream behavior). A systematic evaluation of frontier LLMs and specialized memory frameworks reveals a pervasive gap between retrieving updated evidence and acting on it, with even the best evaluated model achieving only 55.2% overall accuracy. Models often accept outdated assumptions embedded in a user's query, and they struggle to recognize when a change in one aspect of the user's state should invalidate related memories. To establish an initial baseline for state-aware memory, we further present CUPMem, a prototype that strengthens write-time revision through structured state consolidation and propagation-aware search, suggesting that explicit state adjudication is a promising direction for robust agentic memory.

item.title: Learning to Communicate Locally for Large-Scale Multi-Agent Pathfinding
item.author: Vyaltsev, Valeriy, Sagirova, Alsu, Andreychuk, Anton, Bulichev, Oleg, Kuratov, Yuri, Yakovlev, Konstantin, Panov, Aleksandr, Skrynnik, Alexey
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为LC-MAPF的通用预训练模型，通过多轮通信机制增强智能体间的协作，在多种测试场景中优于现有的基于学习和模仿的方法，且不牺牲可扩展性。

背景: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）是物流和搜救等现实世界应用中的关键问题，虽然最优求解是NP难的，但需要可扩展和高效的求解器。

目的: 研究社区提出了各种去中心化的次优MAPF求解器，利用机器学习。本文遵循相同方法，但引入了可学习的通信模块以通过高效的特征共享增强智能体间的协作。

方法: 提出了Local Communication for Multi-agent Pathfinding (LC-MAPF)，一种通用预训练模型，应用多轮通信在相邻智能体间交换信息以改善协调。

主要发现: 引入的方法在多种指标上优于现有的基于学习和模仿的MAPF求解器，且引入的通信机制没有损害LC-MAPF的可扩展性。

结论: LC-MAPF通过多轮通信机制有效提升了智能体间的协作能力，且保持了良好的可扩展性。

翻译: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）是用于多机器人轨迹规划问题的广泛使用的抽象，其中多个同质智能体在共享环境中同时移动。虽然最优求解MAPF是NP难的，但可扩展和高效的求解器对于物流和搜救等现实世界应用至关重要。为此，研究社区提出了各种利用机器学习的去中心化次优MAPF求解器。这些方法将MAPF（从单个智能体视角）框架化为一个Dec-POMDP，其中在每个时间步，智能体必须基于局部观察决定一个动作，通常通过强化学习或模仿学习来解决问题。我们遵循相同的方法，但额外引入了一个可学习的通信模块，以通过高效的特征共享增强智能体间的协作。我们提出了Local Communication for Multi-agent Pathfinding (LC-MAPF)，一种通用预训练模型，应用多轮通信在相邻智能体间交换信息以改善它们的协调。我们的实验表明，引入的方法在多种指标上优于现有的基于学习的MAPF求解器，包括基于IL和RL的方法，在多种（未见）测试场景中。值得注意的是，引入的通信机制没有损害LC-MAPF的可扩展性，这是基于通信的MAPF求解器的常见瓶颈。

Abstract

Multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF) is a widely used abstraction for multi-robot trajectory planning problems, where multiple homogeneous agents move simultaneously within a shared environment. Although solving MAPF optimally is NP-hard, scalable and efficient solvers are critical for real-world applications such as logistics and search-and-rescue. To this end, the research community has proposed various decentralized suboptimal MAPF solvers that leverage machine learning. Such methods frame MAPF (from a single agent perspective) as a Dec-POMDP where at each time step an agent has to decide an action based on the local observation and typically solve the problem via reinforcement learning or imitation learning. We follow the same approach but additionally introduce a learnable communication module tailored to enhance cooperation between agents via efficient feature sharing. We present the Local Communication for Multi-agent Pathfinding (LC-MAPF), a generalizable pre-trained model that applies multi-round communication between neighboring agents to exchange information and improve their coordination. Our experiments show that the introduced method outperforms the existing learning-based MAPF solvers, including IL and RL-based approaches, across diverse metrics in a diverse range of (unseen) test scenarios. Remarkably, the introduced communication mechanism does not compromise LC-MAPF's scalability, a common bottleneck for communication-based MAPF solvers.

item.title: RewardHarness: Self-Evolving Agentic Post-Training
item.author: Zhang, Yuxuan, Du, Penghui, Li, Bo, Wei, Cong, Miao, Junwen, Zhang, Huaisong, Cai, Songcheng, Wang, Yubo, Jiang, Dongfu, Zhang, Yuyu, Nie, Ping, Chen, Wenhu, Yu, Changqian, Allen, Kelsey R.
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为RewardHarness的自进化奖励框架，旨在解决当前奖励模型依赖大规模标注和额外训练的问题，通过迭代进化工具和技能库来对齐人类偏好。

背景: 评估指令引导的图像编辑需要反映人类偏好的奖励，但现有奖励模型通常依赖大规模偏好标注和额外模型训练，导致数据效率低下。

目的: 提出RewardHarness框架，通过迭代进化工具和技能库，从少量偏好演示中学习，以对齐人类偏好。

方法: RewardHarness将奖励建模重构为上下文进化而非权重优化。Orchestrator从维护的库中选择相关工具和技能，Sub-Agent构建推理链产生偏好判断，通过比较预测与真实偏好及分析推理过程，Orchestrator自动细化工具和技能库。

主要发现: 使用仅0.05%的EditReward偏好数据，RewardHarness在图像编辑评估基准上达到47.4%的平均准确率，超过GPT-5 5.3个百分点。当用作GRPO微调的奖励信号时，RL微调模型在ImgEdit-Bench上达到3.52。

结论: RewardHarness在数据效率上表现出色，仅用少量数据即可实现高准确率，并能有效提升模型在图像编辑任务上的表现。

翻译: 评估指令引导的图像编辑需要反映人类偏好的奖励，但当前奖励模型通常依赖大规模偏好标注和额外模型训练。这造成了数据效率差距：人类通常可以从仅几个例子中推断出目标评估标准，而模型通常在数十万次比较上进行训练。我们提出了RewardHarness，这是一个自进化代理奖励框架，将奖励建模重构为上下文进化而非权重优化。RewardHarness不从大规模标注中学习，而是通过迭代进化工具和技能库，从仅100个偏好演示中与人类偏好对齐。给定源图像、候选编辑图像和编辑指令，Orchestrator从维护的库中选择最相关的工具和技能子集，冻结的Sub-Agent使用它们构建推理链以产生偏好判断。通过将预测判断与真实偏好进行比较并分析推理过程中的成功和失败，Orchestrator自动细化其工具和技能库，无需额外的人工标注。仅使用0.05%的EditReward偏好数据，RewardHarness在图像编辑评估基准上达到47.4%的平均准确率，超过GPT-5 5.3个百分点。当用作GRPO微调的奖励信号时，RL微调模型在ImgEdit-Bench上达到3.52。项目页面：this https URL 。

Abstract

Evaluating instruction-guided image edits requires rewards that reflect subtle human preferences, yet current reward models typically depend on large-scale preference annotation and additional model training. This creates a data-efficiency gap: humans can often infer the target evaluation criteria from only a few examples, while models are usually trained on hundreds of thousands of comparisons. We present RewardHarness, a self-evolving agentic reward framework that reframes reward modeling as context evolution rather than weight optimization. Instead of learning from large-scale annotations, RewardHarness aligns with human preferences by iteratively evolving a library of tools and skills from as few as 100 preference demonstrations. Given a source image, candidate edited images, and an editing instruction, an Orchestrator selects the most relevant subset of tools and skills from the maintained library, and a frozen Sub-Agent uses them to construct a reasoning chain that produces a preference judgment. By comparing predicted judgments with ground-truth preferences and analyzing successes and failures in the reasoning process, the Orchestrator automatically refines its library of tools and skills without additional human annotation. Using only 0.05% of the EditReward preference data, RewardHarness achieves 47.4% average accuracy on image-editing evaluation benchmarks, surpassing GPT-5 by 5.3 points. When used as a reward signal for GRPO fine-tuning, RL-tuned models achieve 3.52 on ImgEdit-Bench. Project page: this https URL .

item.title: Forcing-KV: Hybrid KV Cache Compression for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models
item.author: Ji, Yicheng, Zhong, Zhizhou, Zhang, Jun, Yang, Qin, Jin, XiTai, Qin, Ying, Luo, Wenhan, Mao, Shuiyang, Liu, Wei, Li, Huan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种针对自回归视频扩散模型的KV缓存压缩方法，通过将注意力头分为静态和动态两类，实现了在保持输出质量的同时显著提升生成速度和降低内存占用。

背景: 现有的自回归视频扩散模型在处理长视频生成时面临注意力复杂度和内存开销过大的问题，主要源于历史帧中冗余的键值缓存。

目的: 解决自回归视频扩散模型中因冗余键值缓存导致的注意力复杂度和严重内存开销问题，以提升模型的可扩展性。

方法: 提出了一种名为Forcing-KV的混合KV缓存压缩策略，将注意力头分为静态头和动态头，分别采用结构化静态剪枝和基于段间相似度的动态剪枝。

主要发现: 主流自回归扩散模型中的注意力头表现出显著不同的注意力模式和功能角色，且这些角色在样本和去噪步骤中保持稳定。

结论: 该方法在保持输出质量的同时，实现了每秒超过29帧的生成速度，缓存内存减少30%，在480P分辨率下相比LongLive和Self Forcing分别实现了1.35倍和1.50倍的速度提升，在1080P分辨率下实现了2.82倍的速度提升。

翻译: 自回归视频扩散模型采用流式生成框架，能够实现具有实时响应能力的长时视频生成，如自强制训练范式所示。然而，现有的自回归视频扩散模型由于历史帧中冗余的键值缓存，仍面临显著的注意力复杂度和严重的内存开销，这限制了其可扩展性。在本文中，我们通过将KV缓存压缩引入自回归视频扩散模型来应对这一挑战。我们观察到主流自回归扩散模型中的注意力头表现出显著不同的注意力模式和功能角色，且这些角色在样本和去噪步骤中保持稳定。基于对头级功能专业化的实证研究，我们将注意力头分为两类：静态头，专注于自回归块之间的转换和帧内保真度；以及动态头，控制帧间运动和一致性。然后，我们提出了Forcing-KV，一种混合KV缓存压缩策略，对静态头执行结构化静态剪枝，并对动态头基于段间相似度执行动态剪枝。在保持输出质量的同时，我们的方法在单个NVIDIA H200 GPU上实现了每秒超过29帧的生成速度，同时缓存内存减少30%，在480P分辨率下为LongLive和Self Forcing带来高达1.35倍和1.50倍的速度提升，并进一步扩展到1080P分辨率下的2.82倍速度提升。代码和演示视频可在该https URL提供。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决自动回归视频扩散模型中缓存占用过高的问题。由于这类模型计算量大，通过混合压缩缓存可以降低内存消耗，从而提高生成效率。
