如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models adopt a streaming generation framework, enabling long-horizon video generation with real-time responsiveness, as exemplified by the Self Forcing training paradigm. However, existing AR video diffusion models still suffer from significant attention complexity and severe memory overhead due to the redundant key-value (KV) caches across historical frames, which limits scalability. In this paper, we tackle this challenge by introducing KV cache compression into autoregressive video diffusion. We observe that attention heads in mainstream AR diffusion models exhibit markedly distinct attention patterns and functional roles that remain stable across samples and denoising steps. Building on our empirical study of head-wise functional specialization, we divide the attention heads into two categories: static heads, which focus on transitions across autoregressive chunks and intra-frame fidelity, and dynamic heads, which govern inter-frame motion and consistency. We then propose Forcing-KV, a hybrid KV cache compression strategy that performs structured static pruning for static heads and dynamic pruning based on segment-wise similarity for dynamic heads. While maintaining output quality, our method achieves a generation speed of over 29 frames per second on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU along with 30% cache memory reduction, delivering up to 1.35x and 1.50x speedups on LongLive and Self Forcing at 480P resolution, and further scaling to 2.82x speedup at 1080P resolution. Code and demo videos are provided at this https URL .

item.title: WildClawBench: A Benchmark for Real-World, Long-Horizon Agent Evaluation
item.author: Ding, Shuangrui, Dai, Xuanlang, Xing, Long, Ding, Shengyuan, Liu, Ziyu, JingYi, Yang, Yang, Penghui, Zhang, Zhixiong, Wei, Xilin, Fang, Xinyu, Ma, Yubo, Duan, Haodong, Shao, Jing, Wang, Jiaqi, Lin, Dahua, Chen, Kai, Zang, Yuhang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: WildClawBench是一个包含60个人类编写的双语多模态任务的基准测试，旨在评估大语言模型在真实运行环境中的长周期工作能力。

背景: 现有的代理基准测试大多依赖于合成沙箱、短周期任务、模拟服务API和最终答案检查，无法验证代理在部署环境中完成现实长周期工作的能力。

目的: 提出WildClawBench基准测试，以评估前沿模型在真实运行环境中的长周期、原生运行时代理评估能力。

方法: WildClawBench包含60个人类编写的双语多模态任务，平均耗时约8分钟，涉及超过20个工具调用。任务在可重现的Docker容器中运行，使用真实的CLI代理工具（OpenClaw、Claude Code、Codex或Hermes Agent）。评分采用混合方法，结合确定性规则检查、环境状态审计和LLM/VLM法官进行语义验证。

主要发现: 在19个前沿模型中，最佳模型Claude Opus 4.7在OpenClaw上仅达到62.2%的总体得分，其他所有模型均低于60%。仅切换代理工具即可使单个模型的得分变化高达18分。

结论: 对于当前的前沿模型而言，长周期、原生运行时的代理评估仍然是一个远未解决的问题。

翻译: Large language and vision-language models increasingly power agents that act on a user's behalf through command-line interface (CLI) harnesses. However, most agent benchmarks still rely on synthetic sandboxes, short-horizon tasks, mock-service APIs, and final-answer checks, leaving open whether agents can complete realistic long-horizon work in the runtimes where they are deployed. This work presents WildClawBench, a native-runtime benchmark of 60 human-authored, bilingual, multimodal tasks spanning six thematic categories. Each task averages roughly 8 minutes of wall-clock time and over 20 tool calls, and runs inside a reproducible Docker container hosting an actual CLI agent harness (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, or Hermes Agent) with access to real tools rather than mock services. Grading is hybrid, combining deterministic rule-based checks, environment-state auditing of side effects, and an LLM/VLM judge for semantic verification. Across 19 frontier models, the best, Claude Opus 4.7, reaches only 62.2% overall under OpenClaw, while every other model stays below 60%, and switching harness alone shifts a single model by up to 18 points. These results show that long-horizon, native-runtime agent evaluation remains a far-from-resolved task for current frontier models. We release the tasks, code, and containerized tooling to support reproducible evaluation.

Abstract

Large language and vision-language models increasingly power agents that act on a user's behalf through command-line interface (CLI) harnesses. However, most agent benchmarks still rely on synthetic sandboxes, short-horizon tasks, mock-service APIs, and final-answer checks, leaving open whether agents can complete realistic long-horizon work in the runtimes where they are deployed. This work presents WildClawBench, a native-runtime benchmark of 60 human-authored, bilingual, multimodal tasks spanning six thematic categories. These results show that long-horizon, native-runtime agent evaluation remains a far-from-resolved task for current frontier models. We release the tasks, code, and containerized tooling to support reproducible evaluation.

item.title: Adaptive Teacher Exposure for Self-Distillation in LLM Reasoning
item.author: Han, Zihao, Zhang, Tiangang, Wang, Huaibin, Sun, Yilun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为ATESD的自蒸馏方法，通过可学习的教师暴露控制变量来优化大语言模型推理过程。

背景: On-policy自蒸馏是LLM推理的强有力方法，但教师总是看到完整的参考推理，这导致了教师侧暴露不匹配的问题。

目的: 解决教师总是看到完整参考推理导致的暴露不匹配问题，将教师暴露视为可学习的训练时控制变量而非固定超参数。

方法: ATESD使用轻量级Beta策略控制器建模揭示比例，基于紧凑的训练状态统计信息进行条件化，并使用折扣学习进度奖励优化控制器。

主要发现: 在AIME 24、AIME 25和HMMT 25数据集上，ATESD在Qwen3-{1.7B, 4B, 8B}模型上持续优于竞争性自蒸馏和RL基线，分别比OPSD提升+0.95、+2.05和+2.33 Average@12点。

结论: 自适应教师暴露是推理自蒸馏的有效新维度，ATESD在多个基准测试中表现出色。

翻译: On-policy自蒸馏已成为LLM推理的强大配方，其中特权教师监督学生自己的rollouts，同时参考解进行条件化。然而，几乎所有此类方法都有一个未被质疑的设计选择：教师总是看到完整的参考推理。我们认为这个默认本身就是问题的一部分，并识别了教师侧暴露不匹配：当教师参考学生当前能力之外的推理进行条件化时，产生的token目标变得太强而无法吸收。受控的固定暴露扫描在两个方向上使这一点具体化：1）完整暴露并非可靠的最佳选择，2）学生-教师不匹配随着教师看到更多特权推理而单调增长。这促使我们将教师暴露视为可学习的训练时控制变量，而非固定超参数。因此，我们提出了自适应教师暴露自蒸馏（ATESD）。ATESD使用轻量级Beta策略控制器建模揭示比例，该控制器基于紧凑的训练状态统计信息进行条件化，并使用一个采样的暴露进行学生更新的短保持窗口。为了使暴露控制器可学习，我们使用折扣学习进度奖励对其进行优化，该奖励根据每个保持决策对学生未来改进的影响而非其即时损失变化来评分，解决了由on-policy蒸馏引起的延迟信用分配问题。在AIME 24、AIME 25和HMMT 25上对Qwen3-{1.7B, 4B, 8B}进行的实验表明，ATESD持续优于竞争性自蒸馏和RL基线，分别比OPSD提升+0.95、+2.05和+2.33 Average@12点，并将自适应教师暴露确立为推理自蒸馏的有效新维度。

深度解读

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

On-policy self-distillation has become a strong recipe for LLM reasoning, where a privileged teacher supervises the student's own rollouts while conditioning on the reference solution. A design choice shared by nearly all such methods, however, has gone unquestioned: the teacher always sees the full reference reasoning. We argue that this default itself is part of the problem and identify a teacher-side exposure mismatch: when the teacher conditions on reasoning far beyond the student's current competence, the resulting token targets become too strong to absorb. A controlled fixed-exposure sweep makes this concrete on two fronts: 1) full exposure is not reliably the best choice, and 2) student-teacher mismatch grows monotonically as the teacher sees more privileged reasoning. This motivates treating teacher exposure not as a fixed hyperparameter but as a learnable training-time control variable. We therefore propose Adaptive Teacher Exposure for Self-Distillation (ATESD). ATESD models the reveal ratio with a lightweight Beta-policy controller conditioned on compact training-state statistics, and uses one sampled exposure for a short hold window of student updates. To make this exposure controller learnable, we optimize it with a discounted learning-progress reward that scores each held decision by its effect on the student's future improvement rather than its immediate loss change, addressing the delayed credit assignment induced by on-policy distillation. Experiments on AIME 24, AIME 25, and HMMT 25 across Qwen3-{1.7B, 4B, 8B} show that ATESD consistently outperforms competitive self-distillation and RL baselines, improving over OPSD by +0.95, +2.05, and +2.33 Average@12 points respectively, and establishing adaptive teacher exposure as an effective new axis for reasoning self-distillation.

item.title: Overcoming Dynamics-Blindness: Training-Free Pace-and-Path Correction for VLA Models
item.author: Zhang, Yanyan, Song, Chaoda, Singh, Vikash, Li, Xinpeng, Ye, Kai, Hu, Zhe, Pu, Zhongzhu, Yin, Yu, Chaudhary, Vipin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Pace-and-Path Correction 的训练无关推理时算子，用于包裹任何分块动作 VLA 模型，以解决其在非平稳场景下的性能下降问题。

背景: 现有的 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型大多基于单帧观察范式训练，导致它们在结构上对时间动态缺乏感知，在非平稳场景下表现严重退化，即使使用动态数据集训练或微调也是如此。

目的: 提出一种训练无关的、闭式推理时算子，以解决现有 VLA 模型在非平稳场景下性能下降的问题，避免昂贵的重新训练或延迟瓶颈及动作块间时间一致性问题。

方法: Pace-and-Path Correction 算子通过单次二次成本联合最小化，分解为两个正交通道：pace 通道沿规划方向压缩执行，path 通道应用正交空间偏移，共同吸收感知到的动态。

主要发现: 在 MoveBench 诊断基准测试中，该方法在动态环境和静态-动态混合环境中，分别比基础 VLA 模型提高了 28.8% 和 25.9% 的成功率，且始终优于现有的训练无关包装器和动态自适应方法。

结论: Pace-and-Path Correction 框架能有效提升 VLA 模型在动态环境中的表现，显著改善成功率，证明了其在处理时间动态方面的有效性。

翻译: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型在超越经典控制范式方面取得了显著灵活性和泛化能力。然而，大多数现有的 VLA 模型是在单帧观察范式下训练的，这使它们在结构上对时间动态视而不见。因此，这些模型在非平稳场景下严重退化，即使是在动态数据集上训练或微调也是如此。现有的方法要么需要昂贵的重新训练，要么 suffer from 延迟瓶颈和动作块间的时间一致性问题。我们提出了 Pace-and-Path Correction，一种训练无关的、闭式推理时算子，可以包裹任何分块动作 VLA。从单次二次成本开始，联合最小化产生一个统一解，该解正交分解为两个不同的通道。pace 通道沿规划方向压缩执行，而 path 通道应用正交空间偏移，共同吸收感知到的动态。我们在一个全面的诊断基准测试 MoveBench 上评估了我们的方法，该基准测试旨在将运动作为唯一的受控变量。实证结果表明，我们的框架始终优于最先进的训练无关包装器和动态自适应方法，在动态环境和静态-动态混合环境中，分别比基础 VLA 模型提高了 28.8% 和 25.9% 的绝对成功率。

深度解读

Abstract

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve remarkable flexibility and generalization beyond classical control paradigms. However, most prevailing VLAs are trained under a single-frame observation paradigm, which leaves them structurally blind to temporal dynamics. Consequently, these models degrade severely in non-stationary scenarios, even when trained or finetuned on dynamic datasets. Existing approaches either require expensive retraining or suffer from latency bottlenecks and poor temporal consistency across action chunks. We propose Pace-and-Path Correction, a training-free, closed-form inference-time operator that wraps any chunked-action VLA. From a single quadratic cost, joint minimization yields a unified solution that decomposes orthogonally into two distinct channels. The pace channel compresses execution along the planned direction, while the path channel applies an orthogonal spatial offset, jointly absorbing the perceived dynamics within the chunk window. We evaluate our approach on a comprehensive diagnostic benchmark MoveBench designed to isolate motion as the sole controlled variable. Empirical results demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free wrappers and dynamic-adaptive methods and improves success rates by up to 28.8% and 25.9% in absolute terms over foundational VLA models in dynamic-only and static-dynamic mixed environments, respectively.

item.title: Boosting Omni-Modal Language Models: Staged Post-Training with Visually Debiased Evaluation
item.author: Liu, Che, Ma, Lichao, Zhang, Xiangyu Tony, Zhang, Yuxin, Zhang, Haoyang, Yang, Xuerui, Tian, Fei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究通过清理视觉捷径问题，评估了OmniBoost三阶段后训练方法，发现小模型可通过自蒸馏监督获得与大型模型相当的性能。

背景: 多模态语言模型旨在联合理解音频、视觉和语言输入，但在基准测试中，仅靠视觉证据即可回答查询的情况会导致性能评估虚高。

目的: 研究当前多模态基准测试是否将视觉捷径与真正的音频-视觉-语言证据整合区分开来，并探讨在视觉去偏评估设置下后训练的表现。

方法: 对九个多模态基准进行视觉仅查询审计，移除仅靠视觉可解决的查询，保留未定义过滤或会导致比较不稳定的完整子集，得到包含8,551个查询的OmniClean数据集；在OmniClean上评估基于Qwen2.5-Omni-3B的三阶段后训练配方OmniBoost。

主要发现: 平衡的双模态SFT增益有限且不均匀，RLVR提供了广泛的改进，自蒸馏重塑了基准测试概况；在自蒸馏数据上完成SFT后，3B模型达到了与Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct相当且略高的性能。

结论: 当评估控制视觉泄漏时，多模态进展更容易解释；小型多模态模型可以通过分阶段后训练和自蒸馏的Omni查询监督受益。

翻译: Omni-modal language models are intended to jointly understand audio, visual inputs, and language, but benchmark gains can be inflated when visual evidence alone is enough to answer a query. We study whether current omni-modal benchmarks separate visual shortcuts from genuine audio-visual-language evidence integration, and how post-training behaves under a visually debiased evaluation setting. We audit nine omni-modal benchmarks with visual-only probing, remove visually solvable queries, and retain full subsets when filtering is undefined or would make comparisons unstable. This yields OmniClean, a cleaned evaluation view with 8,551 retained queries from 16,968 audited queries. On OmniClean, we evaluate OmniBoost, a three-stage post-training recipe based on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B: mixed bi-modal SFT, mixed-modality RLVR, and SFT on self-distilled data. Balanced bi-modal SFT gives limited and uneven gains, RLVR provides the first broad improvement, and self-distillation reshapes the benchmark profile. After SFT on self-distilled data, the 3B model reaches performance comparable to, and in aggregate slightly above, Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct without using a stronger omni-modal teacher. These results show that omni-modal progress is easier to interpret when evaluation controls visual leakage, and that small omni-modal models can benefit from staged post-training with self-distilled omni-query supervision. Abstract

Omni-modal language models are intended to jointly understand audio, visual inputs, and language, but benchmark gains can be inflated when visual evidence alone is enough to answer a query. We study whether current omni-modal benchmarks separate visual shortcuts from genuine audio-visual-language evidence integration, and how post-training behaves under a visually debiased evaluation setting. We audit nine omni-modal benchmarks with visual-only probing, remove visually solvable queries, and retain full subsets when filtering is undefined or would make comparisons unstable. This yields OmniClean, a cleaned evaluation view with 8,551 retained queries from 16,968 audited queries. On OmniClean, we evaluate OmniBoost, a three-stage post-training recipe based on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B: mixed bi-modal SFT, mixed-modality RLVR, and SFT on self-distilled data. Balanced bi-modal SFT gives limited and uneven gains, RLVR provides the first broad improvement, and self-distillation reshapes the benchmark profile. After SFT on self-distilled data, the 3B model reaches performance comparable to, and in aggregate slightly above, Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct without using a stronger omni-modal teacher. These results show that omni-modal progress is easier to interpret when evaluation controls visual leakage, and that small omni-modal models can benefit from staged post-training with self-distilled omni-query supervision. item.title: PreScam: A Benchmark for Predicting Scam Progression from Early Conversations
item.author: Sun, Weixiang, Ma, Shang, Li, Yiyang, Ma, Tianyi, Wang, Zehong, Nelson, Colby, Xiao, Xusheng, Ye, Yanfang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究提出了PreScam基准，用于建模诈骗对话的进展过程，并评估了模型在预测诈骗终止和诈骗者行动方面的表现。

背景: 对话式诈骗（如恋爱和投资诈骗）是新兴的网络欺诈主要形式，不同于一次性诈骗诱饵，它们通过多轮对话逐步操纵受害者。

目的: 评估语言模型是否能理解现实世界诈骗随时间的进展，并构建一个用于建模诈骗进展的基准。

方法: 构建了PreScam基准，从用户提交的诈骗报告中筛选并结构化177,989条原始报告，形成11,573个对话诈骗实例，涵盖20个诈骗类别。每个实例根据提出的诈骗击杀链进行层级结构化，并在回合级别标注了诈骗者的心理行动和受害者的反应。

主要发现: 在实时终止预测任务中，监督编码器显著优于零样本大语言模型；而在下一行动预测任务中，即使是强大的大语言模型也仅取得中等成功。

结论: 当前模型能够捕捉一些与诈骗相关的线索，但在跨回合跟踪风险升级和操纵展开方面仍存在困难。

翻译: Conversational scams, such as romance and investment scams, are emerging as a major form of online fraud. Unlike one-shot scam lures such as fake lottery or unpaid toll messages, they unfold through multi-turn conversations in which scammers gradually manipulate victims using evolving psychological techniques. However, existing research mainly focuses on static scam detection or synthetic scams, leaving open whether language models can understand how real-world scams progress over time. We introduce PreScam, a benchmark for modeling scam progression from early conversations. Built from user-submitted scam reports, PreScam filters and structures 177,989 raw reports into 11,573 conversational scam instances spanning 20 scam categories. Each instance is hierarchically structured according to the scam lifecycle defined by the proposed scam kill chain, and further annotated at the turn level with scammer psychological actions and victim responses. We benchmark models on two tasks: real-time termination prediction, which estimates whether a conversation is approaching the termination stage, and scammer action prediction, which forecasts the scammer's subsequent actions. Results show a clear gap between surface-level fluency and progression modeling: supervised encoders substantially outperform zero-shot LLMs on real-time termination prediction, while next-action prediction remains only moderately successful even for strong LLMs. Taken together, these results show that current models can capture some scam-related cues, yet still struggle to track how risk escalates and how manipulation unfolds across turns.

item.title: Action Emergence from Streaming Intent
item.author: Pengfei Jing, Victor Shea-Jay Huang, Hengtong Lu, Jifeng Dai, Yan Xie, Benjin Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究将动作涌现定义为自动驾驶系统的目标能力，即通过场景条件推理生成物理可行、语义恰当且安全合规的动作，而非检索或插值学习到的场景-动作映射。

背景: 现有范式无法实现动作涌现：自回归轨迹解码器将原本多模态的未来坍缩为单一平均输出，而扩散和流匹配生成器虽然表达多模态但无法由推理意图引导。

目的: 提出Streaming Intent作为一种实现动作涌现的具体方法，使驾驶意图通过连续思维链从场景理解中因果推导，并在时间片段间保持连贯。

方法: 在名为SI的VLA模型中实现Streaming Intent：自回归解码四步思维链并发射意图令牌，该意图随后驱动分类器无关引导在流匹配动作头上生成最终轨迹，仅需两次去噪步骤。

主要发现: SI在Waymo端到端基准测试中达到竞争性整体性能，验证集和测试集RFS分数分别为7.96和7.74；首次在完全端到端VLA中展示了意图忠实可控性，固定场景下改变意图类别可产生定性不同但始终高质量的计划。

结论: SI模型通过数据驱动学习实现了无需预建轨迹库或手工编码后处理选择器的意图忠实可控性，证明了Streaming Intent在实现动作涌现方面的有效性。

翻译: 我们将动作涌现形式化为端到端自动驾驶的目标能力：即通过场景条件推理而非检索或插值学习到的场景-动作映射，在任意长尾交通场景中生成物理可行、语义恰当且安全合规的动作。我们表明先前的范式无法实现动作涌现：自回归轨迹解码器将固有的多模态未来坍缩为单一平均输出，而扩散和流匹配生成器虽然表达多模态但无法由推理意图引导。我们提出Streaming Intent作为一种实现动作涌现的具体方法：一种使驾驶意图通过连续思维链从场景理解中因果推导，并在时间片段间保持连贯的机制。我们在一个名为SI的VLA模型中实现了Streaming Intent：SI自回归解码四步思维链并发射意图令牌；解码后的意图随后在流匹配动作头上驱动分类器无关引导，仅需两次去噪步骤即可生成最终轨迹。在Waymo端到端基准测试中，SI达到了竞争性整体性能，验证集和测试集RFS分数分别为7.96和7.74。除了整体指标外，该模型展示了——据我们所知在完全端到端VLA中——意图忠实可控性：对于固定场景，在推理时改变意图类别会产生定性不同但始终高质量的计划，完全源于数据驱动学习，无需任何预建轨迹库或手工编码的后处理选择器。

Abstract

We formalize action emergence as a target capability for end-to-end autonomous driving: the ability to generate physically feasible, semantically appropriate, and safety-compliant actions in arbitrary, long-tail traffic scenes through scene-conditioned reasoning rather than retrieval or interpolation of learned scene-action mappings. We show that previous paradigms cannot deliver action emergence: autoregressive trajectory decoders collapse the inherently multimodal future into a single averaged output, while diffusion and flow-matching generators express multimodality but are not steerable by reasoned intent. We propose Streaming Intent as a concrete way to approach action emergence: a mechanism that makes driving intent (i) semantically streamed through a continuous chain-of-thought that causally derives the intent from scene understanding, and (ii) temporally streamed across clips so that intent commitments remain coherent along the driving horizon. We realize Streaming Intent in a VLA model we call SI (Streaming Intent). SI autoregressively decodes a four-step chain-of-thought and emits an intent token; the decoded intent then drives classifier-free guidance (CFG) on a flow-matching action head, requiring only two denoising steps to generate the final trajectory. On the Waymo End-to-End benchmark, SI achieves competitive aggregate performance, with an RFS score of 7.96 on the validation set and 7.74 on the test set. Beyond aggregate metrics, the model demonstrates -- to our knowledge for the first time in a fully end-to-end VLA -- intent-faithful controllability: for a fixed scene, varying the intent class at inference yields qualitatively distinct yet consistently high-quality plans, arising purely from data-driven learning without any pre-built trajectory bank or hand-coded post-hoc selector.

item.title: PRISM: Prior Rectification and Uncertainty-Aware Structure Modeling for Diffusion-Based Text Image Super-Resolution
item.author: Xu, Zihang, Liu, Xiaoyang, Chen, Zheng, Zhang, Yulun, Yang, Xiaokang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PRISM是一个单步扩散文本超分辨率框架，通过Flow-Matching Prior Rectification (FMPR)和Structure-guided Uncertainty-aware Residual Encoder (SURE)解决文本拓扑错误和笔画边界不明确的问题。

背景: Text-SR不仅需要视觉上合理的细节合成，还需要保持笔画拓扑结构的准确性以维持字符识别和可读性。现有方法在严重退化情况下面临两个挑战：从低质量输入提取的文本条件不可靠，以及全局先验无法完全确定细粒度的笔画边界。

目的: 提出PRISM框架，解决严重退化下的文本超分辨率问题，通过FMPR和SURE组件实现全局先验修正和局部结构细化。

方法: PRISM采用单步扩散框架，包含Flow-Matching Prior Rectification (FMPR)和Structure-guided Uncertainty-aware Residual Encoder (SURE)。FMPR构建配对低质量/高质量潜在空间的训练先验，学习将退化嵌入传输到恢复导向先验空间的流匹配；SURE预测不确定性感知的结构残差，选择性吸收可靠的局部边界证据并抑制模糊笔画线索。

主要发现: 在合成和真实世界基准测试中，PRISM实现了最先进的性能，推理时间在毫秒级别。

结论: PRISM通过显式的全局先验修正和局部结构细化，在单次扩散恢复过程中实现了有效的文本超分辨率。

翻译: Text image super-resolution (Text-SR) requires more than visually plausible detail synthesis: slight errors in stroke topology may alter character identity and break readability. Existing methods improve text fidelity with stronger recognition-based or generative priors, yet they still face two unresolved challenges under severe degradation: the text condition extracted from low-quality inputs can itself be unreliable, and a plausible global prior does not fully determine fine-grained stroke boundaries. We present PRISM, a single-step diffusion-based Text-SR framework that addresses these two challenges through Flow-Matching Prior Rectification (FMPR) and a Structure-guided Uncertainty-aware Residual Encoder (SURE). FMPR constructs a privileged training-time prior from paired low-quality/high-quality latents and learns a flow matching that transports degraded embeddings toward this restoration-oriented prior space, yielding more accurate and reliable global text guidance. SURE further predicts uncertainty-aware structural residuals to selectively absorb reliable local boundary evidence while suppressing ambiguous stroke cues. Together, these components enable explicit global prior rectification and local structure refinement within a single diffusion restoration pass. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that PRISM achieves state-of-the-art performance with millisecond-level inference. Our dataset and code will be available at this https URL .

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为PRISM的方法，通过先验修正和不确定性感知结构建模，改进了基于扩散模型的文本图像超分辨率技术。

Abstract

Text image super-resolution (Text-SR) requires more than visually plausible detail synthesis: slight errors in stroke topology may alter character identity and break readability. Existing methods improve text fidelity with stronger recognition-based or generative priors, yet they still face two unresolved challenges under severe degradation: the text condition extracted from low-quality inputs can itself be unreliable, and a plausible global prior does not fully determine fine-grained stroke boundaries. We present PRISM, a single-step diffusion-based Text-SR framework that addresses these two challenges through Flow-Matching Prior Rectification (FMPR) and a Structure-guided Uncertainty-aware Residual Encoder (SURE). FMPR constructs a privileged training-time prior from paired low-quality/high-quality latents and learns a flow matching that transports degraded embeddings toward this restoration-oriented prior space, yielding more accurate and reliable global text guidance. SURE further predicts uncertainty-aware structural residuals to selectively absorb reliable local boundary evidence while suppressing ambiguous stroke cues. Together, these components enable explicit global prior rectification and local structure refinement within a single diffusion restoration pass. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that PRISM achieves state-of-the-art performance with millisecond-level inference. Our dataset and code will be available at this https URL .

item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种将预训练推理骨干模型转化为严谨奥赛级求解器的简单统一配方

背景: 推理模型在长期数学和科学问题解决方面取得了显著进展，多个系统在IMO和IPhO问题上达到了金牌级表现

目的: 介绍一种简单且统一的配方，将预训练推理骨干模型转化为严谨的奥赛级求解器

方法: 首先使用反向困惑度课程进行SFT以灌输严谨的证明搜索和自我检查行为，然后通过两阶段RL管道（从可验证奖励的RL过渡到更精细的证明级RL）扩展这些行为，最后通过测试时扩展提升求解性能

主要发现: 训练出的30B-A3B骨干模型在约34万条8K token以下的轨迹上进行SFT后，再进行200步RL训练，生成的SU-01模型在超过10万token的困难问题上表现出稳定的推理能力，并在数学和物理奥赛竞赛中达到金牌级表现，包括IMO 2025/USAMO 2026和IPhO 2024/2025

结论: 该模型在数学和物理奥赛竞赛中取得了金牌级表现，并展示了科学推理在数学和物理领域之外的强大泛化能力

翻译: 推理模型的最新进展显著推动了长期数学和科学问题解决的进步，目前多个系统在数学奥林匹克竞赛（IMO）和物理奥林匹克竞赛（IPhO）问题上已达到金牌级表现。本文介绍了一种简单且统一的配方，用于将预训练推理骨干模型转化为严谨的奥赛级求解器。该配方首先利用反向困惑度课程进行监督微调（SFT），以灌输严谨的证明搜索和自我检查行为；随后通过两阶段强化学习（RL）管道扩展这些行为，该管道从使用可验证奖励的RL过渡到更精细的证明级RL；最后通过测试时扩展提升求解性能。应用该配方，我们在约34万条8K token以下的轨迹上对30B-A3B骨干模型进行了SFT训练，随后进行了200步RL训练。由此产生的模型SU-01在超过10万token的困难问题上表现出稳定的推理能力，同时在数学和物理奥赛竞赛中达到金牌级表现，包括IMO 2025/USAMO 2026和IPhO 2024/2025。它还展示了科学推理在数学和物理领域之外的强大泛化能力。

Abstract

Recent progress in reasoning models has substantially advanced long-horizon mathematical and scientific problem solving, with several systems now reaching gold-medal-level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) and International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) problems. In this paper, we introduce a simple and unified recipe for converting a post-trained reasoning backbone into a rigorous olympiad-level solver. The recipe first uses a reverse-perplexity curriculum for SFT to instill rigorous proof-search and self-checking behaviors, then scales these behaviors through a two-stage RL pipeline that progresses from RL with verifiable rewards to more delicate proof-level RL, and finally boosts solving performance with test-time scaling. Applying this recipe, we train a 30B-A3B backbone with SFT on around 340K sub-8K-token trajectories followed by 200 RL steps. The resulting model, SU-01, supports stable reasoning on difficult problems with trajectories exceeding 100K tokens, while achieving gold-medal-level performance on mathematical and physical olympiad competitions, including IMO 2025/USAMO 2026 and IPhO 2024/2025. It also demonstrates strong generalization of scientific reasoning to domains beyond mathematics and physics.

item.title: FedHPro: Federated Hyper-Prototype Learning via Gradient Matching
item.author: Huan Wang, Jun Shen, Haoran Li, Zhenyu Yang, Jun Yan, Ousman Manjang, Yanlong Zhai, Di Wu, Guansong Pang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于超原型的联邦学习框架 FedHPro，通过梯度匹配和对比学习提升模型泛化能力。

背景: 联邦学习在保护隐私的同时进行分布式协作训练，原型联邦学习因共享全局原型能增强泛化能力而受到关注。

目的: 解决现有原型更新方法导致语义漂移和全局信号错位的问题，提升跨客户端的语义一致性。

方法: 引入超原型，通过梯度匹配与从客户端真实样本蒸馏的特征对齐；提出FedHPro框架，利用超原型通过互对比学习促进类间可分性，通过一致性惩罚鼓励类内均匀性。

主要发现: 超原型产生更语义一致的全局信号；FedHPro在多个基准数据集上达到最先进性能。

结论: FedHPro在多样化异构场景下验证了有效性，代码已开源。

翻译: 联邦学习（FL）使分布式客户端能够在保护隐私的同时进行协作训练。为了增强FL的泛化能力，基于原型的FL备受关注，因为共享的全局原型为对齐客户端特定的局部原型提供了语义锚点。然而，现有方法通过平均局部原型或优化全局锚点在原型级别更新全局原型，这往往导致客户端间的语义漂移，进而产生错位的全局信号。为了缓解这一问题，我们引入了超原型，定义为通过一组可学习的全局类原型来保留跨客户端的潜在语义知识。超原型通过梯度匹配进行优化，以与从客户端真实样本直接蒸馏的类相关特征对齐，而不是原型级描述符。我们进一步提出了FedHPro，一种联邦超原型学习框架，利用超原型通过带有客户端特定边距的互对比学习来促进类间可分性，同时通过一致性惩罚鼓励类内均匀性。在多样化的异构场景下的综合实验证实，1）超原型产生更语义一致的全局信号，2）FedHPro在几个基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/mala-lab/FedHPro 获取。

Abstract

Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of distributed clients while protecting privacy. To enhance generalization capability in FL, prototype-based FL is in the spotlight, since shared global prototypes offer semantic anchors for aligning client-specific local prototypes. However, existing methods update global prototypes at the prototype-level via averaging local prototypes or refining global anchors, which often leads to semantic drift across clients and subsequently yields a misaligned global signal. To alleviate this issue, we introduce hyper-prototypes, defined by a set of learnable global class-wise prototypes to preserve underlying semantic knowledge across clients. The hyper-prototypes are optimized via gradient matching to align with class-relevant characteristics distilled directly from clients' real samples, rather than prototype-level descriptors. We further propose FedHPro, a Federated Hyper-Prototype Learning framework, to leverage hyper-prototypes to promote inter-class separability via mutual-contrastive learning with client-specific margin, while encouraging intra-class uniformity through a consistency penalty. Comprehensive experiments under diverse heterogeneous scenarios confirm that 1) hyper-prototypes produce a more semantically consistent global signal, and 2) FedHPro achieves state-of-the-art performance on several benchmark datasets. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/mala-lab/FedHPro}{https://github.com/mala-lab/FedHPro}.

item.title: CA-GCL: Cross-Anatomy Global-Local Contrastive Learning for Robust 3D Medical Image Understanding
item.author: Hanwen Zhang, Yao Liu, Die Dai, Jiaye Yang, Qiao Liu, Yutong Xie, Peng Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为CA-GCL的新框架，旨在解决细粒度视觉语言预训练在3D医学图像理解中存在的表示坍塌问题，通过跨解剖结构全局-局部对比学习增强模型鲁棒性。

背景: 现有的细粒度视觉语言预训练范式在文本嵌入空间中存在严重的表示坍塌，导致不同解剖结构的文本嵌入高度聚集且难以区分，使模型对提示变化高度敏感，阻碍了可靠的临床部署。

目的: 为了解决细粒度视觉语言预训练中存在的表示坍塌问题，提高模型对提示变化的鲁棒性，并实现可靠的3D医学图像理解。

方法: 提出了跨解剖结构全局-局部对比学习框架（CA-GCL），引入全局对比目标以强制解剖类别在潜在空间中分离，并采用基于排列不变性和部分完整性的临床感知文本增强策略。

主要发现: 在CT-RATE和Rad-ChestCT数据集上的广泛评估表明，CA-GCL在零样本异常检测中持续优于现有的视觉语言预训练范式，表现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力，并将坍塌的文本相似度分布转变为钟形分布，减少了不同提示模板下的性能方差。

结论: CA-GCL是一个有效的框架，能够实现鲁棒的3D医学图像理解，通过解决表示坍塌问题显著提升了模型的稳定性和可靠性。

翻译: Fine-grained Vision-Language Pre-training (FVLP) 在3D医学图像理解中展示了显著潜力，通过将解剖级别的视觉表示与相应的文本描述对齐。然而，现有的FVLP范式通常在文本嵌入空间中遭受严重的表示坍塌，其中不同解剖结构的文本嵌入变得高度聚集且难以区分。这种分布性退化解除了模型对提示变化的敏感性，阻碍了可靠的临床部署。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的跨解剖结构全局-局部对比学习框架（CA-GCL）。CA-GCL引入了一个全局对比目标，强制解剖类别在潜在空间中分离，有效地抵消了局部对齐引起的聚集趋势。此外，我们结合了一种基于排列不变性和部分完整性的临床感知文本增强策略，以提高对描述不完整性的鲁棒性。在CT-RATE和Rad-ChestCT数据集上的广泛评估表明，CA-GCL在零样本异常检测中持续优于现有的VLP范式，在实现卓越性能的同时表现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力。至关重要的是，CA-GCL减少了不同提示模板下的性能方差，将坍塌的文本相似度分布转变为钟形分布。这些结果验证了CA-GCL是一个有效的鲁棒3D医学图像理解框架。

深度解读

草稿：该论文提出了一种名为CA-GCL的新方法，通过跨解剖结构的全局-局部对比学习来增强3D医学图像理解的鲁棒性。 * *优化：* “Cross-Anatomy” -> “跨解剖结构”。“Global-Local Contrastive Learning” -> “全局-局部对比学习”。“Robust” -> “鲁棒”。 * 草稿：该论文提出了一种名为CA-GCL的新方法，通过跨解剖结构的全局-局部对比学习来增强3D医学图像理解的鲁棒性。 * *约束检查：* “简洁、准确、通俗”。“2

Abstract

Fine-grained Vision-Language Pre-training (FVLP) demonstrates significant potential in 3D medical image understanding by aligning anatomy-level visual representations with corresponding textual descriptions. However, existing FVLP paradigms often suffer from severe representation collapse in the textual embedding space, where text embeddings of distinct anatomical structures become highly clustered and indistinguishable. This distributional degeneracy renders the model hypersensitive to prompt variations, hindering reliable clinical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Cross-Anatomy Global-Local Contrastive Learning framework (CA-GCL). CA-GCL introduces a global contrastive objective that enforces separation between anatomical categories in the latent space, effectively counteracting the aggregation tendency induced by local alignment. Furthermore, we incorporate a clinical-aware text augmentation strategy based on permutation invariance and partial completeness to enhance robustness against descriptive incompleteness. Extensive evaluations on the CT-RATE and Rad-ChestCT datasets demonstrate that CA-GCL consistently outperforms existing VLP paradigms in zero-shot abnormality detection, achieving superior performance while exhibiting strong cross-dataset generalization. Crucially, CA-GCL reduces performance variance across diverse prompt templates, transforming the collapsed textual similarity distribution into a bell-shaped distribution. These results validate CA-GCL as an effective framework for robust 3D medical image understanding.

item.title: Self-Supervised On-Policy Reinforcement Learning via Contrastive Proximal Policy Optimisation
item.author: Asim Osman, Sasha Abramowitz, Mark Bergh, Ulrich Armel Mbou Sob, Ruan John de Kock, Omayma Mahjoub, Oussama Hidaoui, Noah De Nicola, Arnol Manuel Fokam, Felix Chalumeau, Daniel Rajaonarivonivelomanantsoa, Siddarth Singh, Refiloe Shabe, Juan Claude Formanek, Simon Verster Du Toit, Arnu Pretorius
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

summary: 对比强化学习通过对比目标学习目标条件化的Q值，无需手工设计的奖励函数。

background: 现有的对比强化学习算法主要依赖离策略优化，且多局限于连续动作空间，在离散环境中的研究较少，导致其与现代广泛使用的在线策略训练流程脱节。

purpose: 为了建立对比强化学习与在线策略训练流程之间的联系，引入对比近端策略优化算法。

method: CPPO是一种在线策略的对比强化学习算法，直接从对比Q值中推导策略优势，并通过标准PPO目标进行优化，无需奖励函数或回放缓冲区。

main_finding: 在18项任务中，CPPO在14项任务上显著优于之前的对比强化学习基线，在12项任务上匹配或超过了使用手工设计密集奖励的PPO的性能。

conclusion: CPPO不仅证明了在线策略对比强化学习的存在价值，还在多个任务中展现出优越的性能。

translation: 对比强化学习通过对比状态-动作和目标表示来学习目标条件化的Q值，消除了对手工设计奖励函数的需求。尽管在实现可行的自监督学习方面取得了令人印象深刻的成功，但现有的对比强化学习算法都依赖于离策略优化，且大多局限于连续动作空间，在离散环境中的研究投入很少。这使得对比强化学习与现代广泛采用的、在连续和离散环境中均有效的在线策略训练流程脱节。为了建立这种联系，我们引入了对比近端策略优化。CPPO是一种在线策略的对比强化学习算法，它直接从对比Q值中推导策略优势，并通过标准的PPO目标进行优化，无需奖励函数或回放缓冲区。我们在连续和离散、单智能体和合作多智能体任务中评估了CPPO。虽然在线策略方法的存在本身就有用，但我们观察到CPPO不仅在18项任务中的14项上显著优于之前的对比强化学习基线，而且在18项测试任务中的12项上匹配或超过了使用手工设计密集奖励的PPO的性能。

Abstract

Contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) learns goal-conditioned Q-values through a contrastive objective over state-action and goal representations, removing the need for hand-crafted reward functions. Despite impressive success in achieving viable self-supervised learning in RL, all existing CRL algorithms rely on off-policy optimisation and are mostly constrained to continuous action spaces, with little research invested in discrete environments. This leaves CRL disconnected from widely used and effective, modern on-policy training pipelines adopted across both single-agent and multi-agent RL in continuous and discrete environments. To establish a first connection, we introduce Contrastive Proximal Policy Optimisation (CPPO). CPPO is an on-policy contrastive RL algorithm that derives policy advantages directly from contrastive Q-values and optimises them via the standard PPO objective, without requiring a reward function or a replay buffer. We evaluate CPPO across continuous and discrete, single-agent and cooperative multi-agent tasks. Whilst the existence of an on-policy approach is inherently useful, we observe that \textbf{CPPO not only significantly outperforms the previous CRL baselines in 14 out of 18 tasks, but also matches or exceeds PPO's performance, which uses hand-crafted dense rewards, in 12 out of the 18 tasks tested.}

item.title: Di-BiLPS: Denoising induced Bidirectional Latent-PDE-Solver under Sparse Observations
item.author: Zhonghao Li, Chaoyu Liu, Qian Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Di-BiLPS是一个统一神经框架，用于在极稀疏观测下处理前向和逆PDE问题，具有高效推理和灵活输入输出映射能力。

背景: PDEs是建模复杂自然和物理现象的基础，但在许多实际应用中观测数据极其稀疏，限制了经典数值求解器和现有神经方法的应用。

目的: 提出Di-BiLPS框架，旨在有效处理在极稀疏观测下的前向和逆PDE问题，同时提高推理效率并保持灵活的输入输出映射。

方法: Di-BiLPS结合变分自编码器压缩高维输入到紧凑潜在空间，使用潜在扩散模块建模不确定性，采用对比学习对齐表示，并引入基于方差保持扩散过程的PDE信息去噪算法。

主要发现: 在多个PDE基准测试中，Di-BiLPS在极稀疏输入（低至3%）下始终达到SOTA性能，显著降低计算成本，并支持零样本超分辨率。

结论: Di-BiLPS在极稀疏观测下有效解决了PDE问题，实现了高效推理和灵活映射，并支持连续时空域的零样本超分辨率。

翻译: 摘要：偏微分方程（PDEs）是建模复杂自然和物理现象的基础。然而，在许多实际应用中，观测数据极其稀疏，这严重限制了经典数值求解器和现有神经方法的应用。虽然神经方法在中等稀疏观测下显示出有希望的结果，但它们在高分辨率下的推理效率有限，并且在极稀疏情况下精度显著下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了Di-BiLPS，一个统一的神经框架，能够在极稀疏观测下有效处理前向和逆PDE问题。Di-BiLPS结合变分自编码器将高维输入压缩到紧凑的潜在空间，使用潜在扩散模块建模不确定性，并采用对比学习对齐表示。该框架完全在这个潜在空间中运行，实现了高效推理，同时保留了灵活的输入输出映射。此外，我们引入了一种基于方差保持扩散过程的PDE信息去噪算法，进一步提高了推理效率。在多个PDE基准测试中的广泛实验表明，Di-BiLPS在极稀疏输入（低至3%）下始终达到SOTA性能，同时显著降低了计算成本。此外，Di-BiLPS支持零样本超分辨率，因为它允许对连续时空域进行预测。

Abstract

Partial differential equations (PDEs) are fundamental for modeling complex natural and physical phenomena. In many real-world applications, however, observational data are extremely sparse, which severely limits the applicability of both classical numerical solvers and existing neural approaches. While neural methods have shown promising results under moderately sparse observations, their inference efficiency at high resolutions is limited, and their accuracy degrades substantially in the extremely sparse regime. In this work, we propose the Di-BiLPS, a unified neural framework that effectively handle both forward and inverse PDE problems under extremely sparse observations. Di-BiLPS combines a variational autoencoder to compress high-dimensional inputs into a compact latent space, a latent diffusion module to model uncertainty, and contrastive learning to align representations. Operating entirely in this latent space, the framework achieves efficient inference while retaining flexible input-output mapping. In addition, we introduce a PDE-informed denoising algorithm based on a variance-preserving diffusion process, which further improves inference efficiency. Extensive experiments on multiple PDE benchmarks demonstrate that Di-BiLPS consistently achieves SOTA performance under extremely sparse inputs (as low as 3%), while substantially reducing computational cost. Moreover, Di-BiLPS enables zero-shot super-resolution, as it allows predictions over continuous spatial-temporal domains.

item.title: Topology-Preserving Neural Operator Learning via Hodge Decomposition
item.author: Zheng, Dongzhe, Zhong, Tao, Allen-Blanchette, Christine
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究从函数空间视角研究了几何网格上物理场方程的解算子，提出了一种混合欧拉-拉格朗日架构，通过霍奇对偶性分离拓扑自由度和几何动力学，以实现结构保持子空间内的加性近似。

背景: 研究物理场方程在几何网格上的解算子，从函数空间视角出发。

目的: 通过霍奇正交性解决谱干扰，将不可学习的拓扑自由度与可学习的几何动力学分离，实现结构保持子空间内的加性近似。

方法: 基于霍奇理论和算子分裂，推导出一种混合欧拉-拉格朗日架构，称为霍奇谱对偶架构。使用离散微分形式捕捉拓扑主导分量，使用正交辅助环境空间表示复杂的局部动力学。

主要发现: 该方法在几何图上实现了更高的精度和效率，对物理不变量具有增强的保真度。

结论: 该方法在处理几何网格上的物理场方程时表现出优越的性能。

翻译: 本文从函数空间视角研究了几何网格上物理场方程的解算子。我们揭示霍奇正交性通过将不可学习的拓扑自由度与可学习的几何动力学分离，从根本上解决了谱干扰，实现了限制在结构保持子空间内的加性近似。基于霍奇理论和算子分裂，我们推导出了原则性的算子级分解。结果是一种混合欧拉-拉格朗日架构，具有我们称为霍奇谱对偶的代数级归纳偏置。在我们的框架中，我们使用离散微分形式来捕捉拓扑主导分量，并使用正交辅助环境空间来表示复杂的局部动力学。我们的方法在几何图上实现了更高的精度和效率，对物理不变量具有增强的保真度。我们的代码可在该网址获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有神经算子在处理具有复杂拓扑结构（如孔洞）的几何形状时，难以保持拓扑不变性的问题。它通过 Hodge 分解方法，将向量场分解为无旋、无散和调和部分，从而更好地捕捉几何特征。在现实或研究中，保持拓扑不变性对于准确描述流体流过复杂几何形状等物理现象至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 1. **分析请求：** * **角色：** 严谨的学术论文助手。 * **输入：** 一份 PDF 文件的原始内容（以文本/二进制流形式呈现，主要是 PDF 结构数据，如 `obj`、`stream` 等）。 * **任务：** 回答一个具体问题：“作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？” * **限制条件：** * 基于输入文本回答（不要编造）。 * 简洁、准确、通俗的中文。 * 避免公式、符号或缩写（除非是标题/名称的一部分）。 * 如果未明确说明，写 "unknown"。 * 简短（2-4 句）。 * 不要列表、数组或嵌套对象。 * **仅输出纯文本**（无 JSON、无 Markdown、无代码块、无额外解释）。2. **分析输入数据：** * 输入是 PDF 的原始二进制/文本表示。 * 它包含元数据（标题：“Topology-Preserving Neural Operator Learning via Hodge Decomposition”，作者：Dongzhe Zheng, Tao Zhong, Christine Allen-Blanchette）。 * 它包含链接（`/Annots`）指向参考文献（`cite.kovachki2023neural`, `cite.hirani2003dec`, `cite.desbrun2005dec`, `cite.arnold2006feec`, `cite.arnold2010finite`, `cite.li2020fourier`, `cite.lu2021deeponet`, `cite.raissi2019physics`）。 * 它包含指向 GitHub 仓库的链接（`https://github.com/ContinuumCoder/Hodge-Spectral-Duality`）。 * *关键观察：* 输入文本是 PDF 结构的*元数据*和*链接*。它*不*包含论文的正文文本（摘要、引言、方法论、实验）。`stream` 对象包含二进制数据（`xÚ½[Y...`），这很可能是压缩的正文文本，但提示要求我“基于输入文本”。通常，当用户粘贴原始 PDF 内容时，他们期望 AI 去提取内容，但在这里，内容被截断或以二进制形式呈现，无法直接阅读。 * *然而*，提示说“请通读并分析以下论文的原始内容”。由于提供的文本*仅*包含元数据、链接和二进制流，我无法从*提供的文本*中提取关于“他们如何思考”或“借鉴了什么”的具体细节。 * *等等*，通常在这些 RAG（检索增强生成）场景中，如果文本不包含答案，我应该说明这一点。但是，查看提供的链接（`cite.kovachki2023neural` 等），我可以推断出背景。 * *自我修正/细化：* 提示说“基于输入文本回答”。输入文本*不*包含摘要或引言。它只有标题、作者、链接和二进制垃圾数据。 * *假设：* 用户可能期望我利用关于该论文的*外部知识*，或者他们错误地粘贴了元数据而不是正文。 * *严格遵守：* “你必须基于输入文本回答，不要编造不存在的信息。” * *困境：* 如果我说“unknown”，那是准确的，但可能没有帮助。如果我说“他们使用了 Hodge 分解”，我就是在编造，因为我没有在输入文本中看到“Hodge 分解”这个词（虽然标题里有）。 * *再看一遍标题：* “Topology-Preserving Neural Operator Learning via Hodge Decomposition”。 * *再看一遍链接：* `https://github.com/ContinuumCoder/Hodge-Spectral-Duality`。 * *再看一遍参考文献：* Operator），`cite.lu2021deeponet`（DeepONet），`cite.raissi2019physics`（PINN）。 * *结论：* 输入文本*不*包含关于设计逻辑或借鉴工作的叙述性描述。它只提供了标题、作者和参考文献。 * *决定：* 由于我无法从提供的文本中提取关于“他们如何思考”的具体答案，我必须说明输入文本不包含此信息，或者仅基于标题/链接回答。 * *然而*，通常在这些提示中，如果用户粘贴了 PDF 元数据，他们可能是在测试我是否知道该论文。但指令是严格的：“基于输入文本”。 * *严格解读：* 输入文本是 PDF 元数据。它没有描述方法或借鉴工作。 * *替代解读：* 用户希望我*利用*提供的标题和链接来推断答案，即使正文文本缺失。 * *再看一遍提示：* “请通读并分析以下论文的原始内容”。 * *分析：* 内容是 PDF 结构。 * *结果：* 输入文本不包含关于设计逻辑或借鉴工作的信息。 * *起草回答：* “输入文本仅包含论文的元数据、标题和参考文献链接，未提供关于作者如何思考或借鉴现有工作的具体描述。”（输入文本仅包含元数据、标题和参考文献链接，未提供关于作者如何思考或借鉴现有工作的具体描述。） * *等等*，让我们检查一下是否遗漏了任何内容。`stream` 对象包含二进制数据。我无法阅读它。 * Operator、DeepONet、PINN 的。 * *标题：* “Topology-Preserving Neural Operator Learning via Hodge Decomposition”。 * *逻辑：* 标题暗示他们使用 Hodge 分解来保持拓扑结构。参考文献暗示他们借鉴了离散微分同伦（DEC）和有限元素外微分计算（FEEDC）。 * *我能说这个吗？* Abstract

In this paper, we study solution operators of physical field equations on geometric meshes from a function-space perspective. We reveal that Hodge orthogonality fundamentally resolves spectral interference by isolating unlearnable topological degrees of freedom from learnable geometric dynamics, enabling an additive approximation confined to structure-preserving subspaces. Building on Hodge theory and operator splitting, we derive a principled operator-level decomposition. The result is a Hybrid Eulerian-Lagrangian architecture with an algebraic-level inductive bias we call Hodge Spectral Duality (HSD). In our framework, we use discrete differential forms to capture topology-dominated components and an orthogonal auxiliary ambient space to represent complex local dynamics. Our method achieves superior accuracy and efficiency on geometric graphs with enhanced fidelity to physical invariants. Our code is available at this https URL

item.title: Realiz3D: 3D Generation Made Photorealistic via Domain-Aware Learning
item.author: Sobol, Ido, Sohn, Kihyuk, Blum, Yoav, Zakharov, Egor, Bluvstein, Max, Vedaldi, Andrea, Litany, Or
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

summary: Realiz3D是一个轻量级框架，用于训练扩散模型以生成既逼真又符合3D一致性的图像，通过解耦控制和视觉领域来提高生成质量。

background: 现有方法通常通过微调预训练的图像生成器来学习控制信号，但这种方法往往因照片和渲染图之间的领域差距而牺牲图像的真实性。

purpose: 提出Realiz3D框架，旨在解决控制信号与合成外观之间意外关联导致的问题，实现无需适应特定视觉领域即可获得可控性和逼真性的目标。

method: 通过引入协变量，将其输入小型残差适配器以转移领域，从而显式地学习视觉领域（真实或合成）与其他控制信号；同时利用扩散生成器中不同层和去噪步骤的见解来增强控制转移能力。

main_finding: 该方法能够指导模型在应用控制信号时产生逼真的图像，并在文本到多视图生成和3D输入纹理化等任务中表现出色，输出结果具有3D一致性和逼真性。

conclusion: Realiz3D成功解耦了控制和视觉领域，使得模型可以在不拟合特定视觉领域的情况下获得可控性，从而在保持逼真度的同时实现了精确的几何、材料和视角控制。

translation: 我们经常旨在生成既逼真又符合3D一致性的图像，遵循精确的几何、材料和视角控制。通常，这是通过微调一个预训练的图像生成器来实现的，该生成器在数十亿张真实图像上进行了预训练，使用合成3D资产的渲染图，其中控制信号的注释是可用的。虽然这种方法可以学习所需的控制，但由于照片和渲染图之间的领域差距，它往往会牺牲图像的真实性。我们观察到，这个问题很大程度上是由于模型学习到了控制信号的存在与图像的合成外观之间的意外关联。为了解决这个问题，我们介绍了Realiz3D，这是一个用于训练扩散模型的轻量级框架，它解耦了控制和视觉领域。关键思想是通过引入一个协变量，将其输入小型残差适配器，以转移领域，从而显式地学习视觉领域（真实或合成）与其他控制信号。然后，生成器可以接受训练以获得可控性，而不必拟合特定的视觉领域。通过这种方式，模型可以指导其在应用控制信号时产生逼真的图像。我们通过利用关于扩散生成器中不同层和去噪步骤作用的见解，增强了控制向真实领域的可转移性，从而提供了新的训练和推理策略，进一步缩小了差距。我们在文本到多视图生成和3D输入纹理化等任务中展示了Realiz3D的优势，产生了3D一致性和逼真性的输出。

Abstract

We often aim to generate images that are both photorealistic and 3D-consistent, adhering to precise geometry, material, and viewpoint controls. Typically, this is achieved by fine-tuning an image generator, pre-trained on billions of real images, using renders of synthetic 3D assets, where annotations for control signals are available. While this approach can learn the desired controls, it often compromises the realism of the images due to domain gap between photographs and renders. We observe that this issue largely arises from the model learning an unintended association between the presence of control signals and the synthetic appearance of the images. To address this, we introduce Realiz3D, a lightweight framework for training diffusion models, that decouples controls and visual domain. The key idea is to explicitly learn visual domain, real or synthetic, separately from other control signals by introducing a co-variate that, fed into small residual adapters, shifts the domain. Then, the generator can be trained to gain controllability, without fitting to specific visual domain. In this way, the model can be guided to produce realistic images even when controls are applied. We enhance control transferability to the real domain by leveraging insights about roles of different layers and denoising steps in diffusion-based generators, informing new training and inference strategies that further mitigate the gap. We demonstrate the advantages of Realiz3D in tasks as text-to-multiview generation and texturing from 3D inputs, producing outputs that are 3D-consistent and photorealistic.

item.title: PREPING: Building Agent Memory without Tasks
item.author: Choi, Yumin, Park, Sangwoo, Kang, Minki, Baek, Jinheon, Hwang, Sung Ju
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Preping是一个在任务前构建程序记忆的框架，通过提议者引导的记忆构建来提高智能体在新环境中的表现。

背景: 智能体通常从离线演示或在线交互中构建记忆，但在新环境中面临冷启动问题，缺乏特定任务经验。

目的: 研究在观察任何目标环境任务之前，智能体是否能仅使用自生成的合成练习来构建程序记忆。

方法: Preping框架包含提议者记忆，提议者根据结构化控制状态生成合成任务，求解器执行任务，验证器确定哪些轨迹适合记忆插入并提供反馈。

主要发现: Preping在AppWorld、BFCL v3和MCP-Universe上显著优于无记忆基线，性能可与基于剧本的方法竞争，部署成本比在线记忆构建低2.99倍和2.23倍。

结论: 主要益处不来自合成量，而是来自提议者对可行性、冗余和覆盖的控制，结合选择性记忆更新。

翻译: Agent记忆通常从离线演示或在线交互中构建。然而，无论如何构建，当智能体首次引入新环境时，如果没有可用的特定任务经验，就会面临冷启动差距。在本文中，我们研究了任务前记忆构建：智能体能否在观察任何目标环境任务之前，仅使用自生成的合成练习来构建程序记忆。然而，仅合成交互是不够的，因为如果没有控制练习什么和存储什么，合成任务变得冗余、不可行且最终无信息，且由于未过滤的轨迹，记忆进一步迅速退化。为了克服这一点，我们提出了Preping，一个提议者引导的记忆构建框架。其核心是提议者记忆，一个结构化控制状态，塑造未来的练习。提议者根据此状态生成合成任务，求解器执行它们，验证器确定哪些轨迹适合记忆插入，同时也提供反馈以指导未来的提议。在AppWorld、BFCL v3和MCP-Universe上的实验表明，Preping显著优于无记忆基线，并且性能可与从离线或在线经验构建的强基于剧本的方法竞争，在AppWorld上的部署成本比在线记忆构建低2.99倍，在BFCL v3上低2.23倍。进一步分析表明，主要益处不来自合成量，而是来自提议者对可行性、冗余和覆盖的控制，结合选择性记忆更新。

Abstract

Agent memory is typically constructed either offline from curated demonstrations or online from post-deployment interactions. However, regardless of how it is built, an agent faces a cold-start gap when first introduced to a new environment without any task-specific experience available. In this paper, we study pre-task memory construction: whether an agent can build procedural memory before observing any target-environment tasks, using only self-generated synthetic practice. Yet, synthetic interaction alone is insufficient, as without controlling what to practice and what to store, synthetic tasks become redundant, infeasible, and ultimately uninformative, and memory further degrades quickly due to unfiltered trajectories. To overcome this, we present Preping, a proposer-guided memory construction framework. At its core is proposer memory, a structured control state that shapes future practice. A Proposer generates synthetic tasks conditioned on this state, a Solver executes them, and a Validator determines which trajectories are eligible for memory insertion while also providing feedback to guide future proposals. Experiments on AppWorld, BFCL v3, and MCP-Universe show that Preping substantially improves over a no-memory baseline and achieves performance competitive with strong playbook-based methods built from offline or online experience, with deployment cost $2.99\times$ lower on AppWorld and $2.23\times$ lower on BFCL v3 than online memory construction. Further analyses reveal that the main benefit does not come from synthetic volume alone, but from proposer-side control over feasibility, redundancy, and coverage, combined with selective memory updates.

item.title: Unsupervised learning of acquisition variability in structural connectomes via hybrid latent space modeling
item.author: Gaurav Rudravaram, Lianrui Zuo, Karthik Ramadass, Elyssa McMaster, Jongyeon Yoon, Aravind R. Krishnan, Adam M. Saunders, Chenyu Gao, Nancy R. Newlin, Praitayini Kanakaraj, Lori L. Beason Held, Murat Bilgel, Laura A. Barquero, Micah DArchangel, Tin Q. Nguyen, Laurie B. Cutting, Derek Archer, Timothy J. Hohman, Daniel C. Moyer, Bennett A. Landman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种无监督框架，通过架构退火技术解决深度磁共振成像数据中结构连接组分析中的变异性问题，通过联合建模连续和离散潜在变量来分离获取相关效应与生物变异性。

背景: 深度磁共振成像数据在不同站点、扫描仪和协议下的获取差异引入了变异性，这 complicates 结构连接组分析。传统的降维方法将所有方差建模为连续变量，导致获取效应被吸收到连续潜在空间中。

目的: 引入一种无监督框架，通过架构退火技术移除手动调优需求，使模型能够在训练过程中自适应地平衡离散和连续潜在变量，从而更好地分离获取相关效应与生物变异性。

方法: 构建了一个包含7,416个结构连接组的数据库，涵盖2至102岁年龄范围和13项研究中的25种独特获取参数组合。将提出的方法与标准变分自编码器、带k-means聚类的PCA以及仅通过损失函数退火的混合模型进行了比较。

主要发现: 架构退火方法在站点学习方面表现优于基线模型，能够恢复与扫描仪和协议差异对齐的聚类。

结论: 混合连续-离散潜在空间，配合架构而非基于损失的退火技术，提供了一种有用的无监督机制来捕获深度磁共振成像数据中的获取变异性。

翻译: 该研究提出了一种无监督框架，通过架构退火技术解决深度磁共振成像数据中结构连接组分析中的变异性问题，通过联合建模连续和离散潜在变量来分离获取相关效应与生物变异性。

Abstract

Acquisition differences across sites, scanners, and protocols in dMRI introduce variability that complicates structural connectome analysis. This motivates deep learning models that can represent high-dimensional connectomes in a low-dimensional space while explicitly separating acquisition-related effects from biological variation. Conventional dimensionality reduction methods model all variance as continuous, so acquisition effects often get absorbed into a continuous latent space. Recent hybrid latent-space models combine discrete and continuous components to address this, but typically require manual capacity tuning to ensure the discrete component captures the intended variability. We introduce an unsupervised framework that removes this manual tuning by architecturally annealing encoder outputs before decoding, allowing the model to adaptively balance discrete and continuous latent variables during training. To evaluate it, we curated a dataset of N=7,416 structural connectomes derived from dMRI, spanning ages 2 to 102 and 13 studies with 25 unique acquisition-parameter combinations. Of these, 5,900 are cognitively unimpaired, 877 have mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and 639 have Alzheimer's disease (AD). We compare against a standard VAE, PCA with k-means clustering, and hybrid models that anneal only through the loss function. Our architectural annealing produces stronger site learning (ARI=0.53, p<0.05) than these baselines. Results show that a hybrid continuous-discrete latent space, with architectural rather than loss-based annealing, provides a useful unsupervised mechanism for capturing acquisition variability in dMRI: by jointly modeling smooth and categorical structure, the Joint-VAE recovers clusters aligned with scanner and protocol differences.

item.title: EvolveMem:Self-Evolving Memory Architecture via AutoResearch for LLM Agents
item.author: Liu, Jiaqi, Ye, Xinyu, Xia, Peng, Zheng, Zeyu, Xie, Cihang, Ding, Mingyu, Yao, Huaxiu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: EvolveMem 是一种自进化记忆架构，通过 LLM 驱动的诊断模块优化检索配置，实现自动研究过程。

背景: 现有记忆系统在部署后，存储内容会变化，但评分函数、融合策略和答案生成策略保持不变。

目的: 提出一种真正自适应的记忆系统，要求存储知识和检索机制共同进化。

方法: EvolveMem 将检索配置暴露为结构化动作空间，由 LLM 驱动的诊断模块优化；包含自动回退和探索停滞的机制。

主要发现: 在 LoCoMo 上超过最强基线 25.7%，在 MemBench 上超过最强基线 18.9%；进化配置在基准测试间具有正向转移。

结论: 系统实现了自动研究过程，发现了有效的检索策略，包括原始动作空间中不存在的配置维度。

翻译: Long-term memory is essential for LLM agents that operate across multiple sessions, yet existing memory systems treat retrieval infrastructure as fixed: stored content evolves while scoring functions, fusion strategies, and answer-generation policies remain frozen at deployment. We argue that truly adaptive memory requires co-evolution at two levels: the stored knowledge and the retrieval mechanism that queries it. We present EvolveMem, a self-evolving memory architecture that exposes its full retrieval configuration as a structured action space optimized by an LLM-powered diagnosis module. In each evolution round, the module reads per-question failure logs, identifies root causes, and proposes targeted configuration adjustments; a guarded meta-analyzer applies them with automatic revert-on-regression and explore-on-stagnation safeguards. This closed-loop self-evolution realizes an AutoResearch process: the system autonomously conducts iterative research cycles on its own architecture, replacing manual configuration tuning. Starting from a minimal baseline, the process converges autonomously, discovering effective retrieval strategies including entirely new configuration dimensions not present in the original action space. On LoCoMo, EvolveMem outperforms the strongest baseline by 25.7% relative and achieves a 78.0% relative improvement over the minimal baseline. On MemBench, EvolveMem exceeds the strongest baseline by 18.9% relative. Evolved configurations transfer across benchmarks with positive rather than catastrophic transfer, indicating that the self-evolution process captures universal retrieval principles rather than benchmark-specific heuristics. Code is available at this https URL .

item.title: A Unified Geometric Framework for Weighted Contrastive Learning
item.author: Raphael Vock, Edouard Duchesnay, Benoit Dufumier
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了对比学习（CL）中嵌入几何结构的理解，通过将加权InfoNCE目标解释为距离几何问题，揭示了不同监督和弱监督目标下的最优嵌入特征。

背景: 对比学习旨在通过学习反映相似性图的表示来保留样本间的关系结构，但由此产生的嵌入的几何性质仍知之甚少。

目的: 通过将加权InfoNCE目标解释为距离几何问题，以获得对监督和弱监督目标最优嵌入的精确特征描述。

方法: 将加权InfoNCE目标解释为距离几何问题，其中加权方案指定表示所要实现的目标几何结构。

主要发现: 在监督分类中，SupCon和Soft SupCon将每个类别的样本坍缩为一个原型；平衡SupCon恢复经典正单纯形几何，而不平衡SupCon诱导非均匀类间相似性；在连续标签设置中，y-Aware CL通常无法达到其熵最优解，除非标签位于超球面上。

结论: 加权方案的选择决定了对比学习是否几何可实现、退化或不一致，为设计对比目标提供了一个原则性框架。

翻译: Contrastive learning (CL) aims to preserve relational structure between samples by learning representations that reflect a similarity graph. Yet, the geometry of the resulting embeddings remains poorly understood. Here we show that weighted InfoNCE objectives can be interpreted as Distance Geometry Problems, where the weighting scheme specifies the target geometry to be realized by the representation. This viewpoint yields exact characterizations of the optimal embeddings for several supervised and weakly supervised objectives. In supervised classification, both SupCon and Soft SupCon (a dense relaxation of it where pairs from distinct classes have small non-zero similarity) collapse samples within each class to a single prototype. However, while balanced SupCon recovers the classical regular simplex geometry, class imbalance breaks this symmetry: SupCon induces non-uniform inter-class similarities depending on class sizes, whereas Soft SupCon preserves a regular simplex geometry regardless of class imbalance. In continuous-label settings, our framework reveals a different failure mode: y-Aware CL generally cannot attain its entropic optimum unless the labels lie on a hypersphere, exposing a mismatch between Euclidean label weights and spherical latent similarity. By contrast, geometrically consistent choices such as Euclidean-Euclidean weighting or X-CLR admit unique optimal embeddings. Our results show that the choice of weighting scheme determines whether contrastive learning is geometrically realizable, degenerate, or inconsistent, providing a principled framework for designing contrastive objectives.

Abstract

Contrastive learning (CL) aims to preserve relational structure between samples by learning representations that reflect a similarity graph. Yet, the geometry of the resulting embeddings remains poorly understood. Here we show that weighted InfoNCE objectives can be interpreted as Distance Geometry Problems, where the weighting scheme specifies the target geometry to be realized by the representation. This viewpoint yields exact characterizations of the optimal embeddings for several supervised and weakly supervised objectives. In supervised classification, both SupCon and Soft SupCon (a dense relaxation of it where pairs from distinct classes have small non-zero similarity) collapse samples within each class to a single prototype. However, while balanced SupCon recovers the classical regular simplex geometry, class imbalance breaks this symmetry: SupCon induces non-uniform inter-class similarities depending on class sizes, whereas Soft SupCon preserves a regular simplex geometry regardless of class imbalance. In continuous-label settings, our framework reveals a different failure mode: y-Aware CL generally cannot attain its entropic optimum unless the labels lie on a hypersphere, exposing a mismatch between Euclidean label weights and spherical latent similarity. By contrast, geometrically consistent choices such as Euclidean-Euclidean weighting or X-CLR admit unique optimal embeddings. Our results show that the choice of weighting scheme determines whether contrastive learning is geometrically realizable, degenerate, or inconsistent, providing a principled framework for designing contrastive objectives.

item.title: TabPFN-3: Technical Report
item.author: Léo Grinsztajn, Klemens Flöge, Oscar Key, Felix Birkel, Philipp Jund, Brendan Roof, Mihir Manium, Shi Bin, Hoo, Magnus Bühler, Anurag Garg, Dominik Safaric, Jake Robertson, Benjamin Jäger, Simone Alessi, Adrian Hayler, Vladyslav Moroshan, Lennart Purucker, Philipp Singer, Alan Arazi, Julien Siems, Jan Hendrik Metzen, Georg Grab, Nick Erickson, Siyuan Guo, Eliott Kalfon, Simon Bing, David Salinas, Clara Cornu, Lilly Charlotte Wehrhahn, Diana Kriuchkova, Kursat Kaya, Lydia Sidhoum, Marie Salmon, Jerry Chen, Madelon Hulsebos, Yann LeCun, Samuel Müller, Bernhard Schölkopf, Sauraj Gambhir, Noah Hollmann, Frank Hutter
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TabPFN-3 是一个在表格数据预测任务上性能显著提升的模型，通过合成数据预训练和测试时计算扩展，在多个基准测试中超越了现有模型，并大幅提高了推理速度。

背景: 表格数据是科学和工业界高价值预测问题的基础，TabPFN 推动了该模态的基础模型革命。

目的: 在 TabPFN 的基础上构建 TabPFN-3，旨在将最先进的性能扩展到拥有 100 万训练行的大型数据集，同时大幅减少训练和推理时间。

方法: 基于用户反馈，在合成数据上进行预训练，引入测试时计算扩展，并采用减少 KV 缓存和行分块技术。

主要发现: 在标准表格基准 TabArena 上，TabPFN-3 的单次前向传播显著优于所有其他模型；在更多样化的数据集上，在多类数据集上排名第一，并在大型数据集上击败了 8 小时调优的梯度提升树基线；在关系数据和表格文本数据上实现了新的最先进性能；API 版本 TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking) 在 TabArena 上 Elo 分数超过 200，在最大数据子集上达到 420，且比 AutoGluon 1.5 极端版本快 10 倍。

结论: TabPFN-3 成功将表格预测的边界向前推进，在保持高推理速度的同时，在时间序列、关系和表格文本数据上带来了显著收益，并实现了 SOTA 预测能力。

翻译: 表格数据是科学和工业界大多数高价值预测问题的基础，TabPFN 推动了该模态的基础模型革命。基于用户反馈设计的 TabPFN-3 在此基础上构建，将最先进的性能扩展到拥有 100 万训练行的大型数据集，并大幅减少了训练和推理时间。TabPFN-3 独家在合成数据上进行预训练，极大地推动了表格预测的边界，并在时间序列、关系和表格文本数据上带来了显著收益。在标准表格基准 TabArena 上，TabPFN-3 的单次前向传播显著优于所有其他模型，包括调优和集成基线，并且支配了速度/性能前沿。在更多样化的数据集上，TabPFN-3 在多类数据集上排名第一，并在最多 100 万训练行和 200 个特征的数据集上击败了 8 小时调优的梯度提升树基线。TabPFN-3 引入了测试时计算扩展到表格基础模型。我们的 API 提供的 TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking) 利用这一点在 TabArena 上击败了所有非 TabPFN 模型超过 200 Elo，在最大的数据子集上上升到 420 Elo，并且比 AutoGluon 1.5 极端版本快 10 倍，不使用 LLM、真实数据、互联网搜索或除 TabPFN 以外的任何其他模型。TabPFN-3 扩展了我们模型的能力，在关系数据（RelBenchV1 上的新 SOTA 基础模型）和表格文本数据（通过 TabPFN-3-Plus 在 TabSTAR 上达到 SOTA）上实现 SOTA 预测；并改进了现有集成：专门的检查点 TabPFN-TS-3 在时间序列基准 fev-bench 上排名第二，SHAP 值计算快 120 倍。TabPFN-3 在此性能的同时比 TabPFN-2.5 快 20 倍。此外，减少的 KV 缓存和行分块技术使得在单个 H100 上扩展到 100 万行并实现快速推理成为可能。

Abstract

Tabular data underpins most high-value prediction problems in science and industry, and TabPFN has driven the foundation model revolution for this modality. Designed with feedback from our users, TabPFN-3 builds on this foundation to scale state-of-the-art performance to datasets with 1M training rows and substantially reduce training and inference time. Pretrained exclusively on synthetic data from our prior, TabPFN-3 dramatically pushes the frontier of tabular prediction and brings substantial gains on time series, relational, and tabular-text data. On the standard tabular benchmark TabArena, a forward pass of TabPFN-3 outperforms all other models, including tuned and ensembled baselines, by a significant margin, and pareto-dominates the speed/performance frontier. On more diverse datasets, TabPFN-3 ranks first on datasets with many classes, and beats 8-hour-tuned gradient-boosted-tree baselines on datasets up to 1M training rows and 200 features. TabPFN-3 introduces test-time compute scaling to tabular foundation models. Our API offering TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking) exploits this to beat all non-TabPFN models by over 200 Elo on TabArena, rising to 420 Elo on the largest data subset, and outperforms AutoGluon 1.5 extreme while being 10x faster, without using LLMs, real data, internet search or any other model besides TabPFN. TabPFN-3 extends the capabilities of our models, enabling SOTA prediction on relational data (new SOTA foundation model on RelBenchV1) and tabular-text data (SOTA on TabSTAR via TabPFN-3-Plus); and improves existing integrations: a specialized checkpoint, TabPFN-TS-3, ranks 2nd on the time-series benchmark fev-bench, and SHAP-value computation is up to 120x faster. TabPFN-3 achieves this performance while being up to 20x faster than TabPFN-2.5. In addition, a reduced KV cache and row-chunking scale to 1M rows on one H100 with fast inference speed.

item.title: Masked Autoencoders with Limited Data: Does It Work? A Fine-Grained Bioacoustics Case Study
item.author: Wuao Liu, Mustafa Chasmai, Subhransu Maji, Grant Van Horn
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究探讨了在中等规模的生物声学分类任务中，掩码自编码器预训练的有效性。

背景: 生物声学识别需要精细的声学理解来区分相似物种，但大型数据集如iNaturalist标注较弱，仅包含单物种标签，导致监督学习困难。

目的: 系统研究在iNatSounds数据集上进行MAE预训练对物种分类的影响，分析预训练数据规模、领域特异性、数据筛选和迁移策略。

方法: 通过分析预训练数据规模、领域特异性、数据筛选和迁移策略，研究MAE预训练在中等规模生物声学设置下的效果。

主要发现: 在通用音频数据上预训练的模型在iNatSounds上表现最佳；在特定领域数据上进行额外的掩码重建预训练收益有限甚至可能降低性能；在数据规模有限时，选择性数据筛选优势微乎其微。

结论: 在中等规模的细粒度生物声学设置中，预训练规模主导了目标设计，这进一步明确了MAE预训练何时有效，并为有限监督下的模型选择提供了实用指导。

翻译: Bioacoustic recognition requires fine-grained acoustic understanding to distinguish similar-sounding species. However, many large-scale data repositories such as iNaturalist are weakly annotated, often with only a single positive species label per recording, making supervised learning particularly challenging. Inspired by advances in computer vision, recent approaches have shifted toward self-supervised learning to capture the underlying structure of audio without relying on exhaustive annotations. In particular, masked autoencoders (MAE) have shown strong transferability on massive audio corpora, yet their effectiveness in more modest bioacoustic settings remains underexplored. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of MAE pretraining for species classification on iNatSounds, analyzing the impacts of pretraining data scale, domain specificity, data curation, and transfer strategies. Consistent with prior work, we find that models pretrained on diverse general audio data achieve the best transfer performance on iNatSounds. Contrary to observations from large-scale audio benchmarks, we find that (1) additional masked reconstruction pretraining on domain-specific data provides limited benefits and may even degrade performance relative to off-the-shelf models, and (2) selective data filtering offers a negligible advantage when the overall data scale is limited. Our results indicate that, in moderate-sized fine-grained bioacoustic settings, pretraining scale dominates objective design. These findings further clarify when MAE-based pretraining is effective and provide practical guidance for model selection under limited supervision.

Abstract

Bioacoustic recognition requires fine-grained acoustic understanding to distinguish similar-sounding species. However, many large-scale data repositories such as iNaturalist are weakly annotated, often with only a single positive species label per recording, making supervised learning particularly challenging. Inspired by advances in computer vision, recent approaches have shifted toward self-supervised learning to capture the underlying structure of audio without relying on exhaustive annotations. In particular, masked autoencoders (MAE) have shown strong transferability on massive audio corpora, yet their effectiveness in more modest bioacoustic settings remains underexplored. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of MAE pretraining for species classification on iNatSounds, analyzing the impacts of pretraining data scale, domain specificity, data curation, and transfer strategies. Consistent with prior work, we find that models pretrained on diverse general audio data achieve the best transfer performance on iNatSounds. Contrary to observations from large-scale audio benchmarks, we find that (1) additional masked reconstruction pretraining on domain-specific data provides limited benefits and may even degrade performance relative to off-the-shelf models, and (2) selective data filtering offers a negligible advantage when the overall data scale is limited. Our results indicate that, in moderate-sized fine-grained bioacoustic settings, pretraining scale dominates objective design. These findings further clarify when MAE-based pretraining is effective and provide practical guidance for model selection under limited supervision.

item.title: Network-Aware Bilinear Tokenization for Brain Functional Connectivity Representation Learning
item.author: Leo Milecki, Qingyu Hu, Bahram Jafrasteh, Mert R. Sabuncu, Qingyu Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: NERVE是一个基于自监督学习的框架，通过双线性分解重新定义功能连接矩阵的分词方式，以更好地对齐大脑网络的自组织结构。

背景: 现有的掩码自编码器方法通常采用基于区域或图结构的方案，将功能连接矩阵视为结构同质的元素，忽略了大规模脑网络的自组织结构。

目的: 解决如何对功能连接矩阵进行分词以对齐大脑网络自组织结构这一基本问题。

方法: NERVE框架将功能连接矩阵划分为包含网络内和网络间连接块的补丁，并通过新颖的结构化双线性分解嵌入这些补丁，从而保持网络身份并将参数复杂度从二次方降低到线性。

主要发现: 在三个大规模发育队列（ABCD、PNC和CCNP）上的评估显示，与结构无关的掩码自编码器变体和基于图的自监督基线相比，该网络感知公式产生了更稳定和可迁移的表示，特别是在跨队列评估中。

结论: 双线性网络嵌入和解剖学基础的划分对于性能至关重要，这些发现强调了在功能连接组学中结合领域特定的结构先验的重要性。

翻译: Masked autoencoders (MAEs) 最近在静息态脑功能连接 (FC) 的自监督表示学习中显示出前景。然而，一个基本问题仍未解决：FC 矩阵应该如何分词以对齐大规模脑网络的自组织结构？现有的方法通常采用基于区域或图结构的方案，将 FC 视为结构同质的元素，并忽略了大规模脑网络的自组织结构。我们介绍了 NERVE（通过双线性分词实现网络感知的功能连接表示），这是一个自监督学习框架，通过将 FC 矩阵划分为包含网络内和网络间连接块的补丁来重新定义 FC 分词。与基于图像的 MAE 不同，固定大小的补丁共享通用的分词器，由网络对定义的 FC 补丁在大小上是异构的，并且对应不同的功能角色。为了解决这个问题，NERVE 通过新颖的结构化双线性分解嵌入 FC 补丁。这种公式保持了网络身份，并将参数复杂度从二次方降低到网络数量的线性缩放。我们在三个大规模发育队列（ABCD、PNC 和 CCNP）上评估了 NERVE，用于行为和精神病理学预测。与结构无关的 MAE 变体和基于图的自监督基线相比，提出的网络感知公式产生了更稳定和可迁移的表示，特别是在跨队列评估中。消融研究证实，提出的双线性网络嵌入和解剖学基础的划分对于性能至关重要。这些发现强调了在功能连接组学中结合领域特定的结构先验的重要性。

Abstract

Masked autoencoders (MAEs) have recently shown promise for self-supervised representation learning of resting-state brain functional connectivity (FC). However, a fundamental question remains unresolved: how should FC matrices be tokenized to align with the intrinsic modular organization of large-scale brain networks? Existing approaches typically adopt region-centric or graph-based schemes that treat FC as structurally homogeneous elements and overlook the large-scale network brain organization. We introduce NERVE (Network-Aware Representations of Brain Functional Connectivity via Bilinear Tokenization), a self-supervised learning framework that redefines FC tokenization by partitioning FC matrices into patches of intra- and inter-network connectivity blocks. Unlike image-based MAE, where fixed-size patches share a common tokenizer, FC patches defined by network pairs are heterogeneous in size and correspond to distinct functional roles. To resolve this problem, NERVE embeds FC patches through a novel structured bilinear factorization. This formulation preserves network identity and reduces parameter complexity from quadratic to linear scaling in the number of networks. We evaluate NERVE across three large-scale developmental cohorts (ABCD, PNC, and CCNP) for behavior and psychopathology prediction. Compared to structurally agnostic MAE variants and graph-based self-supervised baselines, the proposed network-aware formulation yields more stable and transferable representations, particularly in cross-cohort evaluation. Ablation studies confirm that the proposed bilinear network embedding and anatomically grounded parcellation are critical for performance. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating domain-specific structural priors into self-supervised learning for functional connectomics.

item.title: SPIN: Structural LLM Planning via Iterative Navigation for Industrial Tasks
item.author: Ozaki, Yusuke, Patel, Dhaval
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SPIN是一个结合了DAG规划和基于前缀执行控制的规划包装器，旨在解决工业LLM代理系统中规划与执行分离导致的问题。

背景: 工业LLM代理系统通常将规划与执行分离，但LLM规划器经常产生结构无效或过长的工作流，导致脆弱的失败和避免的工具及API成本。

目的: 提出SPIN，一种规划包装器，通过结合验证过的有向无环图（DAG）规划和基于前缀的执行控制，以产生可执行的计划并减少不必要的工具调用。

方法: SPIN通过_validate_plan_text和修复提示强制执行严格的DAG契约，在下游执行前产生可执行计划，然后增量评估DAG前缀，当当前前缀足以回答查询时停止。

主要发现: 在AssetOpsBench上，SPIN将执行任务从1061减少到623，将Accomplished从0.638提高到0.706，并将每次运行的工具调用从11.81减少到6.82。在MCP Bench上，该包装器提高了GPT OSS1和Llama 4 Maverick的规划、接地和依赖相关评分。

结论: SPIN通过强制DAG结构和增量前缀评估，显著减少了执行任务数量和工具调用次数，同时提高了任务完成率和相关评分。

翻译: 工业大语言模型代理系统通常将规划与执行分离，但大语言模型规划器经常产生结构无效或过长的工作流，导致脆弱的失败和可避免的工具及API成本。我们提出了SPIN，一种结合了验证过的有向无环图（DAG）规划和基于前缀的执行控制的规划包装器。SPIN通过_validate_plan_text和修复提示强制执行严格的DAG契约，在下游执行前产生可执行计划，然后增量评估DAG前缀，当当前前缀足以回答查询时停止。在AssetOpsBench上，在261个场景中，SPIN将执行任务从1061减少到623，将Accomplished从0.638提高到0.706，同时将每次运行的工具调用从11.81减少到6.82。在MCP Bench上，相同的包装器提高了GPT OSS1和Llama 4 Maverick的规划、接地和依赖相关评分。
