Abstract

Recent feed-forward reconstruction models, such as VGGT, have proven competitive with traditional optimization-based reconstructors while also providing geometry-aware features useful for other tasks. Here, we show that the quality of these models scales predictably with model and data size. We do so by introducing VGGT-$Ω$, which substantially improves reconstruction accuracy, efficiency, and capabilities for both static and dynamic scenes. To enable training this model at an unprecedented scale, we introduce architectural changes that improve training efficiency, a high-quality data annotation pipeline that supports dynamic scenes, and a self-supervised learning protocol. We simplify VGGT's architecture by using a single dense prediction head with multi-task supervision and removing the expensive high-resolution convolutional layers. We also use registers to aggregate scene information into a compact representation and introduce register attention, which restricts inter-frame information exchange to these registers, in part replacing global attention. In this way, during training, VGGT-$Ω$ uses only about 30% of the GPU memory of its predecessor, allowing us to train with 15x more supervised data than prior work and to leverage vast amounts of unlabeled video data. VGGT-$Ω$ achieves strong results for reconstruction of static and dynamic scenes across multiple benchmarks, for example, improving over the previous best camera estimation accuracy on Sintel by 77%. We also show that the learned registers can improve vision-language-action models and support alignment with language, suggesting that reconstruction can be a powerful and scalable proxy task for spatial understanding. Project Page: http://vggt-omega.github.io/

item.title: ATLAS: Agentic or Latent Visual Reasoning? One Word is Enough for Both
item.author: Guo, Ziyu, Liu, Rain, Chen, Xinyan, Heng, Pheng-Ann
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ATLAS框架通过单一离散功能标记结合代理推理和潜在推理的优势，避免了中间视觉内容生成的冗长性，并保持了与标准可扩展SFT和RL训练的兼容性。

背景: 视觉推理是领域内的一个有前景的方向，但直接生成图像的方法计算昂贵且架构复杂。代理推理方法存在外部执行导致的上下文切换延迟，而潜在推理方法缺乏任务泛化能力且难以进行自回归并行化训练。

目的: 结合代理推理和潜在推理的优势，同时缓解它们的局限性，提出ATLAS框架。

方法: ATLAS框架中，一个单一的离散功能标记既作为代理操作又作为潜在视觉推理单元。每个功能标记与内部化的视觉操作相关联，不需要视觉监督，且是分词器词汇表中的标准标记，可以通过下一个标记预测生成。为了解决RL期间功能标记的稀疏性，引入了Latent-Anchored GRPO（LA-GRPO），通过静态加权的辅助目标锚定功能标记以稳定训练。

主要发现: ATLAS在具有挑战性的基准测试中实现了优越的性能，同时保持了清晰的解释性。

结论: ATLAS提供了一种新的范式，有望激发未来的视觉推理研究。

翻译: 视觉推理，通常与中间视觉状态交织在一起，已成为该领域的一个有前景的方向。一种直接的方法是在推理过程中通过统一模型生成图像，但这计算昂贵且架构复杂。最近的替代方案包括通过代码或工具调用进行代理推理，以及使用可学习的隐藏嵌入进行潜在推理。然而，代理方法会因外部执行而产生上下文切换延迟，而潜在方法缺乏任务泛化能力，且难以进行自回归并行化训练。为了结合它们的优势同时缓解它们的局限性，我们提出了ATLAS，一个框架，其中单个离散的“词”，称为功能标记，既作为代理操作又作为潜在视觉推理单元。每个功能标记都与内部化的视觉操作相关联，但不需要视觉监督，并且是分词器词汇表中的标准标记，可以通过下一个标记预测生成。这种设计避免了冗长的中间视觉内容生成，同时保持了与普通可扩展SFT和RL训练的兼容性，无需架构或方法上的修改。为了进一步解决RL期间功能标记的稀疏性，我们引入了Latent-Anchored GRPO（LA-GRPO），它通过静态加权的辅助目标锚定功能标记来稳定训练，提供更强的梯度更新。广泛的实验和分析表明，ATLAS在具有挑战性的基准测试中实现了优越的性能，同时保持了清晰的解释性。我们希望ATLAS提供一种新的范式，激发未来的视觉推理研究。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Visual reasoning, often interleaved with intermediate visual states, has emerged as a promising direction in the field. A straightforward approach is to directly generate images via unified models during reasoning, but this is computationally expensive and architecturally non-trivial. Recent alternatives include agentic reasoning through code or tool calls, and latent reasoning with learnable hidden embeddings. However, agentic methods incur context-switching latency from external execution, while latent methods lack task generalization and are difficult to train with autoregressive parallelization. To combine their strengths while mitigating their limitations, we propose ATLAS, a framework in which a single discrete 'word', termed as a functional token, serves both as an agentic operation and a latent visual reasoning unit. Each functional token is associated with an internalized visual operation, yet requires no visual supervision and remains a standard token in the tokenizer vocabulary, which can be generated via next-token prediction. This design avoids verbose intermediate visual content generation, while preserving compatibility with the vanilla scalable SFT and RL training, without architectural or methodological modifications. To further address the sparsity of functional tokens during RL, we introduce Latent-Anchored GRPO (LA-GRPO), which stabilizes the training by anchoring functional tokens with a statically weighted auxiliary objective, providing stronger gradient updates. Extensive experiments and analyses demonstrate that ATLAS achieves superior performance on challenging benchmarks while maintaining clear interpretability. We hope ATLAS offers a new paradigm inspiring future visual reasoning research.

item.title: FAAST: Forward-Only Associative Learning via Closed-Form Fast Weights for Test-Time Supervised Adaptation
item.author: Bao, Guangsheng, Zhang, Hongbo, Cui, Han, Sun, Ke, Zhao, Yanbin, He, Juncai, Zhang, Yue
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FAAST的前向关联适应方法，通过单次传递将标记示例编译为快速权重，以实现高效的监督任务适应。

背景: 预训练模型的适应通常涉及反向传播的高训练成本与基于内存或上下文学习的繁重推理开销之间的权衡。

目的: 提出一种仅前向的关联适应方法，以消除内存或上下文依赖，实现常数时间推理，并将任务适应与预训练表示解耦。

方法: FAAST是一种仅前向的关联适应方法，通过单次传递将标记示例分析编译为快速权重。

主要发现: 在图像分类和语言建模基准测试中，FAAST匹配或超过了基于反向传播的适应，同时适应时间减少了90%以上；与基于内存/上下文的适应相比，内存使用量节省高达95%。

结论: FAAST是一种高度高效、可扩展的监督任务适应解决方案，特别适用于资源受限的模型。

翻译: 本文提出了一种名为FAAST的前向关联适应方法，通过单次传递将标记示例编译为快速权重，以实现高效的监督任务适应。

Abstract

Adapting pretrained models typically involves a trade-off between the high training costs of backpropagation and the heavy inference overhead of memory-based or in-context learning. We propose FAAST, a forward-only associative adaptation method that analytically compiles labeled examples into fast weights in a single pass. By eliminating memory or context dependence, FAAST achieves constant-time inference and decouples task adaptation from pretrained representation. Across image classification and language modeling benchmarks, FAAST matches or exceeds backprop-based adaptation while reducing adaptation time by over 90% and is competitive to memory/context-based adaptation while saving memory usage by up to 95%. These results demonstrate FAAST as a highly efficient, scalable solution for supervised task adaptation, particularly for resource-constrained models. We release the code and models at this https URL .

item.title: Retrieval from Within: An Intrinsic Capability of Attention-Based Models
item.author: Hoffer, Elad, Blau, Yochai, Kinderman, Edan, Banner, Ron, Soudry, Daniel, Ginsburg, Boris
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种名为INTRA的框架，旨在通过注意力机制将检索和生成过程统一在一个模型中。

背景: 传统的检索增强生成（RAG）方法通常将检索和生成视为两个独立的系统，导致检索器和生成器之间存在不匹配。

目的: 研究是否可以通过基于注意力的编码器-解码器模型直接从其内部表示中进行检索，从而统一检索和生成过程。

方法: 提出了INTRA框架，其中解码器注意力查询对预编码的证据片段进行评分，并将这些片段直接重用为生成的上下文。该设计通过在查询之间重用预计算的编码器状态来分摊上下文编码。

主要发现: 在问答基准测试中，INTRA在证据召回率和端到端答案质量方面均优于强大的工程化检索管道。

结论: 结果表明，基于注意力的模型已经具备了一种可以被激发的检索机制，而无需将其作为外部模块添加。

翻译: 检索增强生成（RAG）通常将检索和生成视为两个独立的系统。我们询问基于注意力的编码器-解码器是否可以直接从其内部表示中进行检索。我们介绍了INTRA（通过注意力进行内在检索），这是一个框架，其中解码器注意力查询对预编码的证据片段进行评分，然后将这些片段直接重用为生成的上下文。通过构造，INTRA统一了检索和生成，消除了RAG管道中典型的检索器-生成器不匹配。这种设计还通过在查询之间重用预计算的编码器状态来分摊上下文编码。在问答基准测试中，INTRA在证据召回率和端到端答案质量方面均优于强大的工程化检索管道。我们的结果表明，基于注意力的模型已经具备了一种可以被激发的检索机制，而不是将其作为外部模块添加。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically treats retrieval and generation as separate systems. We ask whether an attention-based encoder-decoder can instead retrieve directly from its own internal representations. We introduce INTRA (INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention), a framework where decoder attention queries score pre-encoded evidence chunks that are then directly reused as context for generation. By construction, INTRA unifies retrieval and generation, eliminating the retriever-generator mismatch typical of RAG pipelines. This design also amortizes context encoding by reusing precomputed encoder states across queries. On question-answering benchmarks, INTRA outperforms strong engineered retrieval pipelines on both evidence recall and end-to-end answer quality. Our results demonstrate that attention-based models already possess a retrieval mechanism that can be elicited, rather than added as an external module.

item.title: GEM: Generating LiDAR World Model via Deformable Mamba
item.author: Yang Wu, Zhaojiang Liu, Qiang Meng, Youquan Liu, Renliang Weng, Jianjun Qian, Jian Yang, Jin Xie
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: GEM是一种基于可变形Mamba架构的生成式激光雷达世界模型，旨在解决激光雷达点云的固有混乱和动态物体与静态结构区分困难的问题，通过场景标记化、动态静态分离和可变形Mamba处理，显著提升了世界模型的保真度和想象力，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。

背景: 基于激光雷达的世界模型进展落后于基于相机视频或占用数据的世界模型，主要归因于两个核心挑战：激光雷达点云的固有混乱以及区分动态物体与静态结构的困难。

目的: 提出GEM，一种生成式激光雷达世界模型，利用可变形Mamba架构来提高世界模型的保真度和想象力。

方法: 1. 利用激光雷达扫描与Mamba处理机制的结构相似性，通过自定义的激光雷达场景标记器将激光雷达扫描转换为紧凑表示。2. 通过动态静态分离器对标记化的特征进行无监督解耦。3. 引入三路径可变形Mamba，对解耦的特征进行选择性扫描和自适应门控融合。4. 可选地集成规划器和BEV布局控制器以探索模型在自主回放和生成“假设”场景方面的能力。

主要发现: GEM在广泛的基准测试和评估设置中取得了最先进的性能，证明了其优越性和有效性。

结论: GEM通过解决激光雷达点云的固有混乱和动态物体与静态结构区分困难的问题，显著提升了世界模型的保真度和想象力，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。

翻译: 基于激光雷达的世界模型，能够模拟环境动态并生成传感器观测，在自动驾驶领域正受到越来越多的关注。然而，基于激光雷达的世界模型进展落后于基于相机视频或占用数据构建的世界模型，主要归因于两个核心挑战：激光雷达点云的固有混乱以及区分动态物体与静态结构的困难。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了GEM：一种生成式激光雷达世界模型，利用可变形Mamba架构，显著提高了保真度和想象力。具体而言，利用激光雷达扫描与Mamba处理机制之间的结构相似性，我们首先通过自定义的激光雷达场景标记器将激光雷达扫描转换为紧凑表示。在通过动态静态分离器对标记化的特征进行无监督解耦后，引入了三路径可变形Mamba，对解耦的特征进行选择性扫描和自适应门控融合，从而增强了对世界演化的时空理解。可选地，可以集成规划器和BEV布局控制器，以探索模型在自主回放和生成“假设”场景方面的能力。广泛的实验表明，GEM在各种基准测试和评估设置中取得了最先进的性能，证明了其优越性和有效性。项目页面：https://github.com/wuyang98/GEM。

Abstract

World models, which simulate environmental dynamics and generate sensor observations, are gaining increasing attention in autonomous driving. However, progress in LiDAR-based world models has lagged behind those built on camera videos or occupancy data, primarily due to two core challenges: the inherent disorder of LiDAR point clouds and the difficulty of distinguishing dynamic objects from static structures. To address these issues, we propose GEM: a Generative LiDAR world model that leverages deformable mamba architecture, significantly improving fidelity and imaginative capability. Specifically, leveraging the structural similarity between sequential laser scanning and Mamba's processing mechanism, we first tokenize LiDAR sweeps into compact representations via a custom LiDAR scene tokenizer. After unsupervised disentanglement of tokenized features via a dynamic-static separator, a tri-path deformable Mamba is introduced to perform selective scanning and adaptive gating fusion over the disentangled features, leading to enhanced spatial-temporal understanding of the world evolution. Optionally, a planner and a BEV layout controller can be integrated to explore the model's capability for autonomous rollout and its potential to generate ``what-if" scenarios. Extensive experiments show that GEM achieves state-of-the-art performances across diverse benchmarks and evaluation settings, demonstrating its superiority and effectiveness. Project page: https://github.com/wuyang98/GEM.

item.title: The Extrapolation Cliff in On-Policy Distillation of Near-Deterministic Structured Outputs
item.author: Li, Xin, Jiang, Hao, Wang, Annan, Zhang, Yichi, Yuen, Chau
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究提出了基于策略蒸馏在大型语言模型后训练中的应用，特别是在结构化输出任务中，当奖励外推系数超过特定阈值时，模型输出格式会从保持格式转变为格式崩溃。

背景: On-policy distillation (OPD) 是广泛用于 LLM 后训练的方法。在结构化输出任务中，当奖励外推系数 lambda 大于 1 时，学生模型可以在领域内超越教师模型，但超过特定阈值 lambda* 后，会违反输出契约。

目的: 通过单位置伯努利约简，推导出确定安全阈值 lambda* 的闭式公式，该公式由教师模态概率、预热启动质量和重要性采样裁剪强度三个可测量量决定。

方法: 研究将规则扩展到校准的 K 元列表式 JSON 任务，并在亚马逊时尚数据集上进行了三个预注册测试，包括细网格悬崖区间、预算扩展测试和小裁剪交叉预测。

主要发现: 在 lambda* 临界值附近，ListOPD 使 1.7B Qwen3 学生模型以五分之一的参数量达到与 8B-SFT 基线模型同域的同等性能；性能增益主要由格式遵守驱动；悬崖诊断与评分标准无关。

结论: 当 lambda 低于 lambda* 时，训练保持格式安全；超过该阈值后，训练转变为格式崩溃；模型在解析输出上的 NDCG@1 指标在 lambda 跨度上保持平坦，而解析有效性在预测边界处急剧变化。

翻译: On-policy distillation (OPD) 是广泛用于 LLM 后训练的方法。当用奖励外推系数 lambda > 1 推进时，学生模型可以在领域内超越教师模型，但在结构化输出任务中，超过阈值 lambda* 的相同步骤会违反输出契约。在单位置伯努利约简中，我们推导出由三个可测量量决定的闭式基相对裁剪安全阈值 lambda*(p,b,c)：教师模态概率、预热启动质量和重要性采样裁剪强度。在 lambda* 以上，外推固定点退出裁剪安全区域，将训练从保持格式转变为格式崩溃。我们将规则扩展到校准的 K 元列表式 JSON 任务，其中单个绑定等价类主导输出契约且 SFT 保留解析空间。在亚马逊时尚上，三个预注册测试——细网格悬崖区间、预算扩展测试和小裁剪交叉预测——落在其锁定预测窗口内，小裁剪值在网格分辨率以下与闭式预测相匹配。在 lambda* 附近操作，ListOPD 使 1.7B Qwen3 学生模型以五分之一的参数量达到与 8B-SFT 基线同域的同等性能。增益主要由格式遵守驱动：解析输出上的 NDCG@1 在 lambda 上保持平坦，而解析有效性在预测边界处急剧变化。悬崖诊断与评分标准无关，而同等性声明使用 Gemini 评分标准并继承了该评估者的暴露。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

On-policy distillation (OPD) is widely used for LLM post-training. When pushed with a reward-extrapolation coefficient lambda > 1, the student can lift past the teacher in domain, but past a threshold lambda* the same step violates the output contract on structured-output tasks. In a single-position Bernoulli reduction, we derive a closed-form base-relative clip-safety threshold lambda*(p,b,c) determined by three measurable quantities: the teacher modal probability, the warm-start mass, and the importance-sampling clip strength. Above lambda*, the extrapolated fixed point exits the clip-safe region, changing training from format-preserving to format-collapsing. We extend the rule to calibrated K-ary listwise JSON tasks where a single binding equivalence class dominates the output contract and SFT retains parse headroom. On Amazon Fashion, three pre-registered tests--a fine-grid cliff interval, a budget-extension test, and a small-clip cross-prediction--fall within their locked prediction windows, with the small-clip value matching the closed-form prediction below grid resolution. Operating just below lambda*, ListOPD brings a 1.7B Qwen3 student to in-domain parity with an 8B-SFT baseline at one-fifth the parameters. The gain is driven primarily by format adherence: NDCG@1 on parsed outputs remains flat across lambda, while parse validity sharply changes at the predicted boundary. The cliff diagnostic is rubric-independent, whereas the parity claim uses a Gemini-graded rubric and inherits that evaluator's exposure.

item.title: Offline Preference Optimization for Rectified Flow with Noise-Tracked Pairs
item.author: Lu, Yunhong, Wang, Qichao, Cao, Hengyuan, Xu, Xiaoyin, Zhang, Min
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PNAPO是一种针对直方流模型的离线对齐框架，通过保留生成图像的先验噪声并利用直方流生成轨迹的直线特性，提高了训练效率和稳定性。

背景: 现有的文本到图像模型的偏好数据集仅存储最终获胜/失败的图像，这种表示对于直方流模型是不够的，因为直方流模型的生成自然地由特定的先验噪声样本索引，并遵循几乎直线的去噪轨迹。

目的: 提出一种专门针对直方流模型的离线对齐框架，以解决现有方法中轨迹估计不匹配和不必要方差的问题，同时提高训练的稳定性和样本效率。

方法: PNAPO通过保留生成获胜和失败图像的成对先验噪声，将标准的三元组转换为六元组。利用直方流的直线特性，通过噪声-图像插值估计中间状态，从而限制轨迹估计空间并产生更紧的代理目标。此外，引入了一种基于获胜者和失败者奖励差距以及训练进展的动态正则化策略。

主要发现: 在最新的直方流文本到图像骨干模型上的实验表明，PNAPO在一致地提高偏好指标的同时，显著减少了训练计算量。

结论: PNAPO是一种有效的框架，能够显著降低训练计算量并提高训练效率，适用于直方流模型的对齐任务。

翻译: 现有用于文本到图像模型的偏好数据集通常仅存储最终的获胜者/失败者图像。这种表示对于直方流模型是不够的，因为其生成自然地由特定的先验噪声样本索引，并遵循几乎直线的去噪轨迹。相比之下，针对扩散模型的先验DPO风格对齐通常使用独立的正向噪声过程来估计轨迹，这可能与真实的反向动力学不匹配，并引入不必要的方差。我们提出了先验噪声感知偏好优化（PNAPO），这是一种专门针对直方流的离线对齐框架。PNAPO通过保留生成每个获胜者/失败者图像的成对先验噪声来增强偏好数据，将标准的三元组（提示，获胜者，失败者）转换为六元组。利用直方流的直线特性，我们通过噪声-图像插值估计中间状态，这限制了轨迹估计空间，并产生更紧的偏好优化代理目标。此外，我们引入了一种动态正则化策略，根据（i）获胜者和失败者之间的奖励差距和（ii）训练进展来调整DPO正则化，从而提高稳定性和样本效率。在最新的直方流文本到图像骨干模型上的实验表明，PNAPO一致地提高了偏好指标，同时显著减少了训练计算量。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Existing preference datasets for text-to-image models typically store only the final winner/loser images. This representation is insufficient for rectified flow (RF) models, whose generation is naturally indexed by a specific prior noise sample and follows a nearly straight denoising trajectory. In contrast, prior DPO-style alignment for diffusion models commonly estimates trajectories using an independent forward noising process, which can be mismatched to the true reverse dynamics and introduces unnecessary variance. We propose Prior Noise-Aware Preference Optimization (PNAPO), an off-policy alignment framework specialized for rectified flow. PNAPO augments preference data by retaining the paired prior noises used to generate each winner/loser image, turning the standard (prompt, winner, loser) triplet into a sextuple. Leveraging the straight-line property of RF, we estimate intermediate states via noise-image interpolation, which constrains the trajectory estimation space and yields a tighter surrogate objective for preference optimization. In addition, we introduce a dynamic regularization strategy that adapts the DPO regularization based on (i) the reward gap between winner and loser and (ii) training progress, improving stability and sample efficiency. Experiments on state-of-the-art RF T2I backbones show that PNAPO consistently improves preference metrics while substantially reducing training compute.

item.title: From Pixels to Concepts: Do Segmentation Models Understand What They Segment?
item.author: Liang, Shuang, Wang, Zeqing, Li, Yuxian, Liu, Xihui, Wang, Han
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了一个名为CAFE的新基准测试，用于评估提示分割模型在概念忠实度方面的表现，通过属性级反事实操纵来测试模型是否真正理解查询概念。

背景: 现有的提示分割模型如SAM3能够根据文本提示进行分割，但现有基准测试主要评估掩码准确性或物体存在性，无法确定模型是否真正基于查询概念进行分割，还是依赖视觉显著但语义误导的线索。

目的: 引入CAFE基准测试，旨在评估提示分割模型在概念忠实度方面的表现，诊断模型是否真正基于概念进行分割，而非依赖捷径进行掩码检索。

方法: CAFE基于属性级反事实操纵构建，保留目标区域和真实掩码，同时修改表面外观、上下文或材料组成等属性以引入误导性语义线索。基准包含2146对测试样本，每个样本包括目标图像、真实掩码、正向提示和误导性负向提示，覆盖三种反事实类别：表面模仿、上下文冲突和本体论冲突。

主要发现: 实验揭示了定位质量与概念区分之间存在系统性差距：模型往往对误导性提示也能生成准确的掩码，表明强大的掩码预测并不一定意味着忠实的语义基础。

结论: CAFE提供了一个受控的基准测试，用于诊断提示分割模型是否执行概念忠实的分割，而不是捷径驱动的掩码检索。

翻译: 分割是许多下游应用的基础视觉任务。最近的提示分割模型，如Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3)，将分割从类别无关的掩码预测扩展到基于高级文本提示的条件概念引导定位。然而，现有基准主要评估掩码准确性或物体存在性，不清楚这些模型是否忠实地定位了查询概念，还是依赖视觉显著但语义误导的线索。我们引入了CAFE：反事实属性真实性评估，这是一个用于评估提示分割模型中概念忠实分割的新基准。我们的CAFE建立在属性级反事实操纵之上：目标区域和真实掩码被保留，而表面外观、上下文或材料组成等属性被修改以引入误导性语义线索。该基准包含2146对测试样本，每个样本由目标图像、真实掩码、正向提示和误导性负向提示组成。这些样本覆盖三种反事实类别：表面模仿、上下文冲突和本体论冲突。我们在CAFE上评估了各种模型类型和大小。实验揭示了定位质量与概念区分之间的系统性差距：模型往往对误导性提示也能生成准确的掩码，表明强大的掩码预测并不一定意味着忠实的语义基础。CAFE提供了一个受控的基准测试，用于诊断提示分割模型是否执行概念忠实的分割，而不是捷径驱动的掩码检索。

Abstract

Segmentation is a fundamental vision task underlying numerous downstream applications. Recent promptable segmentation models, such as Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3), extend segmentation from category-agnostic mask prediction to concept-guided localization conditioned on high-level textual prompts. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate mask accuracy or object presence, leaving unclear whether these models faithfully ground the queried concept or instead rely on visually salient but semantically misleading cues. We introduce CAFE: \textbf{C}ounterfactual \textbf{A}ttribute \textbf{F}actuality \textbf{E}valuation, a novel benchmark for evaluating concept-faithful segmentation in promptable segmentation models. Our \textbf{CAFE} is built on attribute-level counterfactual manipulation: the target region and ground-truth mask are preserved, while attributes such as surface appearance, context, or material composition are modified to introduce misleading semantic cues. The benchmark contains 2,146 paired test samples, each consisting of a target image, a ground-truth mask, a positive prompt, and a misleading negative prompt. These samples cover three counterfactual categories: Superficial Mimicry (\textbf{SM}), Context Conflict (\textbf{CC}), and Ontological Conflict (\textbf{OC}). We evaluate various model types and sizes on our CAFE. Experiments reveal a systematic gap between localization quality and concept discrimination: models often generate accurate masks even for misleading prompts, suggesting that strong mask prediction does not necessarily imply faithful semantic grounding. Our CAFE provides a controlled benchmark for diagnosing whether promptable segmentation models perform concept-faithful grounding rather than shortcut-driven mask retrieval.

item.title: HAGE: Harnessing Agentic Memory via RL-Driven Weighted Graph Evolution
item.author: Jiang, Dongming, Li, Yi, Li, Guanpeng, Li, Qiannan, Li, Bingzhe
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为HAGE的加权多关系记忆框架，旨在解决代理大型语言模型系统中记忆检索的局限性。

背景: 现有的代理大型语言模型系统中的记忆检索通常被处理为静态查找问题，依赖于扁平向量搜索或固定的二元关系图。

目的: 为了解决固定图结构无法捕捉事件之间关系的变化强度、置信度和查询依赖相关性的问题。

方法: HAGE将检索重新构想为在统一关系记忆图上的顺序、查询条件遍历。记忆组织为共享记忆节点上的特定关系图视图，其中每条边都关联一个可训练的关系特征向量。给定查询时，基于LLM的分类器识别关系意图，路由网络动态调节边嵌入的相应维度。遍历分数通过语义相似度和这些查询条件边表示的学习组合来计算。此外，HAGE引入了基于强化学习的训练框架，以联合优化路由行为和边表示。

主要发现: 实证结果表明，与最先进的代理记忆系统相比，HAGE在长期推理准确性方面有所提高，并且具有更好的准确率-效率权衡。

结论: HAGE允许记忆遍历优先考虑高效用关系路径，同时柔和地抑制嘈杂或弱相关的连接。

翻译: 在代理大型语言模型（LLM）系统中，记忆检索通常被处理为静态查找问题，依赖于扁平向量搜索或固定的二元关系图。然而，固定图结构无法捕捉事件之间关系的变化强度、置信度和查询依赖相关性。在本文中，我们提出了HAGE，一个加权多关系记忆框架，它将检索重新构想为在统一关系记忆图上的顺序、查询条件遍历。记忆组织为共享记忆节点上的特定关系图视图，其中每条边都关联一个可训练的关系特征向量，编码多个关系信号。给定查询时，基于LLM的分类器识别关系意图，路由网络动态调节边嵌入的相应维度。遍历分数通过语义相似度和这些查询条件边表示的学习组合来计算。这允许记忆遍历优先考虑高效用关系路径，同时柔和地抑制嘈杂或弱相关的连接。除了自适应遍历外，HAGE进一步引入了基于强化学习的训练框架，使用下游任务联合优化路由行为和边表示。最后，实证结果证明了与最先进的代理记忆系统相比，在长期推理准确性方面的改进和有利的准确率-效率权衡。我们的代码可在该https URL处获得。

Abstract

Memory retrieval in agentic large language model (LLM) systems is often treated as a static lookup problem, relying on flat vector search or fixed binary relational graphs. However, fixed graph structures cannot capture the varying strength, confidence, and query-dependent relevance of relationships between events. In this paper, we propose HAGE, a weighted multi-relational memory framework that reconceptualizes retrieval as sequential, query-conditioned traversal over a unified relational memory graph. Memory is organized as relation-specific graph views over shared memory nodes, where each edge is associated with a trainable relation feature vector encoding multiple relational signals. Given a query, an LLM-based classifier identifies the relational intent, and a routing network dynamically modulates the corresponding dimensions of the edge embedding. Traversal scores are computed via a learned combination of semantic similarity and these query-conditioned edge representations. This allows memory traversal to prioritize high-utility relational paths while softly suppressing noisy or weakly relevant connections. Beyond adaptive traversal, HAGE further introduces a reinforcement learning-based training framework that jointly optimizes routing behavior and edge representations using downstream tasks. Finally, empirical results demonstrate improved long-horizon reasoning accuracy and a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off compared to state-of-the-art agentic memory systems. Our code is available at this https URL .

item.title: MemReread: Enhancing Agentic Long-Context Reasoning via Memory-Guided Rereading
item.author: Ji, Baibei, Weng, Xiaoyang, Li, Juntao, Tang, Zecheng, Lou, Yihang, Zhang, Min
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MemReread是一种基于流式阅读的框架，通过触发问题分解和重读来恢复被过早丢弃的间接事实，从而支持非线性推理并保持线性时间复杂度。

背景: 为了解决标准注意力机制在长上下文推理任务中的二次复杂度问题，基于代理记忆的方法应运而生，但它们在记忆形成过程中存在潜在证据丢失和无效查询干扰的问题。

目的: 克服检索召回在记忆形成过程中的证据丢失和无效查询干扰的限制，同时保持线性时间复杂度。

方法: MemReread基于流式阅读，在最终记忆不足时触发问题分解和重读，并引入强化学习框架来增强长度外推能力并动态确定重读次数。

主要发现: MemReread在长上下文推理任务上 consistently 优于基线框架。

结论: MemReread支持非线性推理，同时保持与上下文长度相关的线性时间复杂度。

翻译: 为了解决标准注意力机制在长上下文推理任务中的二次复杂度问题，基于代理记忆的方法应运而生，它们通常在线性处理文档块时维护动态更新的记忆。为了缓解这种记忆-阅读范式中潜在潜在证据的丢失，近期工作集成了检索模块，允许代理在记忆覆盖期间回忆之前丢弃的信息。然而，检索召回在记忆形成过程中遭受证据丢失和无效查询引起的干扰。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了MemReread。建立在流式阅读之上，MemReread避免了中间检索。当最终记忆不足时，它触发问题分解和重读，从而恢复被过早丢弃的间接事实。这种设计支持非线性推理，同时保持了文档理解的固有逻辑流。为了进一步提高实用性，我们引入了一个强化学习框架，增强了长度外推能力，同时根据任务复杂性动态确定重读次数，从而灵活控制计算开销。广泛的实验表明，MemReread在长上下文推理任务上始终优于基线框架，同时保持与上下文长度相关的线性时间复杂度。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为 MemReread 的方法，通过记忆引导重读机制，来增强智能体在长上下文环境下的推理能力。

Abstract

To tackle long-context reasoning tasks without the quadratic complexity of standard attention mechanisms, approaches based on agent memory have emerged, which typically maintain a dynamically updated memory when linearly processing document chunks. To mitigate the potential loss of latent evidence in this memorize-while-reading paradigm, recent works have integrated retrieval modules that allow agents to recall information previously discarded during memory overwriting. However, retrieval-based recall suffers from both evidence loss during memory formation and interference induced by invalid queries. To overcome these limitations, we propose MemReread. Built upon streaming reading, MemReread circumvents intermediate retrieval. It triggers question decomposition and rereading when the final memory is insufficient, enabling the recovery of indirect facts that were prematurely discarded. This design supports non-linear reasoning while preserving the inherent logical flow of document comprehension. To further enhance practicality, we introduce a reinforcement learning framework that enhances length extrapolation capability while dynamically determining the number of rereading passes based on task complexity, thereby flexibly controlling computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MemReread consistently outperforms baseline frameworks on long-context reasoning tasks, while maintaining linear time complexity with respect to context length.

item.title: MulTaBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Tabular Learning with Text and Image
item.author: Arazi, Alan, Shapira, Eilam, Grunblat, Shoham, Ventura, Mor, Hoffer, Elad, Blayer, Gioia, Holzmüller, David, Purucker, Lennart, Varoquaux, Gaël, Hutter, Frank, Reichart, Roi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了MulTaBench基准测试，包含40个数据集，涵盖图像-表格和文本-表格任务，旨在研究互补预测信号和目标感知表示对多模态表格学习的影响。

背景: 表格基础模型在监督表格学习中取得了最先进性能，但缺乏对文本和图像等非结构化模态的原生支持，且依赖冻结的预训练嵌入。

目的: 为了解决现有基准测试往往关注模态共存而忽视任务特定调整的问题，引入MulTaBench基准测试，重点关注互补预测信号和目标感知表示。

方法: 构建了包含40个数据集的MulTaBench基准测试，分为图像-表格和文本-表格任务，涵盖医疗和电子商务等高影响力领域。

主要发现: 目标感知表示调整在文本和图像模态、多种表格学习器和编码器规模上均能带来性能提升。

结论: MulTaBench是迄今为止最大的图像-表格基准测试，为开发结合联合建模和目标感知表示的新多模态表格基础模型铺平了道路。

翻译: 表格基础模型最近通过利用预训练来学习数值和分类结构化数据的可泛化表示，在监督表格学习中建立了最先进水平。然而，它们缺乏对文本和图像等非结构化模态的原生支持，且依赖冻结的预训练嵌入来处理它们。在既定的多模态表格学习基准测试中，我们发现将嵌入调整到任务上可以提高性能。然而，现有的基准测试往往关注模态的共存；这导致数据集之间的方差较高，并掩盖了任务特定调整的好处。为了解决这一差距，我们介绍了MulTaBench，这是一个包含40个数据集的基准测试，在图像-表格和文本-表格任务之间平均分配。我们专注于模态提供互补预测信号且通用嵌入丢失关键信息从而需要与任务对齐的目标感知表示的预测任务。我们的实验结果表明，目标感知表示调整带来的收益在文本和图像模态、几种表格学习器和嵌入维度上均能泛化。MulTaBench构成了迄今为止最大的图像-表格基准测试工作，跨越了医疗和电子商务等高影响力领域。它旨在促进研究结合联合建模和目标感知表示的新架构，为开发新的多模态表格基础模型铺平了道路。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决多模态表格学习领域缺乏统一基准的问题。在研究中，建立这样的基准有助于评估和比较不同模型在处理包含文本和图像的表格数据时的性能。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一个名为 MulTaBench 的新基准，用于测试结合文本和图像的多模态表格学习模型。

Abstract

Tabular Foundation Models have recently established the state of the art in supervised tabular learning, by leveraging pretraining to learn generalizable representations of numerical and categorical structured data. However, they lack native support for unstructured modalities such as text and image, and rely on frozen, pretrained embeddings to process them. On established Multimodal Tabular Learning benchmarks, we show that tuning the embeddings to the task improves performance. Existing benchmarks, however, often focus on the mere co-occurrence of modalities; this leads to high variance across datasets and masks the benefits of task-specific tuning. To address this gap, we introduce MulTaBench, a benchmark of 40 datasets, split equally between image-tabular and text-tabular tasks. We focus on predictive tasks where the modalities provide complementary predictive signal, and where generic embeddings lose critical information, necessitating Target-Aware Representations that are aligned with the task. Our experimental results demonstrate that the gains from target-aware representation tuning generalize across both text and image modalities, several tabular learners, encoder scales, and embedding dimensions. MulTaBench constitutes the largest image-tabular benchmarking effort to date, spanning high-impact domains such as healthcare and e-commerce. It is designed to enable the research of novel architectures which incorporate joint modeling and target-aware representations, paving the way for the development of novel Multimodal Tabular Foundation Models.

item.title: ShapeCodeBench: A Renewable Benchmark for Perception-to-Program Reconstruction of Synthetic Shape Scenes
item.author: Kumar, Shivam
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ShapeCodeBench是一个用于感知到程序重建的合成基准测试，要求模型根据渲染的图像生成可执行的绘图程序。

背景: 该基准测试旨在解决感知到程序重建的问题，通过合成数据来评估模型的能力。

目的: 创建一个合成基准测试，用于评估模型从图像生成可执行绘图程序的能力，并减少精确实例污染。

方法: 使用v1 DSL在512x512画布上定义四种基本原语，通过种子随机数生成器生成实例，包含易、中、难三个难度等级。

主要发现: 经典计算机视觉启发式方法在简单场景中具有竞争力，但在重叠融合组件时失效；最强多模态配置保留了大部分前景结构，但受限于小参数误差，整体精确匹配率仍然较低。

结论: ShapeCodeBench远未饱和，基准测试代码、冻结数据集、运行结果和论文来源已发布以支持独立复制和扩展。

翻译: 我们介绍了ShapeCodeBench，这是一个用于感知到程序重建的合成基准测试：给定一个渲染的光栅图像，模型必须发出一个可执行的绘图程序，确定性评估器重新渲染并与目标进行比较。v1 DSL在512x512的黑白画布上有四种原语，但每个实例都由种子RNG生成，因此可以创建新的保留集来减少精确实例污染。我们发布了一个冻结的eval_v1分割，包含150个样本，分为易、中、难三个等级，通过精确匹配、像素精度、前景IoU、解析成功和执行成功进行评分。我们评估了一个空程序地板、一个经典计算机视觉启发式方法、Claude Opus 4.7（高和最大努力）以及GPT-5.5（中等和额外高推理努力）。启发式方法在简单场景中具有竞争力，但在重叠融合组件时失效；最强的多模态配置保留了大部分前景结构，但由于小参数误差仍无法实现精确匹配。最佳整体精确匹配仍然很低，因此ShapeCodeBench远未饱和。基准测试代码、冻结数据集、运行结果和论文来源已发布以支持独立复制和扩展。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决从合成形状场景的感知到程序重建的问题。这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？unknown。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一个名为 ShapeCodeBench 的可再生基准，用于合成形状场景的感知到程序重建。

Abstract

We introduce ShapeCodeBench, a synthetic benchmark for perception-to-program reconstruction: given a rendered raster image, a model must emit an executable drawing program that a deterministic evaluator re-renders and compares with the target. The v1 DSL has four primitives on a 512 x 512 black-on-white canvas, but every instance is generated from a seeded RNG, so fresh held-out sets can be created to reduce exact-instance contamination. We release a frozen eval_v1 split with 150 samples across easy, medium, and hard tiers, scored by exact match, pixel accuracy, foreground IoU, parse success, and execution success. We evaluate an empty-program floor, a classical computer-vision heuristic, Claude Opus 4.7 at high and max effort, and GPT-5.5 at medium and extra_high reasoning effort. The heuristic is competitive on easy scenes but collapses when overlaps fuse components; the strongest multimodal configuration preserves much of the foreground structure but still misses exact match because of small parameter errors. Best overall exact match remains low, so ShapeCodeBench is far from saturated. The benchmark code, frozen dataset, run artifacts, and paper sources are released to support independent replication and extension.

item.title: Learning Agentic Policy from Action Guidance
item.author: Ji, Yuxiang, Wang, Zengbin, Wang, Yong, Yang, Shidong, Ma, Ziyu, Chen, Guanhua, Sun, Zonghua, Wu, Liaoni, Chu, Xiangxiang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为ActGuide-RL的方法，通过利用人类交互中生成的丰富动作数据作为计划风格的参考指导，来增强大语言模型在智能体强化学习中的探索能力，从而克服无法到达奖励状态的障碍。

背景: 智能体强化学习严重依赖于基础策略的探索能力，因为训练信号仅在其能力范围之外产生。对于基础策略无法到达奖励状态的任务，需要额外的训练或外部指导来恢复有效的学习信号。

目的: 为了减少对昂贵迭代式监督微调的依赖，利用日常生活中生成的丰富动作数据，提出一种新的智能体强化学习范式。

方法: 提出ActGuide-RL方法，将动作数据作为计划风格的参考指导注入，使智能体策略克服到达奖励状态的障碍。随后，通过混合策略训练联合优化引导和无引导的展开，将探索收益内化回无引导策略中。采用最小干预原则，仅在需要时作为自适应后备调用指导，以匹配任务难度并最小化离策略风险。

主要发现: 在搜索代理基准测试中，ActGuide-RL显著优于零强化学习，在GAIA上提升了10.7个百分点，在XBench上提升了19个百分点（使用Qwen3-4B）。该方法与SFT+RL流程性能相当，且无需冷启动。

结论: 这表明了一种新的智能体强化学习范式，通过使用可扩展的动作指导来减少对大量SFT数据的依赖。

翻译: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) for Large Language Models (LLMs) critically depends on the exploration capability of the base policy, as training signals emerge only within its in-capability region. For tasks where the base policy cannot reach reward states, additional training or external guidance is needed to recover effective learning signals. Rather than relying on costly iterative supervised fine tuning (SFT), we exploit the abundant action data generated in everyday human interactions. We propose ActGuide-RL, which injects action data as plan-style reference guidance, enabling the agentic policy to overcome reachability barriers to reward states. Guided and unguided rollouts are then jointly optimized via mixed-policy training, internalizing the exploration gains back into the unguided policy. Motivated by a theoretical and empirical analysis of the benefit-risk trade-off, we adopt a minimal intervention principle that invokes guidance only as an adaptive fallback, matching task difficulty while minimizing off-policy risk. On search-agent benchmarks, ActGuide-RL substantially improves over zero RL (+10.7 pp on GAIA and +19 pp on XBench with Qwen3-4B), and performs on par with the SFT+RL pipeline without any cold start. This suggests a new paradigm for agentic RL that reduces the reliance on heavy SFT data by using scalable action guidance instead.

深度解读

Abstract

Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) for Large Language Models (LLMs) critically depends on the exploration capability of the base policy, as training signals emerge only within its in-capability region. For tasks where the base policy cannot reach reward states, additional training or external guidance is needed to recover effective learning signals. Rather than relying on costly iterative supervised fine tuning (SFT), we exploit the abundant action data generated in everyday human interactions. We propose \textsc{ActGuide-RL}, which injects action data as plan-style reference guidance, enabling the agentic policy to overcome reachability barriers to reward states. Guided and unguided rollouts are then jointly optimized via mixed-policy training, internalizing the exploration gains back into the unguided policy. Motivated by a theoretical and empirical analysis of the benefit-risk trade-off, we adopt a minimal intervention principle that invokes guidance only as an adaptive fallback, matching task difficulty while minimizing off-policy risk. On search-agent benchmarks, \textsc{ActGuide-RL} substantially improves over zero RL (+10.7 pp on GAIA and +19 pp on XBench with Qwen3-4B), and performs on par with the SFT+RL pipeline without any cold start. This suggests a new paradigm for agentic RL that reduces the reliance on heavy SFT data by using scalable action guidance instead.

item.title: MoCam: Unified Novel View Synthesis via Structured Denoising Dynamics
item.author: Haofeng Liu, Yang Zhou, Ziheng Wang, Zhengbo Xu, Zhan Peng, Jie Ma, Jun Liang, Shengfeng He, Jing Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MoCam通过结构化去噪动力学在扩散过程中协调几何和外观先验的进展，实现了从几何到外观的转换，从而统一了静态和动态视图合成。

背景: 生成式新颖视图合成面临一个基本困境：几何先验提供空间对齐但在视图变化下变得稀疏和不准确，而外观先验提供视觉保真度但缺乏几何对应关系。现有方法要么在整个生成过程中传播几何误差，要么在融合两者时遭受信号冲突。

目的: 介绍MoCam方法，通过结构化去噪动力学在扩散过程中协调几何和外观先验的进展，以解决几何和外观先验之间的冲突，实现鲁棒的几何-外观解耦。

方法: MoCam在早期阶段利用几何先验来锚定粗糙结构并容忍其不完整性，然后在后期阶段切换到外观先历来主动纠正几何误差并细化细节。这种方法在扩散过程中时间上解耦了几何对齐和外观细化。

主要发现: 实验表明MoCam显著优于先前方法，特别是在点云包含严重孔洞或扭曲的情况下，实现了鲁棒的几何-外观解耦。

结论: MoCam通过结构化去噪动力学在扩散过程中协调几何和外观先验的进展，实现了从几何到外观的转换，从而统一了静态和动态视图合成。

翻译: 生成式新颖视图合成面临一个基本困境：几何先验提供空间对齐但在视图变化下变得稀疏和不准确，而外观先验提供视觉保真度但缺乏几何对应关系。现有方法要么在整个生成过程中传播几何误差，要么在融合两者时遭受信号冲突。我们介绍了MoCam，它采用结构化去噪动力学在扩散过程中协调从几何到外观的进展。MoCam首先在早期阶段利用几何先验来锚定粗糙结构并容忍其不完整性，然后在后期阶段切换到外观先历来主动纠正几何误差并细化细节。这种设计通过在扩散过程中时间上解耦几何对齐和外观细化，自然地统一了静态和动态视图合成。实验表明MoCam显著优于先前方法，特别是在点云包含严重孔洞或扭曲的情况下，实现了鲁棒的几何-外观解耦。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Generative novel view synthesis faces a fundamental dilemma: geometric priors provide spatial alignment but become sparse and inaccurate under view changes, while appearance priors offer visual fidelity but lack geometric correspondence. Existing methods either propagate geometric errors throughout generation or suffer from signal conflicts when fusing both statically. We introduce MoCam, which employs structured denoising dynamics to orchestrate a coordinated progression from geometry to appearance within the diffusion process. MoCam first leverages geometric priors in early stages to anchor coarse structures and tolerate their incompleteness, then switches to appearance priors in later stages to actively correct geometric errors and refine details. This design naturally unifies static and dynamic view synthesis by temporally decoupling geometric alignment and appearance refinement within the diffusion process. Experiments demonstrate that MoCam significantly outperforms prior methods, particularly when point clouds contain severe holes or distortions, achieving robust geometry-appearance disentanglement.

item.title: VideoSEAL: Mitigating Evidence Misalignment in Agentic Long Video Understanding by Decoupling Answer Authority
item.author: Chenhao Qiu, Yechao Zhang, Xin Luo, Shien Song, Xusheng Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对长视频问答中证据错位的问题，提出解耦规划器-检查器框架，通过像素级验证提高准确性和证据一致性。

背景: 现有多模态大模型在长视频问答中面临长时域搜索和验证的挑战，且现有代理存在证据错位现象。

目的: 解决长视频问答中证据错位问题，提高答案准确性和证据一致性。

方法: 提出解耦规划器-检查器框架，将规划与答案权威分离，并在最终回答前进行像素级验证。

主要发现: 现有代理存在证据错位，由提示压力和奖励压力放大，根本原因是耦合代理范式混淆了长时域规划与答案权威。

结论: 解耦框架在四个长视频基准上提高了答案准确性和证据对齐，且具有可扩展性和模块化升级能力。

翻译: Long video question answering requires locating sparse, time-scattered visual evidence within highly redundant content. Although current MLLMs perform well on short videos, long videos introduce long-horizon search and verification, which often necessitates multi-turn, agentic interaction. We show that existing LVU agents can exhibit 'evidence misalignment': they produce correct answers that are not supported by the retrieved or inspected evidence. To characterize this failure, we introduce two diagnostics (temporal groundedness and semantic groundedness) and use them to reveal two pressures that amplify misalignment: prompt pressure from shared-context saturation at inference time and reward pressure from outcome-only optimization during training. These findings point to a structural root cause: the coupled agent paradigm conflates long-horizon planning with answer authority. We therefore propose the decoupled planner-inspector framework, which separates planning from answer authority and gates final answering on pixel-level verification. Across four long-video benchmarks, our framework improves both answer accuracy and evidence alignment, achieving 55.1% on LVBench and 62.0% on LongVideoBench while producing interpretable search trajectories. Moreover, the decoupled architecture scales consistently with increased search budgets and supports plug-and-play upgrades of the MLLM backbone without retraining the planner. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Echochef/VideoSEAL.

Abstract

Long video question answering requires locating sparse, time-scattered visual evidence within highly redundant content. Although current MLLMs perform well on short videos, long videos introduce long-horizon search and verification, which often necessitates multi-turn, agentic interaction. We show that existing LVU agents can exhibit "evidence misalignment": they produce correct answers that are not supported by the retrieved or inspected evidence. To characterize this failure, we introduce two diagnostics (temporal groundedness and semantic groundedness) and use them to reveal two pressures that amplify misalignment: prompt pressure from shared-context saturation at inference time and reward pressure from outcome-only optimization during training. These findings point to a structural root cause: the coupled agent paradigm conflates long-horizon planning with answer authority. We therefore propose the decoupled planner-inspector framework, which separates planning from answer authority and gates final answering on pixel-level verification. Across four long-video benchmarks, our framework improves both answer accuracy and evidence alignment, achieving 55.1% on LVBench and 62.0% on LongVideoBench while producing interpretable search trajectories. Moreover, the decoupled architecture scales consistently with increased search budgets and supports plug-and-play upgrades of the MLLM backbone without retraining the planner. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Echochef/VideoSEAL.

item.title: scShapeBench: Discovering geometry from high dimensional scRNAseq data
item.author: Andrew J Steindl, João Felipe Rocha, Brian Tshilengi Di Bassinga, Zachary Warren, Matthew Scicluna, César Miguel Valdez Córdova, Shabarni Gupta, Leire Torices, Daniel Neumann, Timothy J. Mann, Ihuan Gunawan, Dhananjay Bhaskar, John G Lock, Christine L Chaffer, Guy Wolf, Smita Krishnaswamy
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了scShapeBench基准数据集、scReebTower基线方法以及拓扑感知评估指标，旨在解决单细胞生物学中高维点云数据形状检测的自动化问题。

背景: 高维点云数据在单细胞生物学等领域广泛存在，其形状或拓扑结构决定了可提取的信息类型。现有的分析流程通常假设特定的形状，如聚类、树状或轨迹结构，选择流程往往依赖人工视觉检查。

目的: 为了解决单细胞数据形状检测的自动化问题，以便为下游分析流程选择合适的策略。

方法: 提出了scShapeBench基准数据集，包含合成和专家标注的单细胞数据；引入scReebTower基线方法，利用扩散几何提取Reeb图；提供了拓扑感知的评估指标。

主要发现: scReebTower在合成和真实数据上均优于现有的PAGA和Mapper基线方法。

结论: scReebTower能够有效提取Reeb图，将可视化与流程选择联系起来，并证明了自动化形状检测的可行性。

翻译: High-dimensional point cloud data arise across many scientific domains, especially single-cell biology. The shapes or topologies of these datasets determine the types of information that can be extracted. For example, clustered data supports cell-type identification, trajectory structures support transition analysis, and archetypal structures capture continua of cellular behaviors. Existing analysis pipelines often assume a specific shape. The standard Seurat pipeline combines UMAP visualization with Louvain clustering and therefore assumes clustered data, while tools such as Monocle and SPADE assume tree-like structures, and flow-based models such as MIOFlow and Conditional Flow Matching target trajectories. Choosing which pipeline to apply is therefore often left to bioinformaticians who visually inspect datasets before selecting an analysis strategy. With the rise of agentic AI scientists, automating shape detection is increasingly important for selecting downstream analysis pipelines. To address this problem, we introduce scShapeBench, a benchmark dataset for shape detection containing both synthetic and expert-annotated single-cell datasets. Synthetic datasets are sampled from ground-truth skeleton graphs with controlled variance. Real single-cell datasets are curated from diverse sources and annotated by experts into four categories: clusters, single trajectory, multi-branching, and archetypal. We additionally introduce scReebTower, a baseline method that uses diffusion geometry to extract Reeb graphs and connect visualization with pipeline selection. We provide topology-aware evaluation metrics and compare scReebTower against PAGA and Mapper on synthetic and real data. Our results indicate that scReebTower outperforms existing baselines. Overall, our contributions span benchmarks, evaluation metrics, and a baseline for automated shape detection in single-cell data.

Abstract

High-dimensional point cloud data arise across many scientific domains, especially single-cell biology. The shapes or topologies of these datasets determine the types of information that can be extracted. For example, clustered data supports cell-type identification, trajectory structures support transition analysis, and archetypal structures capture continua of cellular behaviors. Existing analysis pipelines often assume a specific shape. The standard Seurat pipeline combines UMAP visualization with Louvain clustering and therefore assumes clustered data, while tools such as Monocle and SPADE assume tree-like structures, and flow-based models such as MIOFlow and Conditional Flow Matching target trajectories. Choosing which pipeline to apply is therefore often left to bioinformaticians who visually inspect datasets before selecting an analysis strategy. With the rise of agentic AI scientists, automating shape detection is increasingly important for selecting downstream analysis pipelines. To address this problem, we introduce scShapeBench, a benchmark dataset for shape detection containing both synthetic and expert-annotated single-cell datasets. Synthetic datasets are sampled from ground-truth skeleton graphs with controlled variance. Real single-cell datasets are curated from diverse sources and annotated by experts into four categories: clusters, single trajectory, multi-branching, and archetypal. We additionally introduce scReebTower, a baseline method that uses diffusion geometry to extract Reeb graphs and connect visualization with pipeline selection. We provide topology-aware evaluation metrics and compare scReebTower against PAGA and Mapper on synthetic and real data. Our results indicate that scReebTower outperforms existing baselines. Overall, our contributions span benchmarks, evaluation metrics, and a baseline for automated shape detection in single-cell data.

item.title: Visual Aesthetic Benchmark: Can Frontier Models Judge Beauty?
item.author: Feng, Yichen, Li, Yuetai, Liu, Chunjiang, Chen, Yuanyuan, Jiang, Fengqing, Huang, Yue, Hua, Hang, Yuan, Zhengqing, Zheng, Kaiyuan, Niu, Luyao, Ramasubramanian, Bhaskar, Alomair, Basel, Zhang, Xiangliang, Sra, Misha, Chen, Zichen, Poovendran, Radha, Xu, Zhangchen
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究提出了Visual Aesthetic Benchmark (VAB)以评估多模态大模型在美学判断上的表现，发现现有模型与专家判断存在显著差距。

背景: 多模态大模型被广泛用于视觉理解、生成和策展，其中许多应用需要明确的美学判断。

目的: 探究现有的标量评分方法是否能准确捕捉比较偏好，并引入VAB作为基于比较选择的美学评估基准。

方法: 通过控制研究对比评分排名与直接比较的结果，构建包含400个任务和1,195张图片的VAB数据集，涵盖绘画、摄影和插画，标签由10位独立专家共识得出。

主要发现: 评分排名与直接比较结果不一致；在VAB上，最强模型在26.5%的任务中能正确识别最佳和最差图片，远低于人类专家的68.9%；在2,000个专家示例上微调35B参数模型可接近397B参数模型的性能。

结论: 当前多模态模型与专家美学判断之间存在明显且可测量的差距，VAB提供了首个基于集合的、专家验证的测试平台，用于跟踪和缩小这一差距。

翻译: 多模态大模型目前被常规部署用于视觉理解、生成和策展。这些应用中很大一部分需要明确的美学判断。大多数现有解决方案将这种判断简化为对单张图像的标量评分预测。我们首先询问这种评分是否能忠实地捕捉比较偏好：在一项包含八位专家标注员的控制研究中，基于评分的排名与这些标注员直接比较的结果对齐不佳，而直接排名在最佳和最差图像标签上产生了显著更高的标注员间一致性。受这一发现启发，我们引入了视觉美学基准VAB，它将美学评估视为对匹配主题的候选集合的比较选择。VAB包含400个任务和1,195张图像，涵盖绘画、摄影和插画，标签源自每个任务的10位独立专家法官的共识。评估了20个前沿多模态模型和六个专用的视觉质量奖励模型，我们发现最强的系统仅在26.5%的任务中能正确识别最佳和最差图像，这远低于人类专家实现的68.9%。在2,000个专家示例上微调一个35B参数模型使其性能接近一个397B参数开放权重模型的性能，表明VAB中的比较信号是可迁移的。这些结果共同揭示了当前多模态模型与专家美学判断之间清晰且可测量的差距，VAB提供了首个基于集合的、专家验证的测试平台，用于跟踪和缩小这一差距。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决前沿人工智能模型能否准确判断视觉美学的问题。这个问题很重要，因为美学判断是人机交互中的关键环节，且现有数据集可能存在局限性，需要新的基准来评估模型能力。

Abstract

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are now routinely deployed for visual understanding, generation, and curation. A substantial fraction of these applications require an explicit aesthetic judgment. Most existing solutions reduce this judgment to predicting a scalar score for a single image. We first ask whether such scores faithfully capture comparative preference: in a controlled study with eight expert annotators, score-derived rankings align poorly with the same annotators' direct comparisons, while direct ranking yields substantially higher inter-annotator agreement on best- and worst-image labels. Motivated by this finding, we introduce the Visual Aesthetic Benchmark (VAB), which casts aesthetic evaluation as comparative selection over candidate sets with matched subject matter. VAB contains 400 tasks and 1,195 images across fine art, photography, and illustration, with labels derived from the consensus of 10 independent expert judges per task. Evaluating 20 frontier MLLMs and six dedicated visual-quality reward models, we find that the strongest system identifies both the best and the worst image correctly across three random permutations of the candidate order in only 26.5% of tasks, far below the 68.9% achieved by human experts. Fine-tuning a 35B-parameter model on 2,000 expert examples brings its accuracy close to that of a 397B-parameter open-weight model, suggesting that the comparative signal in VAB is transferable. Together, these results expose a clear and measurable gap between current multimodal models and expert aesthetic judgment, and VAB provides the first set-based, expert-grounded testbed on which that gap can be tracked and closed.

item.title: 3D RL-DWA: A Hybrid Reinforcement Learning and Dynamic Window Approach for Goal-Directed Local Navigation in Multi-DoF Robots
item.author: Chiara Castellani, Enrico Turco, Domenico Prattichizzo
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种结合强化学习与动态窗口法的新型混合方法，用于高自由度机器人的自适应三维局部导航。该方法利用稀疏点云数据动态调整变形微机器人的运动和形状，使其在复杂受限环境中向目标导航并最大化占据体积。实验在模拟血管网络中进行，基于1080次试验的结果表明，与纯强化学习和基于模型的方法相比，将强化学习与基于动态窗口法的局部规划器结合显著增强了变形和导航能力。

背景: 高自由度机器人系统在复杂受限环境中的导航面临挑战，特别是在稀疏感知条件下。

目的: 开发一种能够利用稀疏点云数据动态调整变形微机器人运动和形状的混合方法，以实现高效且自适应的三维导航。

方法: 提出了一种结合强化学习与动态窗口法的新型混合方法。该方法利用稀疏点云数据动态调整变形微机器人的运动和形状。

主要发现: 在模拟血管网络中进行的1080次试验表明，将强化学习与基于动态窗口法的局部规划器结合，显著增强了变形和导航能力。该自主控制器在训练中始终实现高变形和近乎完美的路径完成，并在未见场景中保持稳健性能。

结论: 混合规划策略在稀疏感知条件下实现高效且自适应的三维导航方面具有潜力。

翻译: 本文提出了一种结合强化学习与动态窗口法的新型混合方法，用于高自由度机器人的自适应三维局部导航。该方法利用稀疏点云数据动态调整变形微机器人的运动和形状，使其在复杂受限环境中向目标导航并最大化占据体积。实验在模拟血管网络中进行，基于1080次试验的结果表明，与纯强化学习和基于模型的方法相比，将强化学习与基于动态窗口法的局部规划器结合显著增强了变形和导航能力。特别是，所提出的自主控制器在训练过程中始终实现高变形和近乎完美的路径完成，并在未见场景中保持稳健性能。这些发现凸显了混合规划策略在稀疏感知条件下实现高效且自适应三维导航的潜力。

Abstract

In this paper, we present a novel hybrid approach that combines Reinforcement Learning (RL) with Dynamic Window Approach (DWA) for adaptive 3D local navigation of high-degree-of-freedom robotic systems. Our method leverages sparse point cloud data to dynamically adjust both the motion and the shape of a deformable microrobot, enabling the system to navigate toward a goal in complex, constrained environments while maximizing the occupied volume. We evaluate our framework in a simulated vascular network. Experimental results, based on 1080 trials, indicate that integrating RL with a DWA-based local planner significantly enhances both deformation and navigation capabilities compared to a pure RL and a model-based methods. In particular, the proposed autonomous controller consistently achieves high deformation and near-perfect path completion during training and maintains robust performance in unseen scenarios. These findings highlight the potential of hybrid planning strategies for efficient and adaptive 3D navigation under sparse sensory conditions.

item.title: WriteSAE: Sparse Autoencoders for Recurrent State
item.author: Young, Jack
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: WriteSAE是首个能够分解和编辑状态空间及混合循环语言模型矩阵缓存写入的稀疏自编码器，解决了现有残差SAE无法触及的问题。

背景: 现有SAE读取残差流，但Gated DeltaNet、Mamba-2和RWKV-7通过秩一更新写入d_k乘以d_v的缓存，没有任何向量原子可以替换。

目的: 将每个解码器原子分解为原生写入形状，暴露每个token对数偏移的闭式形式，并在匹配的Frobenius范数下训练，使原子每次交换一个缓存槽。

主要发现: 原子替换在Qwen3.5-0.8B L9 H4的92.4%的触发中击败了匹配范数消融，87个原子的种群测试在89.8%下保持，闭式形式在R平方为0.98时预测了测量效果，Mamba-2-370M在2500次触发中以88.1%的替换率进行替换。

结论: 在贪婪解码下，3倍提升中位排名的安装，使目标在延续中的表现从33.3%提升至100%，这是首次在矩阵循环写入点进行的安装。

方法: 将每个解码器原子分解为原生写入形状，暴露每个token对数偏移的闭式形式，并在匹配的Frobenius范数下训练，使原子每次交换一个缓存槽。

Abstract

We introduce WriteSAE, the first sparse autoencoder that decomposes and edits the matrix cache write of state-space and hybrid recurrent language models, where residual SAEs cannot reach. Existing SAEs read residual streams, but Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, and RWKV-7 write to a $d_k \times d_v$ cache through rank-1 updates $k_t v_t^\top$ that no vector atom can replace. WriteSAE factors each decoder atom into the native write shape, exposes a closed form for the per-token logit shift, and trains under matched Frobenius norm so atoms swap one cache slot at a time. Atom substitution beats matched-norm ablation on 92.4% of $n=4{,}851$ firings at Qwen3.5-0.8B L9 H4, the 87-atom population test holds at 89.8%, the closed form predicts measured effects at $R^2=0.98$, and Mamba-2-370M substitutes at 88.1% over 2,500 firings. Sustained three-position installs at $3\times$ lift midrank target-in-continuation from 33.3% to 100% under greedy decoding, the first behavioral install at the matrix-recurrent write site.

item.title: Orthrus: Memory-Efficient Parallel Token Generation via Dual-View Diffusion
item.author: Van Nguyen, Chien, Hegde, Chaitra, Pham, Van Cuong, Rossi, Ryan A., Dernoncourt, Franck, Nguyen, Thien Huu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 介绍了一种名为Orthrus的框架，该框架结合了自回归大语言模型和扩散模型的优势，通过统一架构实现高保真和高速并行生成。

背景: 标准自回归解码的顺序性质是高吞吐量推理的基本瓶颈。虽然扩散语言模型试图通过并行生成打破这一障碍，但它们 suffer from significant performance degradation, high training costs, and a lack of rigorous convergence guarantees.

目的: 解决自回归解码的顺序瓶颈，同时克服扩散语言模型在性能、训练成本和收敛保证方面的缺陷。

方法: 设计了一个名为Orthrus的框架，它无缝集成到现有的Transformers中，通过向冻结的LLM添加一个轻量级、可训练的模块，在标准自回归视图旁边创建一个并行的扩散视图。两个视图都关注相同的高保真KV缓存，自回归头执行上下文预填充以构建准确的KV表示，而扩散头执行并行生成。

主要发现: 通过在两个视图之间采用精确的共识机制，Orthrus保证了无损推理，实现了高达7.8倍的速度提升，且仅增加了O(1)的内存缓存开销和极少的参数。

结论: Orthrus成功统一了自回归模型的精确生成保真度和扩散模型的高速并行生成能力，是一种简单高效的解决方案。

翻译: 我们介绍了Orthrus，一个简单高效的dual-architecture框架，它统一了自回归大语言模型（LLMs）的精确生成保真度与扩散模型的高速并行令牌生成能力。标准自回归解码的顺序性质代表了高吞吐量推理的基本瓶颈。虽然扩散语言模型试图通过并行生成打破这一障碍，但它们 suffer from significant performance degradation, high training costs, and a lack of rigorous convergence guarantees。Orthrus原生地解决了这一二分法。设计为无缝集成到现有的Transformers中，该框架通过向冻结的LLM添加一个轻量级、可训练的模块，在标准自回归视图旁边创建一个并行的扩散视图。在这个统一系统中，两个视图都关注相同的高保真Key-Value（KV）缓存；自回归头执行上下文预填充以构建准确的KV表示，而扩散头执行并行生成。通过在两个视图之间采用精确的共识机制，Orthrus保证了无损推理，实现了高达7.8倍的速度提升，且仅增加了O(1)的内存缓存开销和极少的参数。

Abstract

We introduce Orthrus, a simple and efficient dual-architecture framework that unifies the exact generation fidelity of autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) with the high-speed parallel token generation of diffusion models. The sequential nature of standard autoregressive decoding represents a fundamental bottleneck for high-throughput inference. While diffusion language models attempt to break this barrier via parallel generation, they suffer from significant performance degradation, high training costs, and a lack of rigorous convergence guarantees. Orthrus resolves this dichotomy natively. Designed to seamlessly integrate into existing Transformers, the framework augments a frozen LLM with a lightweight, trainable module to create a parallel diffusion view alongside the standard autoregressive view. In this unified system, both views attend to the exact same high-fidelity Key-Value (KV) cache; the autoregressive head executes context pre-filling to construct accurate KV representations, while the diffusion head executes parallel generation. By employing an exact consensus mechanism between the two views, Orthrus guarantees lossless inference, delivering up to a 7.8x speedup with only an O(1) memory cache overhead and minimal parameter additions.

item.title: AgentLens: Revealing The Lucky Pass Problem in SWE-Agent Evaluation
item.author: Sahoo, Priyam, Mittal, Gaurav, Li, Xiaomin, Ma, Shengjie, Steenhoek, Benjamin, Lin, Pingping, Hu, Yu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究指出仅凭最终补丁是否通过测试来评估软件工程代理是不够的，并提出了AgentLens框架以评估代理的执行过程质量。

背景: 现有的软件工程代理评估主要依赖最终补丁是否通过测试这一二元信号，这种仅关注结果的观点将合理的解决方案与混乱的试错过程视为等同。

目的: 通过实证分析证明这种等同性是错误的，并引入AgentLens框架对代理轨迹进行过程层面的评估。

方法: 在60个SWE-bench Verified任务上评估了8个模型后端的2,614条轨迹，构建了包含1,815条轨迹的评估子集，并利用合并多个通过解构建任务级前缀树接受器，结合上下文敏感的意图标签器对轨迹进行分类和标注。

主要发现: 在通过轨迹中，10.7%表现出被称为幸运通过的异常行为；质量评分将通过轨迹分为幸运、稳固和理想三个层级，并分解了幸运通过的五种机制；不同模型的后端幸运率在0.5%到23.2%之间；按质量评分排名比按通过率排名会导致模型名次变化多达五位。

结论: 仅凭最终结果评估代理存在局限性，引入过程质量评估能更准确地反映代理性能，并揭示了代理在解决软件工程任务时可能存在的非最优行为模式。

翻译: Evaluation of software engineering (SWE) agents is dominated by a binary signal: whether the final patch passes the tests. This outcome-only view treats a principled solution and a chaotic trial-and-error process as equivalent. We show that this equivalence is empirically false. We evaluate 2,614 OpenHands trajectories from eight model backends on 60 SWE-bench Verified tasks. Of these, 47 have enough passing trajectories to construct task-level process references, yielding a 1,815-trajectory evaluation subset. Among passing trajectories in this subset, 10.7% exhibit behavior we call a Lucky Pass: regression cycles, blind retries, missing verification, or temporally disordered exploration, implementation, and verification. We introduce AgentLens, a framework for process-level assessment of SWE-agent trajectories, and release AgentLens-Bench, a dataset of 1,815 trajectories annotated with quality scores, waste signals, divergence points, and 47 task-level Prefix Tree Acceptor (PTA) references. AgentLens builds PTA references by merging multiple passing solutions for the same task, and uses a context-sensitive intent labeler to assign actions to Exploration, Implementation, Verification, or Orchestration based on trajectory history rather than tool identity alone. On AgentLens-Bench, the quality score separates passing trajectories into Lucky, Solid, and Ideal tiers and further decomposes Lucky Passes into five recurring mechanisms. Across the eight model backends, Lucky rates range from 0.5% to 23.2%, and some models move by as many as five rank positions when ranked by quality score instead of pass rate. We release the anonymized project repository, including the AgentLens-Bench dataset and AgentLens SDK, at this https URL .

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文揭示了 SWE-Agent 评估中存在的“幸运通过问题”。

Abstract

Evaluation of software engineering (SWE) agents is dominated by a binary signal: whether the final patch passes the tests. This outcome-only view treats a principled solution and a chaotic trial-and-error process as equivalent. We show that this equivalence is empirically false. We evaluate 2,614 OpenHands trajectories from eight model backends on 60 SWE-bench Verified tasks. Of these, 47 have enough passing trajectories to construct task-level process references, yielding a 1,815-trajectory evaluation subset. Among passing trajectories in this subset, 10.7% exhibit behavior we call a Lucky Pass: regression cycles, blind retries, missing verification, or temporally disordered exploration, implementation, and verification. We introduce AgentLens, a framework for process-level assessment of SWE-agent trajectories, and release AgentLens-Bench, a dataset of 1,815 trajectories annotated with quality scores, waste signals, divergence points, and 47 task-level Prefix Tree Acceptor (PTA) references. AgentLens builds PTA references by merging multiple passing solutions for the same task, and uses a context-sensitive intent labeler to assign actions to Exploration, Implementation, Verification, or Orchestration based on trajectory history rather than tool identity alone. On AgentLens-Bench, the quality score separates passing trajectories into Lucky, Solid, and Ideal tiers and further decomposes Lucky Passes into five recurring mechanisms. Across the eight model backends, Lucky rates range from 0.5% to 23.2%, and some models move by as many as five rank positions when ranked by quality score instead of pass rate. We release the anonymized project repository, including the AgentLens-Bench dataset and AgentLens SDK, at this https URL .

item.title: Asymmetric Flow Models
item.author: Chen, Hansheng, Ackermann, Jan, Kim, Minseo, Wetzstein, Gordon, Guibas, Leonidas
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AsymFlow通过限制噪声预测到低秩子空间，同时保持数据预测全维，实现了高维空间中的流生成，并在ImageNet 256x256上取得了领先的1.57 FID。

背景: 在高维空间中进行基于流的生成是困难的，因为速度预测需要建模高维噪声，即使数据具有强低秩结构。

目的: 提出Asymmetric Flow Modeling (AsymFlow)，通过限制噪声预测到低秩子空间同时保持数据预测全维，以解决高维空间流生成的问题。

方法: AsymFlow采用秩不对称的速度参数化，将噪声预测限制在低秩子空间，同时保持数据预测全维，并从这种不对称预测中分析恢复全维速度，无需改变网络架构或训练/采样过程。

主要发现: AsymFlow在ImageNet 256x256上取得了领先的1.57 FID，优于先前的DiT/JiT类像素扩散模型；它还提供了将预训练的潜在流模型微调到像素空间模型的首条途径，从FLUX.2 klein 9B微调的像素AsymFlow模型在HPSv3、DPG-Bench和GenEval上建立了新的最先进水平。

结论: AsymFlow不仅在高维图像生成任务上表现出色，还通过将低秩像素子空间与潜在空间对齐，实现了从潜在模型到像素模型的平滑微调，显著提升了视觉真实感。

翻译: 在高维空间中进行基于流的生成是困难的，因为速度预测需要建模高维噪声，即使数据具有强低秩结构。我们提出了Asymmetric Flow Modeling (AsymFlow)，这是一种秩不对称的速度参数化，它将噪声预测限制在低秩子空间，同时保持数据预测全维。从这种不对称预测中，AsymFlow可以分析恢复全维速度，而无需改变网络架构或训练/采样过程。在ImageNet 256x256上，AsymFlow取得了领先的1.57 FID，显著优于先前的DiT/JiT类像素扩散模型。AsymFlow还提供了将预训练的潜在流模型微调到像素空间模型的首条途径：将低秩像素子空间与潜在空间对齐，可以得到无缝的初始化，保留了潜在模型的高级语义和结构，因此微调主要改善低级不匹配，而不是重新学习像素生成。我们展示了从FLUX.2 klein 9B微调的像素AsymFlow模型在HPSv3、DPG-Bench和GenEval上建立了像素空间文本到图像生成的新最先进水平，同时在视觉上显示出显著改善的真实感。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: unknown

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Flow-based generation in high-dimensional spaces is difficult because velocity prediction requires modeling high-dimensional noise, even when data has strong low-rank structure. We present Asymmetric Flow Modeling (AsymFlow), a rank-asymmetric velocity parameterization that restricts noise prediction to a low-rank subspace while keeping data prediction full-dimensional. From this asymmetric prediction, AsymFlow analytically recovers the full-dimensional velocity without changing the network architecture or training/sampling procedures. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, AsymFlow achieves a leading 1.57 FID, outperforming prior DiT/JiT-like pixel diffusion models by a large margin. AsymFlow also provides the first-ever route for finetuning pretrained latent flow models into pixel-space models: aligning the low-rank pixel subspace to the latent space gives a seamless initialization that preserves the latent model's high-level semantics and structure, so finetuning mainly improves low-level mismatches rather than relearning pixel generation. We show that the pixel AsymFlow model finetuned from FLUX.2 klein 9B establishes a new state of the art for pixel-space text-to-image generation, beating its latent base on HPSv3, DPG-Bench, and GenEval while qualitatively showing substantially improved visual realism.

item.title: Retrieval is Cheap, Show Me the Code: Executable Multi-Hop Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
item.author: Sun, Jiashuo, Shi, Jimeng, Xie, Yixuan, Wang, Saizhuo, Parekh, Jash Rajesh, Jiang, Pengcheng, Shi, Zhiyi, Fan, Jiajun, Zheng, Qinglong, Li, Peiran, Wang, Shaowen, Liu, Ge, Han, Jiawei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: pyrag框架通过将多跳检索增强生成（RAG）重新表述为程序合成与执行，解决了现有系统在多跳问答中推理脆弱的问题。

背景: 现有的检索增强生成（RAG）系统在处理需要链式多步检索和推理的多跳问题时表现脆弱。主要挑战包括：推理过程通过自由形式的自然语言表示，中间状态隐式存在，检索查询容易偏离目标实体，且错误由产生错误的同一模型检测，使得自我反思不可靠且缺乏依据。

目的: 将多跳问答视为一种逐步计算过程，并利用代码专用语言模型的训练方式，引入pyrag框架，将多跳RAG重新表述为程序合成与执行。

方法: pyrag框架将推理过程表示为可执行的Python程序，该程序在检索和问答工具上运行。它将中间状态暴露为变量，通过执行产生确定性反馈，并生成整个推理过程的可检查追踪。这种表述进一步实现了编译器引导的自我修复和执行驱动的自适应检索，无需任何额外训练。

主要发现: 在五个问答基准测试（PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, 和 Bamboogle）上的实验表明，pyrag在无训练和RL训练设置下均持续优于强基线，特别是在组合多跳数据集上取得了显著提升。

结论: pyrag框架通过程序合成与执行的方法，有效解决了多跳RAG中的推理脆弱性问题，并在多个基准测试中表现优异。

翻译: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为知识密集型问答的标准方法，但现有系统在多跳问题上仍然脆弱，解决该任务需要链式多个检索和推理步骤。主要挑战在于当前方法通过自由形式的自然语言表示推理，其中中间状态是隐式的，检索查询可能会偏离目标实体，并且错误由产生错误的同一模型检测，使得自我反思成为不可靠、无依据的信号。我们观察到多跳问答是逐步计算的一种典型形式，并且这种结构化过程与代码专用语言模型的训练方式非常一致。受此启发，我们介绍了pyrag框架，将多跳RAG重新表述为程序合成与执行。与自由形式的推理轨迹不同，pyrag将推理过程表示为在检索和问答工具上运行的可执行Python程序，将中间状态暴露为变量，通过执行产生确定性反馈，并生成整个推理过程的可检查追踪。这种表述进一步实现了编译器引导的自我修复和执行驱动的自适应检索，无需任何额外训练。在五个问答基准测试（PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, 和 Bamboogle）上的实验表明，pyrag在无训练和RL训练设置下均持续优于强基线，特别是在组合多跳数据集上取得了显著提升。我们的代码、数据和模型可在以下网址公开获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决检索增强生成中处理复杂多跳推理的问题。它提出利用代码来执行推理过程，以替代传统的文本生成方式。这在现实中很重要，因为现实问题往往需要多步逻辑推理，简单的生成容易出错，而代码执行能提供更精确和可靠的答案。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknownunknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard approach for knowledge-intensive question answering, but existing systems remain brittle on multi-hop questions, where solving the task requires chaining multiple retrieval and reasoning steps. Key challenges are that current methods represent reasoning through free-form natural language, where intermediate states are implicit, retrieval queries can drift from intended entities, and errors are detected by the same model that produces them making self-reflection an unreliable, ungrounded signal. We observe that multi-hop question answering is a typical form of step-by-step computation, and that this structured process aligns closely with how code-specialized language models are trained to operate. Motivated by this, we introduce \pyrag, a framework that reformulates multi-hop RAG as program synthesis and execution. Instead of free-form reasoning trajectories, \pyrag represents the reasoning process as an executable Python program over retrieval and QA tools, exposing intermediate states as variables, producing deterministic feedback through execution, and yielding an inspectable trace of the entire reasoning process. This formulation further enables compiler-grounded self-repair and execution-driven adaptive retrieval without any additional training. Experiments on five QA benchmarks (PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle) show that \pyrag consistently outperforms strong baselines under both training-free and RL-trained settings, with especially large gains on compositional multi-hop datasets. Our code, data and models are publicly available at this https URL .

item.title: F-GRPO: Factorized Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Unified Candidate Generation and Ranking
item.author: Surana, Rohan, Mundada, Gagan, Wu, Junda, Li, Xintong, Jiao, Yizhu, Jin, Bowen, Zhou, Sizhe, Yu, Tong, Sinha, Ritwik, Han, Jiawei, Shang, Jingbo, McAuley, Julian
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为F-GRPO的统一框架，旨在解决大语言模型在生成和排序过程中面临的优化挑战。该方法通过单一自回归过程同时进行候选生成和排序，并利用因子化组相对策略优化进行端到端训练。

背景: 传统的检索流程通过候选检索和重排序来优化效用，其中排序操作在预定义的候选集上进行。大语言模型将这一过程扩展为生成过程：给定候选池，LLM可以在一次自回归传递中生成一个子集并对其进行排序。然而，这种灵活性引入了新的优化挑战：模型必须在接收效用反馈之前搜索组合输出空间。由于反馈是基于完整序列定义的，它无法区分糟糕的结果是由于未能生成相关子集还是未能正确排序该子集。这种信用分配差距使得端到端优化不稳定且样本效率低下。

目的: 为了解决信用分配差距问题，提出一个统一框架，在单一自回归展开中执行生成和排序，并通过因子化组相对策略优化进行端到端优化。

方法: 提出F-GRPO框架，将策略分解为候选生成和排序，共享单一LLM骨干网络。使用顺序不变覆盖奖励和位置感知效用奖励进行联合训练。针对由此产生的阶段特定信用分配问题，在两阶段序列级目标中使用单独的组相对优势。

主要发现: 在顺序推荐和多跳问答基准测试中，F-GRPO在排名靠前的性能上优于GRPO和分离基线，优于监督替代方案，并与强大的零样本重排序器保持竞争力，且在推理时无需架构更改。

结论: F-GRPO框架能够有效解决大语言模型在生成和排序过程中的优化难题，通过端到端训练和联合优化，在多个基准测试中取得了优异的性能表现。

翻译: 传统的检索流程通过候选检索和重排序来优化效用，其中排序操作在预定义的候选集上进行。大语言模型将这一过程扩展为生成过程：给定候选池，LLM可以在一次自回归传递中生成一个子集并对其进行排序。然而，这种灵活性引入了新的优化挑战：模型必须在接收效用反馈之前搜索组合输出空间。由于反馈是基于完整序列定义的，它无法区分糟糕的结果是由于未能生成相关子集还是未能正确排序该子集。这种信用分配差距使得端到端优化不稳定且样本效率低下。现有的系统通常通过将候选生成与排序分离来解决这一问题。然而，这种解耦与下游效用仍然不一致，因为排序受到其接收的候选集的限制。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种统一框架，在单一自回归展开中执行两者，并通过因子化组相对策略优化进行端到端优化。我们的框架将策略分解为候选生成和排序，同时共享单一LLM骨干网络，并使用顺序不变覆盖奖励和位置感知效用奖励对其进行联合训练。为了解决由此产生的阶段特定信用分配问题，我们在两阶段序列级目标中为生成和排序使用单独的组相对优势。在顺序推荐和多跳问答基准测试中，F-GRPO在排名靠前的性能上优于GRPO和分离基线，优于监督替代方案，并与强大的零样本重排序器保持竞争力，且在推理时无需架构更改。

Abstract

Traditional retrieval pipelines optimize utility through stages of candidate retrieval and reranking, where ranking operates over a predefined candidate set. Large Language Models (LLMs) broaden this into a generative process: given a candidate pool, an LLM can generate a subset and order it within a single autoregressive pass. However, this flexibility introduces a new optimization challenge: the model must search a combinatorial output space while receiving utility feedback only after the full ranked list is generated. Because this feedback is defined over the completed sequence, it cannot distinguish whether a poor result arises from failing to generate a relevant subset or from failing to rank that subset correctly. This credit assignment gap makes end-to-end optimization unstable and sample-inefficient. Existing systems often address this by separating candidate generation from ranking. However, such decoupling remains misaligned with downstream utility because ranking is limited by the candidate set it receives. To bridge this gap, we propose a unified framework that performs both within a single autoregressive rollout and optimizes them end-to-end via factorized group-relative policy optimization (F-GRPO). Our framework factorizes the policy into candidate generation and ranking while sharing a single LLM backbone, and jointly trains them with an order-invariant coverage reward and a position-aware utility reward. To address the resulting phase-specific credit assignment problem, we use separate group-relative advantages for generation and ranking within a two-phase sequence-level objective. Across sequential recommendation and multi-hop question answering benchmarks, F-GRPO improves top-ranked performance over GRPO and decoupled baselines, outperforms supervised alternatives, and remains competitive with strong zero-shot rerankers, with no architectural changes at inference time.

item.title: FeatCal: Feature Calibration for Post-Merging Models
item.author: Gu, Yanggan, Cai, Shuo, Wang, Zihao, Wang, Wenjun, Wang, Yuanyi, Wang, Pengkai, Huang, Sirui, Lu, Su, Wu, Jianmin, Yang, Hongxia
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: FeatCal是一种通过逐层校准合并模型权重来减少特征漂移的方法，在CLIP和GLUE基准测试中优于现有的后合并校准基线。

背景: 模型合并将任务专家组合成一个模型，避免了联合训练、重新训练或部署许多专家模型，但合并后的模型往往仍不如任务专家表现好。

目的: 研究模型合并后的性能差距，通过特征漂移这一概念来分析，并开发一种能够减少特征漂移的校准方法。

方法: FeatCal方法使用一个小校准集，按照前向顺序逐层校准合并模型的权重，采用高效的闭式解来更新模型权重，无需梯度下降、迭代优化或额外模块。

主要发现: 在CLIP-ViT-B/32 Task Arithmetic和FLAN-T5-base GLUE基准上，FeatCal分别以85.5%和85.2%的准确率击败了Surgery和ProbSurgery；在CLIP-ViT-B/32上，8个示例即可达到82.9%，256个示例仅需53秒，比基线快约4倍。

结论: FeatCal在减少特征漂移的同时保持接近合并权重，保留了模型合并的优势，具有更好的样本效率和更低的校准成本。

翻译: 模型合并将任务专家组合成一个模型，避免了联合训练、重新训练或部署许多专家模型，但合并后的模型往往仍不如任务专家表现好。我们通过特征漂移——即合并模型与专家在相同输入下产生的特征之间的差异——来研究这一性能差距。我们的理论将这种漂移分解为上游传播和局部不匹配，按照前向顺序跟踪它如何通过后续层传播和组合，并将最终的特征漂移与输出漂移联系起来。这一观点催生了FeatCal，它使用一个小校准集按照前向顺序逐层校准合并模型权重，在减少特征漂移的同时保持接近合并权重并保留模型合并的好处。FeatCal使用高效的闭式解来更新模型权重，无需梯度下降、迭代优化或额外模块。在主要的CLIP和GLUE基准上，FeatCal击败了Surgery和ProbSurgery这两个最接近的后合并校准基线：在CLIP-ViT-B/32 Task Arithmetic上为85.5%对比77.0%/78.8%，在FLAN-T5-base GLUE上为85.2%对比83.7%/82.2%。在CLIP-ViT-B/32上，每个任务8个示例即可达到82.9%，每个任务256个示例仅需53秒，比两个基线都快约4倍，显示了更好的样本效率和更低的校准成本。

Abstract

Model merging combines task experts into one model and avoids joint training, retraining, or deploying many expert models, but the merged model often still underperforms task experts. We study this performance gap through feature drift, the difference between features produced by the merged model and by the expert on the same input. Our theory decomposes this drift into upstream propagation and local mismatch, tracks how it propagates and combines through later layers in forward order, and links final feature drift to output drift. This view motivates FeatCal, which uses a small calibration set to calibrate the merged model weights layer by layer in forward order, reducing feature drift while staying close to merged weights and preserving the benefits of model merging. FeatCal uses an efficient closed-form solution to update model weights, with no gradient descent, iterative optimization, or extra modules. On the main CLIP and GLUE benchmarks, FeatCal beats Surgery and ProbSurgery, the closest post-merging calibration baselines: 85.5% vs. 77.0%/78.8% on CLIP-ViT-B/32 Task Arithmetic (TA) and 85.2% vs. 83.7%/82.2% on FLAN-T5-base GLUE. On CLIP-ViT-B/32, 8 examples per task reach 82.9%, and 256 examples per task take 53 seconds, about 4x faster than both baselines, showing better sample efficiency and lower calibration cost.

item.title: MAP: A Map-then-Act Paradigm for Long-Horizon Interactive Agent Reasoning
item.author: Liu, Yuxin, Ye, Ziang, Sun, Yueqing, Zhu, Mingye, Xiao, Jinwei, Han, Zhuowen, GU, Qi, Cai, Xunliang, Zhang, Lei
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为MAP的框架，通过在执行前建立环境认知地图来解决延迟环境感知问题。

背景: 当前交互式LLM代理依赖目标条件分步规划，在执行过程中被动获取环境理解，导致延迟环境感知和认知瓶颈。

目的: 受人类感知和认知地图理论启发，提出Map-then-Act Paradigm (MAP)框架，将环境理解前置。

方法: MAP框架包含三个阶段：全局探索获取环境通用先验、任务特定映射构建结构化认知地图、知识增强执行。

主要发现: MAP在多个基准测试和LLM中均取得一致提升；在ARC-AGI-3上，前沿模型在25个游戏环境中有22个超越了接近零的基线表现；在MAP-2K数据集上训练优于专家执行轨迹。

结论: 理解环境比模仿执行更为基础。

Abstract

Current interactive LLM agents rely on goal-conditioned stepwise planning, where environmental understanding is acquired reactively during execution rather than established beforehand. This temporal inversion leads to Delayed Environmental Perception: agents must infer environmental constraints through trial-and-error, resulting in an Epistemic Bottleneck that traps them in inefficient failure cycles. Inspired by human affordance perception and cognitive map theory, we propose the Map-then-Act Paradigm (MAP), a plug-and-play framework that shifts environment understanding before execution. MAP consists of three stages: (1) Global Exploration, acquiring environment-general priors; (2) Task-Specific Mapping, constructing a structured cognitive map; and (3) Knowledge-Augmented Execution, solving tasks grounded on the map. Experiments show consistent gains across benchmarks and LLMs. On ARC-AGI-3, MAP enables frontier models to surpass near-zero baseline performance in 22 of 25 game environments. We further introduce MAP-2K, a dataset of map-then-act trajectories, and show that training on it outperforms expert execution traces, suggesting that understanding environments is more fundamental than imitation.

item.title: Context Training with Active Information Seeking
item.author: Huang, Zeyu, Kuncoro, Adhiguna, Feng, Qixuan, Shen, Jiajun, Dery, Lucio, Szlam, Arthur, Ranzato, Marc'Aurelio
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种结合搜索工具的主动信息获取方法，通过训练程序优化上下文，以提升大语言模型在下游任务中的表现。

背景: 现有大型语言模型在部署后进行适应成本高昂，尤其是当任务需要新产生信息或特定领域知识时。虽然通过优化上下文可以在不更新权重的情况下调整模型，但大多数现有方法仍依赖模型的内在知识，属于闭环系统。

目的: 为上下文优化器配备维基百科搜索和浏览器工具，实现主动信息获取，以改进大语言模型在下游任务中的适应能力。

方法: 将搜索工具添加到标准的顺序上下文优化流程中，并结合基于搜索的训练程序，该程序维护并修剪多个候选上下文。

主要发现: 单纯添加工具会降低性能；但与基于搜索的训练程序结合时，主动信息获取能带来一致且显著的性能提升。该方法在低资源翻译、健康场景、推理密集型任务等多样化领域表现出色，且数据高效、对不同超参数稳健，生成的上下文在不同模型间具有泛化能力。

结论: 主动信息获取方法能够有效提升大语言模型在多种任务中的表现，且具有良好的泛化性和鲁棒性。

翻译: 大多数现有的大型语言模型在部署后适应成本高昂，尤其是当任务需要新产生信息或小众领域知识时。近期研究表明，通过操纵和优化其上下文，可以在不更新权重的情况下将大语言模型定制为下游任务。然而，大多数现有方法仍保持闭环，仅依赖模型的内在知识。在本文中，我们为这些上下文优化器配备了维基百科搜索和浏览器工具以进行主动信息获取。我们表明，将这些工具简单地添加到标准的顺序上下文优化流程中实际上会比基线降低性能。然而，当与维护和修剪多个候选上下文的基于搜索的训练程序配对时，主动信息获取能带来一致且显著的提升。我们在包括低资源翻译、健康场景和推理密集型任务在内的多样化领域展示了这些改进。此外，我们的方法被证明是数据高效的，对不同超参数稳健，并且能够生成在不同模型间泛化良好的有效文本上下文。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: unknown

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

Most existing large language models (LLMs) are expensive to adapt after deployment, especially when a task requires newly produced information or niche domain knowledge. Recent work has shown that, by manipulating and optimizing their context, LLMs can be tailored to downstream tasks without updating their weights. However, most existing methods remain closed-loop, relying solely on the model's intrinsic knowledge. In this paper, we equip these context optimizers with Wikipedia search and browser tools for active information seeking. We show that naively adding these tools to a standard sequential context optimization pipeline can actually degrade performance compared to baselines. However, when paired with a search-based training procedure that maintains and prunes multiple candidate contexts, active information seeking delivers consistent and substantial gains. We demonstrate these improvements across diverse domains, including low-resource translation (Flores+), health scenarios (HealthBench), and reasoning-heavy tasks (LiveCodeBench and Humanity's Last Exam). Furthermore, our method proves to be data-efficient, robust across different hyperparameters, and capable of generating effective textual contexts that generalize well across different models.

item.title: Vividh-ASR: A Complexity-Tiered Benchmark and Optimization Dynamics for Robust Indic Speech Recognition
item.author: Juvekar, Kush, Manohar, Kavya, Menon, Aditya Srinivas, Bhattacharya, Arghya, Nethil, Kumarmanas
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了多语言ASR模型在低资源语言上的微调问题，提出了Vividh-ASR基准测试和反向多阶段微调方法。

背景: 多语言ASR模型（如Whisper）在低资源语言上的微调通常能改善朗读语音性能，但会降低自发语音性能，这种现象被称为工作室偏差。

目的: 为了诊断这种不匹配，引入了Vividh-ASR基准测试，并提出了反向多阶段微调方法。

方法: 1. 创建了Vividh-ASR基准测试，包含四个层级的复杂度：工作室、广播、自发和合成噪声；2. 进行了学习率时间和课程排序的受控研究；3. 提出了反向多阶段微调方法。

主要发现: 1. 早期的大参数更新使全局字错误率提高了12个百分点；2. 硬到易的课程顺序为自发语音增加了增益；3. 反向多阶段微调使244M参数的模型匹配或超过769M参数的模型；4. 有效的时间表将适应集中在解码器上，保留了预训练编码器的声学几何结构。

结论: Vividh-ASR基准测试和反向多阶段微调方法能够有效解决工作室偏差问题，实现高效的模型微调。

Abstract

Fine-tuning multilingual ASR models like Whisper for low-resource languages often improves read speech but degrades spontaneous audio performance, a phenomenon we term studio-bias. To diagnose this mismatch, we introduce Vividh-ASR, a complexity-stratified benchmark for Hindi and Malayalam across four tiers: studio, broadcast, spontaneous, and synthetic noise. Through a controlled study of learning-rate timing and curriculum ordering, we find that early large parameter updates improve global WER by 12 absolute points, while a hard-to-easy curriculum adds gains for spontaneous speech. These findings motivate reverse multi-stage fine-tuning (R-MFT), a training recipe that enables a parameter-efficient 244M Whisper model to match or exceed conventionally fine-tuned 769M counterparts. Representational analysis via CKA and SVD reveals effective schedules concentrate adaptation in the decoder, preserving the pre-trained encoder's acoustic geometry. We release the benchmark and models.

item.title: EvObj: Learning Evolving Object-centric Representations for 3D Instance Segmentation without Scene Supervision
item.author: Jiahao Chen, Zihui Zhang, Yafei Yang, Jinxi Li, Shenxing Wei, Zhixuan Sun, Bo Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: EvObj 是一种无监督 3D 实例分割方法，通过集成两个创新模块来弥合合成预训练数据与真实点云之间的几何域差距。

背景: 当前方法在将对象先验从合成数据集（如 ShapeNet）转移到真实扫描数据（如 ScanNet）时，由于形态变化和遮挡伪影导致结构差异。

目的: 解决合成数据与真实点云之间的几何域差距，以实现更好的 3D 对象分割。

方法: 集成了两个创新模块：(1) 对象辨别模块，动态细化对象候选，使对象先验能够连续适应目标域；(2) 对象补全模块，在发现对象后重建部分几何形状。

主要发现: 在真实世界和合成数据集上进行了广泛实验，证明了优于所有基线的 3D 对象分割性能，并实现了最先进的结果。

结论: EvObj 在 3D 对象分割方面表现出色，优于所有基线并达到了最先进的结果。

翻译: 我们介绍了 EvObj，用于无监督 3D 实例分割，弥合了合成预训练数据与真实点云之间的几何域差距。当前方法在将对象先验从合成数据集（如 ShapeNet）转移到真实扫描数据（如 ScanNet）时，由于形态变化和遮挡伪影导致结构差异。为了解决这个问题，EvObj 集成了两个创新模块：(1) 对象辨别模块，动态细化对象候选，使对象先验能够连续适应目标域；(2) 对象补全模块，在发现对象后重建部分几何形状。我们在真实世界和合成数据集上进行了广泛实验，证明了优于所有基线的 3D 对象分割性能，并实现了最先进的结果。
