Abstract

Multimodal large laboratory models (MLLMs) still struggle with spatial understanding under the dominant perspective-image paradigm, which inherits the narrow field of view of human-like perception. For navigation, robotic search, and 3D scene understanding, 360-degree panoramic sensing offers a form of supersensing by capturing the entire surrounding environment at once. However, existing MLLM pipelines typically decompose panoramas into multiple perspective views, leaving the spherical structure of equirectangular projection (ERP) largely implicit. In this paper, we study pano-native understanding, which requires an MLLM to reason over an ERP panorama as a continuous, observer-centered space. To this end, we first define the key abilities for pano-native understanding, including semantic anchoring, spherical localization, reference-frame transformation, and depth-aware 3D spatial reasoning. We then build a large-scale metadata construction pipeline that converts mixed-source ERP panoramas into geometry-aware, language-grounded, and depth-aware supervision, and instantiate these signals as capability-aligned instruction tuning data. On the model side, we introduce PanoWorld with Spherical Spatial Cross-Attention, which injects spherical geometry into the visual stream. We further construct PanoSpace-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating ERP-native spatial reasoning. Experiments show that PanoWorld substantially outperforms both proprietary and open-source baselines on PanoSpace-Bench, H* Bench, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen benchmarks. These results demonstrate that robust panoramic reasoning requires dedicated pano-native supervision and geometry-aware model adaptation. All source code and proposed data will be publicly released.

item.title: OxyEcomBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Foundation Models across E-Commerce Ecosystems
item.author: Yong Liu, Ximan Liu, Guoqing Yang, Bing Bai, Xiaoqiang Xu, Zhen Chen, Ke Zhang, Yan Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了OxyEcomBench，这是一个针对电商领域的统一多模态基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型和多模态大型语言模型在电商任务中的表现。

背景: 电商领域具有独特的挑战，包括复杂的领域知识、长尾产品证据、异构视觉数据以及多个利益相关者角色之间的相互作用，这些与模型主要训练的通用世界知识存在显著差异，导致模型在开放域和电商领域的性能之间存在显著差距。

目的: 为了系统地量化这一差距，本文引入了OxyEcomBench，这是一个包含约6300个高质量双语中文-英文电商实例的统一多模态基准测试。

方法: OxyEcomBench通过联合覆盖平台运营商、商家和客户，涵盖6个能力方面和29项任务，支持文本和混合模态输入，包括单图、多图、单轮和多轮配置。所有数据均来自真实的电商平台并由领域专家验证。该基准测试采用难度感知设计，应用四级P0-P3评分标准，并优先考虑视觉显著的多模态案例。

主要发现: 在20个主流LLMs和MLLMs上的评估显示，即使是领先模型的表现也仅处于中等水平，且在OxyEcomBench上的性能差距有所缩小。

结论: 这表明在电商领域缺乏足够的电商特定知识注入，削弱了先进通用模型在该领域的优势。

翻译: LLMs and MLLMs have become indispensable tools across a wide range of applications. E-commerce, however, poses distinctive challenges -- including intricate domain knowledge, long-tail product evidence, heterogeneous visual data, and the interplay among multiple stakeholder roles -- that diverge substantially from the general world knowledge these models are primarily trained on, often causing a notable gap between their open-domain and e-commerce performance. To systematically quantify this gap, we introduce OxyEcomBench, a unified multimodal benchmark comprising approximately 6,300 high-quality instances for real-world bilingual Chinese--English e-commerce. Although several e-commerce benchmarks have been proposed, they typically adopt a single stakeholder perspective, target a narrow set of tasks, or address isolated challenges, making it difficult to holistically assess models' understanding of the full e-commerce pipeline. OxyEcomBench addresses these limitations by jointly covering platform operators, merchants, and customers across 6 capability aspects and 29 tasks, supporting text-only and mixed-modality inputs with single-image, multi-image, single-turn, and multi-turn configurations. All data is sourced from authentic e-commerce platforms and verified by domain experts. The benchmark further adopts a difficulty-aware design with a four-level P0--P3 rubric applied to all 29 tasks whose difficulty admits stable expert consensus, and rigorously prioritizes visually salient multimodal cases in which key evidence resides in images rather than text alone. Evaluations on 20 mainstream LLMs and MLLMs show that even the leading models attain modest performance and that performance gaps narrow on OxyEcomBench, suggesting that insufficient e-commerce-specific knowledge infusion mutes the advantages of advanced general-purpose models in this domain.

Abstract

LLMs and MLLMs have become indispensable tools across a wide range of applications. E-commerce, however, poses distinctive challenges -- including intricate domain knowledge, long-tail product evidence, heterogeneous visual data, and the interplay among multiple stakeholder roles -- that diverge substantially from the general world knowledge these models are primarily trained on, often causing a notable gap between their open-domain and e-commerce performance. To systematically quantify this gap, we introduce OxyEcomBench, a unified multimodal benchmark comprising approximately 6,300 high-quality instances for real-world bilingual Chinese--English e-commerce. Although several e-commerce benchmarks have been proposed, they typically adopt a single stakeholder perspective, target a narrow set of tasks, or address isolated challenges, making it difficult to holistically assess models' understanding of the full e-commerce pipeline. OxyEcomBench addresses these limitations by jointly covering platform operators, merchants, and customers across 6 capability aspects and 29 tasks, supporting text-only and mixed-modality inputs with single-image, multi-image, single-turn, and multi-turn configurations. All data is sourced from authentic e-commerce platforms and verified by domain experts. The benchmark further adopts a difficulty-aware design with a four-level P0--P3 rubric applied to all 29 tasks whose difficulty admits stable expert consensus, and rigorously prioritizes visually salient multimodal cases in which key evidence resides in images rather than text alone. Evaluations on 20 mainstream LLMs and MLLMs show that even the leading models attain modest performance and that performance gaps narrow on OxyEcomBench, suggesting that insufficient e-commerce-specific knowledge infusion mutes the advantages of advanced general-purpose models in this domain.

item.title: Stable Attention Response for Reliable Precipitation Nowcasting
item.author: Penghui Wen, Zexin Hu, Sen Zhang, Patrick Filippi, Xiaogang Zhu, Allen Benter, Thomas Bishop, Zhiyong Wang, Kun Hu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为HARECast的框架，通过显式建模和稳定注意力响应能量来提高降水临近预报的可靠性。

背景: 降水临近预报具有高度局部性、快速演化和异质性。尽管近期方法广泛采用基于注意力的架构，但往往忽视了跨样本的注意力响应稳定性。

目的: 解决注意力响应能量跨样本不稳定这一导致预报不可靠的重要且未被充分探索的问题。

方法: 提出HARECast框架，显式建模头级注意力响应能量，并通过组级正则化目标来减少跨样本波动。

主要发现: 不准确的预报与跨头和跨层的注意力响应能量方差较大相关。理论上，跨样本变异性会通过自注意力传播并扩大预测误差的下界。

结论: 在SEVIR和MeteoNet数据集上实现了最先进的性能。

翻译: 降水临近预报仍然具有挑战性，这是由于大气动力学的高度局部性、快速演变和异质性。尽管近期方法在单模态和多模态设置中越来越多地采用基于注意力的架构，但它们主要强调更强的表示学习和预测能力，而较少关注跨样本的注意力响应稳定性。在这项工作中，我们表明注意力响应能量的跨样本不稳定是预报不可靠的一个重要且以前未被充分探索的来源。经验上，不准确的预报与跨头和跨层的注意力响应能量方差较大相关。理论上，我们表明跨样本变异性可以通过自注意力传播，并扩大预测误差的下界。基于这一见解，我们提出了HARECast，一种用于降水临近预报的基于头级注意力响应能量调节的框架。HARECast显式建模头级注意力响应能量，并通过组级正则化目标来稳定它，从而减少跨样本波动。所提出的公式是通用的，适用于单模态和多模态临近预报架构。我们在具有重建分支和基于扩散的预测器的标准预报管道中实例化了HARECast，并在常用的基准SEVIR和MeteoNet上对其进行了评估。实验结果表明，HARECast实现了最先进的性能。

Abstract

Precipitation nowcasting remains challenging due to the highly localized, rapidly evolving, and heterogeneous nature of atmospheric dynamics. Although recent methods increasingly adopt attention-based architectures in both unimodal and multimodal settings, they mainly emphasize stronger representation learning and prediction capacity, while paying less attention to the stability of attention responses across samples. In this work, we show that cross-sample instability of attention-response energy is an important and previously underexplored source of forecasting unreliability. Empirically, inaccurate forecasts are associated with larger attention-response energy variance across heads and layers. Theoretically, we show that cross-sample variability can propagate through self-attention, and enlarge a lower bound on prediction error. Based on this insight, we propose HARECast, a Head-wise Attention Response Energy-regulated framework for precipitation nowcasting. HARECast explicitly models head-wise attention-response energy and stabilizes it through a group-wise regularization objective that reduces cross-sample fluctuations. The proposed formulation is generic and applicable to both unimodal and multimodal nowcasting architectures. We instantiate HARECast in a standard forecasting pipeline with reconstruction branches and a diffusion-based predictor, and evaluate it on commonly used benchmarks--SEVIR and MeteoNet. Experimental results demonstrate that HARECast achieves state-of-the-art performance.

item.title: ECG-NAT: A Self-supervised Neighborhood Attention Transformer for Multi-lead Electrocardiogram Classification
item.author: Mahsa Gazeran, Sayvan Soleymanbaigi, Fatemeh Daneshfar, Amjad Seyedi, Fardin Akhlaghian Tab
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为ECG-NAT的新型自监督学习方法，用于多导联心电图分类。该方法通过两阶段训练，首先利用掩码自编码器进行生成式预训练，随后结合监督对比损失和交叉熵损失进行判别性微调。该模型通过分层注意力机制高效捕获多尺度时间特征，在仅使用1%标注数据的情况下，在基准数据集上达到了88.1%的准确率。

背景: 心电图心律失常分类面临信号变异性、噪声、标注数据有限以及难以同时实现准确性和效率的挑战。现有方法大多针对全局上下文特征或局部形态模式，很少实现分层多尺度特征提取。

目的: 提出一种名为ECG-NAT的新型自监督学习方法，旨在解决ECG信号分类中同时捕获细粒度心跳级形态和更广泛节律级依赖关系并保持计算效率的问题。

方法: 提出ECG-NAT，采用两阶段方法：第一阶段是生成式预训练，使用掩码自编码器在多个数据集上重建部分掩码的ECG信号；第二阶段是判别性微调，使用结合监督对比损失和交叉熵损失的双重损失函数。此外，还引入了分层注意力机制来高效捕获多尺度时间特征。

主要发现: ECG-NAT在基准数据集上表现出鲁棒的性能，在仅使用1%标注数据的情况下达到了88.1%的准确率，证明了其在低资源环境下的强效性。

结论: ECG-NAT框架结合了优越的分类性能和计算效率，使其适用于实时ECG诊断。

翻译: Electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia classification remains challenging due to signal variability, noise, limited labeled data, and the difficulty in achieving both accuracy and efficiency in models. While self-supervised learning reduces label dependency, most methods target either global contextual features or local morphological patterns, but rarely implement hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction. ECG signals require architectures that simultaneously capture fine-grained beat-level morphology and broader rhythm-level dependencies with computational efficiency. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes the Electrocardiogram Neighborhood Attention Transformer (ECG-NAT), a novel self-supervised learning approach tailored for multi-lead ECG classification. Our two-stage approach begins with generative pretraining, using a masked autoencoder to reconstruct partially masked ECG signals across multiple diverse datasets, enabling the model to learn robust, domain-invariant representations from unlabeled data. This is followed by discriminative fine-tuning with a dual-loss function that combines supervised contrastive and cross-entropy losses, aligning representation learning with label prediction. The hierarchical attention mechanism efficiently captures multi-scale temporal features from localized beat morphology to broader rhythm patterns at low computational cost. ECG-NAT achieves robust performance on benchmark datasets, with 88.1% accuracy using only 1% labeled data, demonstrating strong efficacy in low-resource settings. The framework combines superior classification performance with computational efficiency, making it practical for real-time ECG diagnosis. The code will be made available upon acceptance at: https://github.com/Mahsagazeran/ECG-NAT.

Abstract

Electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia classification remains challenging due to signal variability, noise, limited labeled data, and the difficulty in achieving both accuracy and efficiency in models. While self-supervised learning reduces label dependency, most methods target either global contextual features or local morphological patterns, but rarely implement hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction. ECG signals require architectures that simultaneously capture fine-grained beat-level morphology and broader rhythm-level dependencies with computational efficiency. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes the Electrocardiogram Neighborhood Attention Transformer (ECG-NAT), a novel self-supervised learning approach tailored for multi-lead ECG classification. Our two-stage approach begins with generative pretraining, using a masked autoencoder to reconstruct partially masked ECG signals across multiple diverse datasets, enabling the model to learn robust, domain-invariant representations from unlabeled data. This is followed by discriminative fine-tuning with a dual-loss function that combines supervised contrastive and cross-entropy losses, aligning representation learning with label prediction. The hierarchical attention mechanism efficiently captures multi-scale temporal features from localized beat morphology to broader rhythm patterns at low computational cost. ECG-NAT achieves robust performance on benchmark datasets, with 88.1\% accuracy using only 1\% labeled data, demonstrating strong efficacy in low-resource settings. The framework combines superior classification performance with computational efficiency, making it practical for real-time ECG diagnosis. The code will be made available upon acceptance at: https://github.com/Mahsagazeran/ECG-NAT.

item.title: STAR: Semantic-Temporal Adaptive Representation Learning for Few-Shot Action Recognition
item.author: Hongli Liu, Yu Wang, Shengjie Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Few-shot action recognition (FSAR) 需要模型仅凭少量标注样本就能泛化到新的动作类别。本文提出了一种名为 STAR 的统一框架，旨在解决语义-时间错位和多尺度时间动态建模不足的问题，通过引入 Mamba 的序列建模能力来提升性能。

背景: 现有的基于视觉-语言模型的方法存在语义-时间错位问题，静态文本提示无法捕捉稀疏出现的决定性视觉线索，且多尺度时间动态建模不足，导致短期判别性线索和长期依赖关系被过度平滑或碎片化。

目的: 为了解决语义-时间错位和多尺度时间动态建模不足的挑战，提出一种名为 STAR 的统一框架，以弥合语义和时间的差距，并将 Mamba 的序列建模能力转移到 FSAR 中。

方法: STAR 包含语义对齐组件和时序感知组件。语义对齐模块引入时序语义注意力机制进行跨模态对齐；时序感知模块包含语义时序原型细化器，结合语义引导的 Mamba 块、多频率时序采样和双向状态空间细化。此外，利用大语言模型生成的时序依赖类描述符提供长距离语义指导。

主要发现: 在五个 FSAR 基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，STAR 在性能上始终优于最先进的方法。例如，在 1-shot 设置下，STAR 在 SSv2-Full 和 SSv2-Small 数据集上分别实现了 8.1% 和 6.7% 的提升，在 HMDB51 上实现了 7.3% 的提升，验证了其在有限监督下的有效性。

结论: STAR 在五个 FSAR 基准数据集上表现一致优于现有方法，证明了其在有限监督下的有效性。

翻译: Few-shot action recognition (FSAR) requires models to generalize to novel action categories from only a handful of annotated samples. Despite progress with vision-language models, existing approaches still suffer from semantic-temporal misalignment, where static textual prompts fail to capture decisive visual cues that appear sparsely across sequences, and from inadequate modeling of multi-scale temporal dynamics, as short-term discriminative cues and long-range dependencies are often either oversmoothed or fragmented. To address these challenges, we propose Semantic Temporal Adaptive Representation Learning (STAR), a unified framework, consisting of a semantic-alignment component and a temporal-aware component, effectively bridging the semantic and temporal gaps and transferring the sequence modeling capability of Mamba into the FSAR. The semantic alignment module introduces a Temporal Semantic Attention (TSA) mechanism, which performs frame-level cross-modal alignment with textual cues, ensuring fine-grained semantic-temporal consistency. The temporal-aware module incorporates a Semantic Temporal Prototype Refiner (STPR) that integrates semantic-guided Mamba blocks with multi-frequency temporal sampling and bidirectional state-space refinement, yielding semantically aligned prototypes with enhanced discriminative fidelity and temporal consistency. Furthermore, temporally dependent class descriptors derived from large language models (LLMs) provide long-range semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on five FSAR benchmarks demonstrate the consistent superiority of STAR over state-of-the-art methods. For instance, STAR achieves up to 8.1% and 6.7% gains on the SSv2-Full and SSv2-Small datasets under the 1-shot setting, and 7.3% on HMDB51, validating its effectiveness under limited supervision. The code is available at https://github.com/HongliLiu1/STAR-main.

Abstract

Few-shot action recognition (FSAR) requires models to generalize to novel action categories from only a handful of annotated samples. Despite progress with vision-language models, existing approaches still suffer from semantic-temporal misalignment, where static textual prompts fail to capture decisive visual cues that appear sparsely across sequences, and from inadequate modeling of multi-scale temporal dynamics, as short-term discriminative cues and long-range dependencies are often either oversmoothed or fragmented. To address these challenges, we propose Semantic Temporal Adaptive Representation Learning (STAR), a unified framework, consisting of a semantic-alignment component and a temporal-aware component, effectively bridging the semantic and temporal gaps and transferring the sequence modeling capability of Mamba into the FSAR. The semantic alignment module introduces a Temporal Semantic Attention (TSA) mechanism, which performs frame-level cross-modal alignment with textual cues, ensuring fine-grained semantic-temporal consistency. The temporal-aware module incorporates a Semantic Temporal Prototype Refiner (STPR) that integrates semantic-guided Mamba blocks with multi-frequency temporal sampling and bidirectional state-space refinement, yielding semantically aligned prototypes with enhanced discriminative fidelity and temporal consistency. Furthermore, temporally dependent class descriptors derived from large language models (LLMs) provide long-range semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on five FSAR benchmarks demonstrate the consistent superiority of STAR over state-of-the-art methods. For instance, STAR achieves up to 8.1% and 6.7% gains on the SSv2-Full and SSv2-Small datasets under the 1-shot setting, and 7.3% on HMDB51, validating its effectiveness under limited supervision. The code is available at https://github.com/HongliLiu1/STAR-main.

item.title: ReTool-Video: Recursive Tool-Using Video Agents with Meta-Augmented Tool Grounding
item.author: Xiao Liu, Nayu Liu, Junnan Zhu, Ruirui Chen, Guohui Xiang, Changjian Wang, Kaiwen Wei, Rongzhen Li, Jiang Zhong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对现有视频智能体在工具空间粗糙和动作空间扁平化方面的局限性，提出了一种递归工具使用方法和元增强视频工具库，以提升复杂视频理解能力。

背景: 视频理解需要主动寻求证据，现有视频智能体虽然通过检索、记忆、帧检查和验证器工具提高了推理能力，但仍面临工具空间粗糙和动作空间扁平化的问题。

目的: 解决现有视频智能体工具空间缺乏细粒度操作和动作空间将高层意图强制映射为原始工具调用的局限性，提升复杂视频理解能力。

方法: 构建了元增强视频工具库，包含134个工具，其中26个基础工具和108个元工具，并提出了递归工具使用方法ReTool-Video，将高层意图递归转化为可执行的工具链。

主要发现: 在MVBench、MLVU和Video-MME等数据集上，ReTool-Video consistently outperforms strong baselines，递归基线和细粒度元工具提高了复杂视频理解的稳定性和有效性。

结论: 通过递归基线和细粒度元工具，显著提升了复杂视频理解的稳定性和有效性。

翻译: 视频理解需要主动寻求证据，这促使了工具增强视频智能体的发展，用于时间推理、跨模态理解和复杂问答。现有的视频智能体通过检索、记忆、帧检查和验证器工具提高了视频推理能力，但仍面临两个局限：1）工具空间粗糙，缺乏用于组合推理的细粒度操作；2）动作空间扁平化，将高层视频意图强制映射为原始可执行的工具调用。本文通过两个互补设计解决了这些挑战。首先，构建了元增强视频工具库，这是一个可扩展的工具库，包含134个注册工具，包括26个用于通用多模态信号处理的基础工具和108个用于过滤、聚合、重排序、格式化和其他中间结果操作的元工具。MVTL支持对结构化视频信息和原始模态证据的双重访问，使各种视频推理场景成为可能。其次，提出了ReTool-Video，一种递归工具使用方法，将高层视频意图转化为可执行的工具链。在ReTool-Video中，匹配的动作直接执行，而不匹配的意图委托给解析器进行参数修复、工具替换或分解。这允许抽象动作，如时间合并、跨模态验证或重复事件聚合，在运行时逐步转化为具体的多模态操作。在MVBench、MLVU和Video-MME w/o sub.上的实验表明，ReTool-Video consistently outperforms strong baselines。进一步分析表明，递归基线和细粒度元工具提高了复杂视频理解的稳定性和有效性。

Abstract

Video understanding requires active evidence seeking, motivating tool-augmented video agents for temporal reasoning, cross-modal understanding, and complex question answering. Existing video agents have improved video reasoning with retrieval, memory, frame inspection, and verifier tools, but they still face two limitations: (1) a coarse tool space that lacks fine-grained operations for compositional reasoning; and (2) a flat action space that forces high-level video intents into primitive executable tool calls. In this paper, we address these challenges with two complementary designs. First, we construct a MetaAug-Video Tool Library (MVTL), an extensible tool library with 134 registered tools, including 26 base tools for general multimodal signal processing and 108 meta tools for filtering, aggregation, reranking, formatting, and other intermediate-result operations. MVTL supports dual-level access to both structured video information and raw modal evidence, enabling diverse video reasoning scenarios. Second, we propose ReTool-Video, a recursive tool-using method that grounds high-level video intents into executable tool chains. In ReTool-Video, matched actions are executed directly, while unmatched intents are delegated to a resolver for parameter repair, tool substitution, or decomposition. This allows abstract actions such as temporal merging, cross-modal verification, or repeated-event aggregation to be progressively translated into concrete multimodal operations at runtime. Experiments on MVBench, MLVU, and Video-MME w/o sub. show that ReTool-Video consistently outperforms strong baselines. Further analysis demonstrates that recursive grounding and fine-grained meta tools improve the stability and effectiveness of complex video understanding.

item.title: Improving Code Translation with Syntax-Guided and Semantic-aware Preference Optimization
item.author: Yuhan Wu, Huan Zhang, Wei Cheng, Chen Shen, Jingyue Yang, Wei Hu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为CTO的方法，旨在通过语法引导和语义感知的偏好优化来改进代码翻译。

背景: 虽然大型语言模型在代码翻译方面展现出巨大潜力，但它们往往难以同时确保语法正确性和语义一致性。偏好学习虽然是一种有前景的对齐策略，但受到不可靠的语义奖励的限制，这些奖励通常来自稀疏的测试用例或受限的参考翻译。

目的: 提出一种稳健的语义奖励，该奖励必须直接从源代码中推导出来，以改进代码翻译。

方法: CTO方法通过对比学习训练一个跨语言语义模型，以直接评估源代码和翻译代码之间的功能等价性。通过将代码翻译制定为多目标优化问题，这种稳健的语义信号与基于编译器的语法反馈在直接偏好优化框架中无缝统一。

主要发现: 在C++、Java和Python翻译上的广泛实验表明，CTO显著优于现有的基线和替代的偏好优化策略。

结论: CTO通过语法引导和语义感知的偏好优化，有效地解决了代码翻译中语法正确性和语义一致性的问题。

翻译: LLMs在代码翻译方面展现出巨大潜力，但往往难以同时确保语法正确性和语义一致性。虽然基于偏好的学习提供了一种有前景的对齐策略，但受到来自稀疏测试用例或受限参考翻译的不可靠语义奖励的限制。我们认为，代码翻译的稳健语义奖励必须直接从源代码中推导出来。在本文中，我们提出了CTO，通过语法引导和语义感知的偏好优化来改进代码翻译。通过对比学习，我们训练了一个跨语言语义模型，以直接评估源代码和翻译代码之间的功能等价性。通过将代码翻译制定为多目标优化问题，这种稳健的语义信号与基于编译器的语法反馈在直接偏好优化框架中无缝统一。在C++、Java和Python翻译上的广泛实验表明，CTO显著优于现有的基线和替代的偏好优化策略。

Abstract

LLMs have shown immense potential for code translation, yet they often struggle to ensure both syntactic correctness and semantic consistency. While preference-based learning offers a promising alignment strategy, it is hindered by unreliable semantic rewards derived from sparse test cases or restrictive reference translations. We argue that a robust semantic reward for code translation must be derived directly from the source code. In this paper, we propose CTO to improve code translation with syntax-guided and semantic-aware preference optimization. Through contrastive learning, we train a cross-lingual semantic model to directly assess functional equivalence between source and translated code. By formulating code translation as a multi-objective optimization problem, this robust semantic signal is seamlessly unified with compiler-based syntactic feedback within the direct preference optimization framework. Extensive experiments on C++, Java, and Python translations demonstrate that CTO significantly outperforms existing baselines and alternative preference optimization strategies.

item.title: Intelligence Delivery Network: Toward an Internet Architecture for the AI Age
item.author: Hanling Wang, Qing Li, Dan Zhao, Yuhong Song, Xingchi Chen, Teng Gao, Peiyuan Zong, Zhuyun Qi, Yue Yu, Yong Jiang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了智能交付网络(IDN)架构，旨在将AI能力作为可交付的网络服务，通过跨云、区域、边缘和本地环境的位置、选择、重用和验证智能，以支持分布式AI服务。

背景: AI驱动的应用正在重塑互联网的角色，用户越来越多地依赖网络获取大型基础模型衍生的智能服务。当前的云中心部署模式虽然操作方便，但存在延迟和抖动、大量广域流量、分布式异构计算资源利用率低以及日益增长的隐私和治理担忧等问题。

目的: 为了解决当前云中心部署模式在延迟、流量、资源利用率和隐私方面的局限性，构建一个能够支持分布式AI服务的互联网架构，使AI能力更加可访问、高效、可信且响应多样化应用需求。

方法: IDN架构将AI能力视为可交付的网络服务，根据需求本地性、资源可用性和策略约束，在云、区域、边缘和本地环境中进行智能的位置、选择、重用和验证。系统假设、核心架构机制以及能力抽象、计算资源集成、需求驱动部署、服务路由、状态感知缓存和信任管理等机制共同支持分布式AI服务。

主要发现: IDN架构通过跨环境协同智能交付，能够有效支持分布式AI服务，为AI时代的互联网架构提供了一条实用路径。

结论: IDN架构使AI能力更加可访问、高效、可信且响应多样化应用需求，为AI时代的互联网架构提供了实用路径。

翻译: AI驱动的应用的迅速兴起正在重塑互联网的角色。用户越来越多地依赖网络来获取由大型基础模型衍生的智能服务，而不仅仅是到达远程端点或检索特定内容。今天AI服务的主导部署范式仍然是云中心的，用户请求被传输到远程数据中心进行集中推理。虽然操作方便，但这种范式遭受延迟和抖动、大量广域流量、分布式异构计算资源利用率低以及日益增长的隐私和治理担忧。在本文中，我们提出了智能交付网络(IDN)，一种将AI能力视为可交付网络服务的互联网架构。关键思想是根据需求本地性、资源可用性和策略约束，在云、区域、边缘和本地环境中定位、选择、重用和验证智能。我们提出了IDN的系统假设，定义了其核心架构机制，并讨论了能力抽象、计算资源集成、需求驱动部署、服务路由、状态感知缓存和信任管理如何共同支持分布式AI服务。我们相信IDN为AI时代的互联网架构提供了一条实用路径，使AI能力更加可访问、高效、可信且响应多样化应用需求。

Abstract

The rapid emergence of AI-powered applications is reshaping the role of the Internet. Users increasingly rely on the network to obtain intelligence services derived from large foundation models, rather than merely to reach remote endpoints or retrieve specific content. Today's dominant deployment paradigm for AI services remains cloud-centric, where user requests are transmitted to remote data centers for centralized inference. Although operationally convenient, this paradigm suffers from latency and jitter, heavy wide-area traffic, limited utilization of distributed heterogeneous compute resources, and growing privacy and governance concerns. In this paper, we propose the Intelligence Delivery Network (IDN), an Internet architecture that treats AI capabilities as deliverable network services. The key idea is to position, select, reuse, and verify intelligence across cloud, regional, edge, and local environments according to demand locality, resource availability, and policy constraints. We present the system assumptions of IDN, define its core architectural mechanisms, and discuss how capability abstraction, compute resource integration, demand-driven deployment, service routing, state-aware caching, and trust management can jointly support distributed AI services. We believe that IDN provides a practical path toward an Internet architecture for the AI age, making AI capabilities more accessible, efficient, trustworthy, and responsive to diverse application needs.

item.title: It's not the Language Model, it's the Tool: Deterministic Mediation for Scientific Workflows
item.author: Marios Adamidis, Danae Katrisioti, Yannis Tzitzikas, Emmanuel Stratakis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 typed mediation 的模式，旨在解决语言模型在科学分析中重复生成结果不一致的问题。该模式通过编排确定性工具而非生成分析代码，确保了结果的稳定性和可复现性。

背景: 语言模型能够产生令人信服的科学分析，但在相同数据上重复生成时，结果往往不同。研究人员在面临不同输出时，缺乏明确的信任依据。

目的: 提出 typed mediation 模式，以解决科学分析中结果不一致的问题，确保分析的可复现性。

方法: 该模式通过模型编排确定性工具而非生成分析代码来实现。每个工具编码了特定研究人员针对特定仪器的精确程序。模型选择工具并调用，工具产生结果。评估通过在四个平台上对同一光致发光分析进行四次重复运行来完成。

主要发现: typed tool 在所有运行中产生相同的结果。商业平台要么在运行间变化数值和分析方法，要么无法产生有效结果。在两个涉及专有二进制格式和许可软件的仪器上部署六个月后，用户反馈非常积极。

结论: 部署拓扑结构不仅是偏好，更是科学工具中介的结构性要求。该模式为在科学工作流中部署语言模型提供了一种实用的模式，将分析时间从几周减少到几分钟，并保证运行间输出的一致性。

翻译: 语言模型能够产生令人信服的科学分析，但在相同数据上重复生成时，结果往往不同。研究人员在面临不同输出时，缺乏明确的信任依据。本文提出了一种名为 typed mediation 的模式，旨在解决语言模型在科学分析中重复生成结果不一致的问题。该模式通过编排确定性工具而非生成分析代码，确保了结果的稳定性和可复现性。评估通过在四个平台上对同一光致发光分析进行四次重复运行来完成。结果表明，typed tool 在所有运行中产生相同的结果，而商业平台要么在运行间变化数值和分析方法，要么无法产生有效结果。在两个涉及专有二进制格式和许可软件的仪器上部署六个月后，用户反馈非常积极。部署拓扑结构不仅是偏好，更是科学工具中介的结构性要求。该模式为在科学工作流中部署语言模型提供了一种实用的模式，将分析时间从几周减少到几分钟，并保证运行间输出的一致性。

Abstract

Language models can produce convincing scientific analyses, but repeated generations on the same data do not guarantee the same result. A researcher may regenerate an identical query and receive a different fit, a different peak position or a different analysis procedure, without an obvious way to decide which output to trust. We propose typed mediation, a pattern in which the model orchestrates deterministic tools rather than generating analytical code. Each tool encodes one researcher's exact procedure for one instrument, ported through structured interviews. The model selects which tool to call and with what parameters. The tool produces the result. Regeneration does not change it. We evaluate this claim by running the same photoluminescence analysis on four platforms, including three commercial foundation models, four times each with the same prompt. The typed tool produces identical results across all runs. The commercial platforms either vary in numerical output and analytical methodology across runs, or fail to produce valid results on the task. We deploy this pattern on two instruments serving users over approximately six months, with very positive user feedback. Both cases are very challenging: they involve proprietary binary formats and per-seat licensed software, which force the tool to remain on local infrastructure alongside the data and the instrument it operates. We argue that deployment topology is not just a preference, but a structural requirement of scientific tool mediation. The result is a practical pattern for deploying language models in scientific workflows where reproducibility is mandatory, reducing analysis time from weeks to minutes while guaranteeing identical outputs across runs.

item.title: Compact Latent Manifold Translation: A Parameter-Efficient Foundation Model for Cross-Modal and Cross-Frequency Physiological Signal Synthesis
item.author: Bo Cui, Xiaowen Song, Yaowen Zhang, Shunzhe Zhang, B. J. F. van Beijnum, Monique Tabak, Ying Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种紧凑型潜在流形转换框架，旨在解决生理信号分析中的模态和频率差距问题。

背景: 生理时间序列分析（如心电图和光电容积脉搏波）持续受到异构记录设备导致的模态和频率差距的阻碍。现有基础模型通常依赖连续潜在空间，存在严重的模态纠缠、缺乏高频跨模态生成能力以及高计算成本等问题。

目的: 提出紧凑型潜在流形转换框架，以高效连接这些差距，并实现边缘设备部署。

方法: 提出一种两阶段离散翻译范式。首先引入通用分词器，利用分层残差向量量化将异构信号解耦为隔离且结构良好的离散潜在流形。其次，通过集成静态生理先验的上下文提示潜在翻译器，将这些离散令牌跨模态映射，将复杂的信号合成重新定义为纯潜在序列翻译任务。

主要发现: 该模型在跨模态PPG到ECG合成中，解决了时间相位漂移，并将临床R波检测F1分数从0.37（基线）提高到0.83。在极端跨频率超分辨率（25Hz到100Hz）中，成功恢复高频诊断特征，达到前所未有的皮尔逊相关系数0.9956。

结论: 通过学习生物信号的通用离散语言，该模型以极小的计算足迹实现了边缘部署的多模态医疗基础模型的新轨迹。

翻译: unknown

Abstract

The analysis of physiological time series, such as electrocardiograms (ECG) and photoplethysmograms (PPG), is persistently hindered by modality and frequency gaps stemming from heterogeneous recording devices. Existing foundation models typically rely on continuous latent spaces, which frequently suffer from severe modality entanglement, lack high-fidelity cross-frequency generative capacity, and impose high computational costs that prohibit edge-device deployment. In this paper, we propose Compact Latent Manifold Translation (CLMT), a highly parameter-efficient (0.09B) unified framework that bridges these gaps through a novel two-stage discrete translation paradigm. First, we introduce a Universal Tokenizer utilizing Hierarchical Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ) to decouple heterogeneous signals into isolated, well-structured discrete latent manifolds, effectively preventing inter-modality interference. Second, a Context-Prompted Latent Translator maps these discrete tokens across modalities by integrating static physiological priors, reframing complex signal synthesis as a pure latent sequence translation task. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our 0.09B model significantly outperforms massive baselines. In cross-modal PPG-to-ECG synthesis, it resolves temporal phase drift and dramatically improves the clinical R-peak detection F1-score from 0.37 (baseline) to 0.83. Furthermore, in extreme cross-frequency super-resolution (25Hz to 100Hz), it successfully recovers high-frequency diagnostic landmarks, achieving an unprecedented Pearson correlation of 0.9956. By learning a universal discrete language for biological signals with a fraction of the computational footprint, our approach sets a new trajectory for edge-deployable, multi-modal medical foundation models.

item.title: D-VLA: A High-Concurrency Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models
item.author: Yucheng Guo, Yongjian Guo, Zhong Guan, Wen Huang, Haoran Sun, Haodong Yue, Xiaolong Xiang, Shuai Di, Zhen Sun, Luqiao Wang, Junwu Xiong, Yicheng Gong
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: D-VLA是一个用于大规模分布式强化学习的高并发、低延迟框架，旨在解决视觉-语言-动作模型在物理仿真中的资源冲突问题。

背景: 随着Embodied AI的快速发展，视觉-语言-动作模型在多模态感知和任务执行方面表现出色。然而，在大规模分布式环境中应用强化学习面临严重的系统性瓶颈，主要源于高保真物理仿真与深度学习对VRAM/带宽的密集需求之间的资源冲突，这往往导致整体吞吐量受限于执行阶段的低效。

目的: 提出D-VLA框架，以解决在大规模分布式环境中训练大型视觉-语言-动作模型时面临的资源冲突和执行效率低下的问题。

方法: D-VLA引入了'平面解耦'，在物理上隔离高频训练数据与低频权重控制，以消除仿真与优化之间的干扰。此外，设计了一个四线程异步的'泳道'流水线，实现采样、推理、梯度计算和参数分布的完全并行重叠。还采用了双池VRAM管理模型和拓扑感知复制来解决内存碎片并优化通信效率。

主要发现: 在LIBERO基准测试中，D-VLA在数十亿参数VLA模型的吞吐量和采样效率方面显著优于主流RL框架。在万亿参数的可扩展性测试中，该框架保持了卓越的稳定性和线性加速比。

结论: D-VLA为高性能通用具身智能体提供了一个稳健的系统，能够有效处理大规模模型训练。

翻译: 随着Embodied AI的快速发展，视觉-语言-动作模型在多模态感知和任务执行方面表现出色。然而，在大规模分布式环境中应用强化学习面临严重的系统性瓶颈，主要源于高保真物理仿真与深度学习对VRAM/带宽的密集需求之间的资源冲突，这往往导致整体吞吐量受限于执行阶段的低效。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了D-VLA，一个用于大规模具身基础模型的高并发、低延迟分布式RL框架。D-VLA引入了'平面解耦'，在物理上隔离高频训练数据与低频权重控制，以消除仿真与优化之间的干扰。我们还设计了一个四线程异步的'泳道'流水线，实现采样、推理、梯度计算和参数分布的完全并行重叠。此外，双池VRAM管理模型和拓扑感知复制解决了内存碎片并优化了通信效率。在LIBERO等基准测试中，D-VLA在数十亿参数VLA模型的吞吐量和采样效率方面显著优于主流RL框架。在万亿参数的可扩展性测试中，我们的框架保持了卓越的稳定性和线性加速比，为高性能通用具身智能体提供了一个稳健的系统。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为 D-VLA 的高并发分布式异步强化学习框架，专门用于训练视觉-语言-动作模型。

Abstract

The rapid evolution of Embodied AI has enabled Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to excel in multimodal perception and task execution. However, applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to these massive models in large-scale distributed environments faces severe systemic bottlenecks, primarily due to the resource conflict between high-fidelity physical simulation and the intensive VRAM/bandwidth demands of deep learning. This conflict often leaves overall throughput constrained by execution-phase inefficiencies. To address these challenges, we propose D-VLA, a high-concurrency, low-latency distributed RL framework for large-scale embodied foundation models. D-VLA introduces "Plane Decoupling," physically isolating high-frequency training data from low-frequency weight control to eliminate interference between simulation and optimization. We further design a four-thread asynchronous "Swimlane" pipeline, enabling full parallel overlap of sampling, inference, gradient computation, and parameter distribution. Additionally, a dual-pool VRAM management model and topology-aware replication resolve memory fragmentation and optimize communication efficiency. Experiments on benchmarks like LIBERO show that D-VLA significantly outperforms mainstream RL frameworks in throughput and sampling efficiency for billion-parameter VLA models. In trillion-parameter scalability tests, our framework maintains exceptional stability and linear speedup, providing a robust system for high-performance general-purpose embodied agents.

item.author: Shiyu Tan, Zixuan Zhao, Hao Gao, Zhiheng Chen, Xiaolong Yin, Enya Shen
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Img2CADSeq 是一个多阶段管道，用于从单视图图像重建高质量的 CAD 模型。

背景: BRep 是 CAD 的标准格式，但基于单视图图像重建高质量 BRep 面临拓扑约束和操作序列复杂性的挑战。

目的: 克服重建过程中的局限性，实现从单视图图像重建高质量 CAD 模型。

方法: 提出三级分层代码本编码 CAD 序列，通过优先考虑轮廓而非细节来压缩序列；利用粗到细的点云中间体和对比学习桥接模态差距，并使用 VQ-Diffusion 模型；基于 CAD-220K 和 PrintCAD 数据集。

主要发现: Img2CADSeq 显著优于现有最先进的方法。

结论: 生成的标准 STEP 文件可直接用于商业 CAD 软件。

翻译: 边界表示是计算机辅助设计的标准格式，然而，由于拓扑约束和操作序列的复杂性，从单视图图像重建高质量的 BRep 仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了 Img2CADSeq，这是一个多阶段管道，通过将 CAD 序列编码为三级分层代码本，克服了这些局限性。受重要性优先级指导，该策略优先考虑轮廓而非细节，将长序列压缩到稳定的离散潜在空间。为了桥接模态差距，我们利用粗到细的点云中间体，通过对比学习对齐 2D 视觉特征和 3D CAD 序列，以条件化 VQ-Diffusion 模型。在引入的 CAD-220K 和 PrintCAD 数据集的支持下，我们的方法确保了强大的工业领域适应性。大量实验表明，Img2CADSeq 显著优于最先进的方法，生成的标准 STEP 文件可直接用于商业 CAD 软件。

Abstract

Boundary Representation (BRep) is the standard format for Computer-Aided Design (CAD), yet reconstructing high-quality BReps from single-view images remains challenging due to the complexity of topological constraints and operation sequences. We present Img2CADSeq, a multi-stage pipeline that overcomes these limitations by encoding CAD sequences into a three-level hierarchical codebook. Guided by an importance prioritization, this strategy values profiles over details, compressing long sequences into a stable discrete latent space. To bridge the modality gap, we leverage a coarse-to-fine point cloud intermediate, aligning 2D visual features with 3D CAD sequences via contrastive learning to condition a VQ-Diffusion model. Supported by newly introduced CAD-220K and PrintCAD datasets, our approach ensures robust industrial domain adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Img2CADSeq significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, producing standard STEP files that can be directly used in commercial CAD software.

item.title: HCSG: Human-Centric Semantic-Geometric Reasoning for Vision-Language Navigation
item.author: Haoxuan Xu, Tianfu Li, Wenbo Chen, Yi Liu, Jin Wu, Huashuo Lei, Yunfan Lou, Lujia Wang, Hesheng Wang, Haoang Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: HCSG 是首个面向视觉语言导航的人本框架，通过融合几何预测和语义解释，实现了从被动避障到主动理解人类行为的转变。

背景: 视觉语言导航虽然通过扩展数据和模型容量取得了进展，但在现实室内场景中，静态环境假设失效，机器人不可避免地会遇到动态行人。

目的: 为了解决现有方法仅将人类视为移动障碍物、缺乏明确推理来解读意图或遵守社会规范的问题，提出 HCSG 框架。

方法: HCSG 引入了统一的人类理解模块，结合几何预测（预测姿态和轨迹）和语义解释（利用视觉语言模型生成自然语言描述）。此外，引入社会距离损失以强制执行社会合规的交互距离。这些表示被融合到拓扑地图中以进行指令规划。

主要发现: 在 HA-VLNCE 基准测试中，HCSG 显著优于最先进的方法，成功率达到 14% 的提升，碰撞率降低 34%。

结论: 该框架为动态人机环境中的安全、社会智能导航提供了坚实基础，项目链接见文末。

翻译: VLN 通过扩展数据和模型容量取得了显著进展。然而，在现实室内场景中，静态环境的假设失效，机器人不可避免地会遇到动态行人。现有的人本方法通常仅基于隐式视觉线索将人类视为移动障碍物，缺乏解读人类意图或遵守社会规范所需的明确推理。为此，我们提出了 HCSG，首个面向 VLN 的人本框架。该框架为动态人机环境中的安全、社会智能导航提供了坚实基础，将范式从被动避障转变为主动理解人类行为。具体而言，HCSG 引入了统一的人类理解模块，协同两种关键能力：（i）几何预测，预测人类姿态和轨迹以预判未来运动动态；（ii）语义解释，利用视觉语言模型生成人类动作和意图的自然语言描述。这些语义几何表示被融合到智能体的拓扑地图中以进行指令条件规划。此外，引入了社会距离损失以强制执行社会合规的交互距离。在 HA-VLNCE 基准测试上的广泛实验表明，HCSG 显著优于最先进的方法，成功率达到 14% 的提升，碰撞率降低 34%。我们的项目可见于 https://haoxuanxu1024.github.io/HCSG/。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了人本语义几何推理（HCSG）框架，通过结合语义信息和几何推理来提升视觉语言导航的性能。

Abstract

VLN has achieved remarkable progress by scaling data and model capacity. However, the assumption of a static environment breaks down in real-world indoor scenarios, where robots inevitably encounter dynamic pedestrians. Existing human-aware approaches typically treat humans merely as moving obstacles based on implicit visual cues, lacking the explicit reasoning required to interpret human intentions or maintain social norms. To address this, we propose HCSG, the first human-centric framework for VLN. This framework provides a robust foundation for safe, socially intelligent navigation in dynamic human-robot environments that shifts the paradigm from passive collision avoidance to active human behavior understanding. Specifically, HCSG introduces a unified Human Understanding Module that synergizes two key capabilities: (i) geometric forecasting, which predicts human pose and trajectory to anticipate future motion dynamics; and (ii) semantic interpretation, which leverages a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to generate natural language descriptions of human actions and intentions. These semantic-geometric representations are fused into the agent's topological map for instruction-conditioned planning. Furthermore, a social distance loss is introduced to enforce socially compliant interaction distances. Extensive experiments on the HA-VLNCE benchmark demonstrate that HCSG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving a 14% improvement in Success Rate and a 34% reduction in Collision Rate. Our project can be seen at https://haoxuanxu1024.github.io/HCSG/.

item.title: AI Harness Engineering: A Runtime Substrate for Foundation-Model Software Agents
item.author: Hailin Zhong, Shengxin Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种名为AI Harness Engineering的新框架，旨在通过构建一个模型-工具-环境系统来解决自主软件工程代理在现实开发中不可靠的问题。

背景: 虽然基础模型已经改变了自动化代码生成，但自主软件工程代理在现实开发环境中仍然不可靠。现有的解释主要归因于模型能力的不足。

目的: 研究旨在重新定位自主软件工程能力的来源，提出通过构建一个包含运行时基底的模型-工具-环境系统来提升代理的可靠性。

方法: 研究将运行时基底形式化为AI Harness Engineering，定义了包括任务规范、上下文选择、工具访问等在内的11个组件责任。通过四个级别的阶梯（H0-H3）来操作化基底的实现，并提出了一种基于追踪的评估协议。

主要发现: 在受控验证任务中，该框架生成的证据结构随基底的级别变化：低级别仅产生最终补丁，高级别产生重现日志、失败归因、确定性需求检查和结构化验证报告。

结论: 该框架将自主软件工程的核心问题从基础模型是否能产生补丁重新定义为模型-工具-环境系统能否产生可验证的、可归因的且可维护的变更。

翻译: 摘要：基础模型已经改变了自动化代码生成，但自主软件工程代理在现实开发设置中仍然不可靠。主导解释将这一差距归因于模型能力。我们提出了一个不同的定位：软件工程能力源于一个模型-工具-环境系统，其中运行时基底——工具——调节基础模型代理如何观察项目、对其采取行动、接收反馈并建立变更已完成。我们将该基底形式化为AI Harness Engineering，并识别了11个组件责任：任务规范、上下文选择、工具访问、项目记忆、任务状态、可观测性、失败归因、验证、权限、熵审计和干预记录。我们通过一个四级阶梯（H0-H3）将工具操作化，该阶梯逐步将运行时支持暴露给代理，并提出了一种基于追踪的评估协议，将每个代理运行转换为可审计的剧集包。应用于受控验证任务时，该框架产生的证据结构随工具级别系统地变化：低级别仅产生最终补丁，高级别产生重现日志、失败归因、确定性需求检查和结构化验证报告。该框架将自主软件工程的核心问题从基础模型是否能产生补丁重新定义为模型-工具-环境系统能否产生可验证的、可归因的且可维护的变更。我们概述了基础模型软件代理所需的运行时系统的研究计划。

Abstract

Foundation models have transformed automated code generation, yet autonomous software-engineering agents remain unreliable in realistic development settings. The dominant explanation locates this gap in model capability. We propose a different locus: software-engineering capability emerges from a model-harness-environment system, in which a runtime substrate -- the harness -- mediates how a foundation-model agent observes a project, acts on it, receives feedback, and establishes that a change is complete. We formalize this substrate as an AI Harness Engineering and identify eleven component responsibilities: task specification, context selection, tool access, project memory, task state, observability, failure attribution, verification, permissions, entropy auditing, and intervention recording. We operationalize the harness through a four-level ladder (H0-H3) that progressively exposes runtime support to the agent, and we propose a trace-based evaluation protocol that converts each agent run into an auditable episode package. Applied to a controlled validation task, the framework yields episode packages whose evidence structure varies systematically with harness level: lower levels produce only a final patch, higher levels produce reproduction logs, failure attributions, deterministic requirement checks, and structured verification reports. The framework reframes the central question of autonomous software engineering from whether a foundation model can produce a patch to whether the model-harness-environment system can produce a verifiably correct, attributed, and maintainable change. We outline a research program for the runtime systems that foundation-model software agents will require.

item.title: Backbone is All You Need: Assessing Vulnerabilities of Frozen Foundation Models in Synthetic Image Forensics
item.author: Chiara Musso, Joy Battocchio, Andrea Montibeller, Giulia Boato
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于 ViT 的灰盒攻击方法，利用检测器骨干网络知识在特征空间内生成对抗样本，以破坏检测器可靠性。

背景: 随着合成图像越来越逼真，ViTs 成为深度伪造检测的核心，但依赖冻结的预训练骨干网络存在漏洞。

目的: 揭示仅利用检测器 ViT 骨干网络知识即可破坏检测器可靠性的漏洞，并提出一种灰盒攻击方法。

方法: 提出 Surrogate Iterative Adversarial Attack (SIAA)，这是一种灰盒攻击，仅利用对检测器 ViT 骨干网络的知识，并在目标检测器的特征空间内操作。

主要发现: 在多种 ViT 检测器和灰盒场景下，该方法能产生高攻击成功率，通常接近白盒性能。

结论: 仅利用骨干网络知识就足以破坏检测器可靠性，突显了在对抗性多媒体取证中需要更具韧性的防御措施。

翻译: 随着人工智能生成的合成图像变得越来越逼真，Vision Transformers (ViTs) 已成为现代深度伪造检测的基石。然而，普遍依赖冻结的预训练骨干网络引入了一个微妙但关键的漏洞。在这项工作中，我们提出了 Surrogate Iterative Adversarial Attack (SIAA)，这是一种灰盒攻击，仅利用对检测器 ViT 骨干网络的知识，并在目标检测器的特征空间内完全操作，以制作高度有效的对抗样本。通过我们的实验，涉及多个基于 ViT 的检测器和不同的灰盒场景，包括少样本学习、完全训练错位和攻击可转移性测试，我们证明这种漏洞始终产生高攻击成功率，通常接近白盒性能。通过这样做，我们揭示仅利用骨干网络知识就足以破坏检测器的可靠性，强调了在对抗性多媒体取证中需要更具韧性的防御措施。

Abstract

As AI-generated synthetic images become increasingly realistic, Vision Transformers (ViTs) have emerged as a cornerstone of modern deepfake detection. However, the prevailing reliance on frozen, pre-trained backbones introduces a subtle yet critical vulnerability. In this work, we present the Surrogate Iterative Adversarial Attack (SIAA), a gray-box attack that exploits knowledge of the detector's ViT backbone alone and operates entirely within the target detector's feature space to craft highly effective adversarial examples. Through our experiments, involving multiple ViT-based detectors and diverse gray-box scenarios, including few-shot learning, complete training misalignment and attack transferability tests, we demonstrate that this vulnerability consistently yields high attack success rates, often approaching white-box performance. By doing so, we reveal that backbone knowledge alone is sufficient to undermine detector reliability, highlighting the urgent need for more resilient defenses in adversarial multimedia forensics.

item.title: Align then Adapt: Rethinking Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning in 4D Perception
item.author: Yiding Sun, Jihua Zhu, Haozhe Cheng, Chaoyi Lu, Zhichuan Yang, Lin Chen, Yaonan Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对4D数据稀缺的问题，提出了一种名为PointATA的“对齐后适应”范式，通过两阶段参数高效迁移学习，将预训练的3D模型迁移到4D感知任务中，以克服过拟合和模态差距。

背景: 点云视频理解对机器人技术至关重要，因为它能准确编码运动和场景交互。然而，4D数据集远比3D数据集稀缺，这阻碍了自监督4D模型的扩展性。

目的: 将预训练的3D模型迁移到4D感知任务，并解决迁移过程中遇到的过拟合和模态差距两个关键限制。

方法: 开发了名为PointATA的“对齐后适应”范式。第一阶段利用最优传输理论训练点对齐嵌入器以缓解模态差距；第二阶段在冻结的3D骨干网上集成点视频适配器和空间上下文编码器以增强时间建模能力并缓解过拟合。

主要发现: PointATA能够使不具备时间知识的预训练3D模型以更小的参数成本推理动态视频内容。实验表明，其在3D动作识别、4D动作分割和4D语义分割等任务上达到了与全微调模型相当甚至更优的性能。

结论: PointATA成功实现了3D模型向4D任务的迁移，在保持参数高效的同时，在多个任务上取得了优异的实验结果。

翻译: Point cloud video understanding is critical for robotics as it accurately encodes motion and scene interaction. We recognize that 4D datasets are far scarcer than 3D ones, which hampers the scalability of self-supervised 4D models. A promising alternative is to transfer 3D pre-trained models to 4D perception tasks. However, rigorous empirical analysis reveals two critical limitations that impede transfer capability: overfitting and the modality gap. To overcome these challenges, we develop a novel "Align then Adapt" (PointATA) paradigm that decomposes parameter-efficient transfer learning into two sequential stages. Optimal-transport theory is employed to quantify the distributional discrepancy between 3D and 4D datasets, enabling our proposed point align embedder to be trained in Stage 1 to alleviate the underlying modality gap. To mitigate overfitting, an efficient point-video adapter and a spatial-context encoder are integrated into the frozen 3D backbone to enhance temporal modeling capacity in Stage 2. Notably, with the above engineering-oriented designs, PointATA enables a pre-trained 3D model without temporal knowledge to reason about dynamic video content at a smaller parameter cost compared to previous work. Extensive experiments show that PointATA can match or even outperform strong full fine-tuning models, whilst enjoying the advantage of parameter efficiency, e.g. 97.21 accuracy on 3D action recognition, +8.7 on 4 D action segmentation, and 84.06 on 4D semantic segmentation.

Abstract

Point cloud video understanding is critical for robotics as it accurately encodes motion and scene interaction. We recognize that 4D datasets are far scarcer than 3D ones, which hampers the scalability of self-supervised 4D models. A promising alternative is to transfer 3D pre-trained models to 4D perception tasks. However, rigorous empirical analysis reveals two critical limitations that impede transfer capability: overfitting and the modality gap. To overcome these challenges, we develop a novel "Align then Adapt" (PointATA) paradigm that decomposes parameter-efficient transfer learning into two sequential stages. Optimal-transport theory is employed to quantify the distributional discrepancy between 3D and 4D datasets, enabling our proposed point align embedder to be trained in Stage 1 to alleviate the underlying modality gap. To mitigate overfitting, an efficient point-video adapter and a spatial-context encoder are integrated into the frozen 3D backbone to enhance temporal modeling capacity in Stage 2. Notably, with the above engineering-oriented designs, PointATA enables a pre-trained 3D model without temporal knowledge to reason about dynamic video content at a smaller parameter cost compared to previous work. Extensive experiments show that PointATA can match or even outperform strong full fine-tuning models, whilst enjoying the advantage of parameter efficiency, e.g. 97.21 \% accuracy on 3D action recognition, $+8.7 \%$ on 4 D action segmentation, and 84.06\% on 4D semantic segmentation.

item.title: SparseGF: A Height-Aware Sparse Segmentation Framework with Context Compression for Robust Ground Filtering Across Urban to Natural Scenes
item.author: Qin, Nannan, Tao, Pengjie, Guan, Haiyan, Kang, Zhizhong, Ma, Lingfei, Hu, Xiangyun, Li, Jonathan
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 SparseGF 的高度感知稀疏分割框架，旨在解决激光雷达点云地面滤波中的上下文细节困境和高大物体误分类问题。

背景: 高质量的数字地形模型对地理空间分析至关重要，通常依赖地面滤波技术。虽然深度学习方法表现良好，但在跨场景泛化方面存在局限，主要受限于大规模处理中的上下文细节困境以及仅优化分类导致的对高大物体的随机误分类。

目的: 克服现有深度学习地面滤波方法在跨场景泛化中的两个问题：大规模处理中的上下文细节困境以及高大物体的随机误分类。

方法: 提出了 SparseGF 框架，包含三个创新：1. 凸面镜灵感上下文压缩模块，将广阔上下文压缩为紧凑表示并保留中心细节；2. 混合稀疏体素点网络架构，有效解释压缩表示并减轻几何失真；3. 高度感知损失函数，强制地形高程先验以抑制误分类。

主要发现: 在两个大规模数据集上评估显示，SparseGF 在城市到自然地形上表现稳健。在复杂城市场景中表现领先，在混合地形上表现具有竞争力，在茂密森林陡峭地区表现中等但非灾难性。

结论: 该工作为深度学习地面滤波研究提供新见解，鼓励进一步探索真正的大规模环境监测跨场景泛化。

翻译: 从机载激光扫描 ALS 数据派生的高质量数字地形模型对于广泛的地理空间分析至关重要，其生成通常依赖于稳健的地面滤波 GF，将跨越多样化景观的点云分为地面和非地面部分。虽然当前的基于深度学习的 GF 方法已经展示了令人印象深刻的性能，特别是在特定的具有挑战性的地形上，但它们的跨场景泛化仍然受到两个持续问题的限制：由于计算资源有限导致的大规模处理中的上下文细节困境，以及仅优化分类导致的对高大物体的随机误分类。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了 SparseGF，一种增强上下文压缩的高度感知稀疏分割框架。它建立在三个关键创新之上：(1) 凸面镜灵感的上下文压缩模块，将广阔的上下文压缩为紧凑的表示，同时保留中心细节；(2) 混合稀疏体素点网络架构，有效地解释压缩的表示，同时减轻压缩引起的几何失真；(3) 高度感知损失函数，在训练期间明确强制地形高程先验，以抑制对高大物体的随机误分类。在两个大规模 ALS 基准数据集上的广泛评估表明，SparseGF 在从城市到自然的地形上提供了稳健的 GF，在复杂城市场景中实现了领先的性能，在混合地形上具有竞争力的结果，在茂密森林陡峭地区具有中等但非灾难性的准确性。这项工作为基于深度学习的 GF 研究提供了新的见解，并鼓励进一步探索真正的大规模环境监测的跨场景泛化。

深度解读

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: unknown

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: unknown

Abstract

High-quality digital terrain models derived from airborne laser scanning (ALS) data are essential for a wide range of geospatial analyses, and their generation typically relies on robust ground filtering (GF) to separate point clouds across diverse landscapes into ground and non-ground parts. Although current deep-learning-based GF methods have demonstrated impressive performance, especially in specific challenging terrains, their cross-scene generalization remains limited by two persistent issues: the context-detail dilemma in large-scale processing due to limited computational resources, and the random misclassification of tall objects arising from classification-only optimization. To overcome these limitations, we propose SparseGF, a height-aware sparse segmentation framework enhanced with context compression. It is built upon three key innovations: (1) a convex-mirror-inspired context compression module that condenses expansive contexts into compact representations while preserving central details; (2) a hybrid sparse voxel-point network architecture that effectively interprets compressed representations while mitigating compression-induced geometric distortion; and (3) a height-aware loss function that explicitly enforces topographic elevation priors during training to suppress random misclassification of tall objects. Extensive evaluations on two large-scale ALS benchmark datasets demonstrate that SparseGF delivers robust GF across urban to natural terrains, achieving leading performance in complex urban scenes, competitive results on mixed terrains, and moderate yet non-catastrophic accuracy in densely forested steep areas. This work offers new insights into deep-learning-based GF research and encourages further exploration toward truly cross-scene generalization for large-scale environmental monitoring.

item.title: Channel-Free Human Activity Recognition via Inductive-Bias-Aware Fusion Design for Heterogeneous IoT Sensor Environments
item.author: Hasegawa, Tatsuhito
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种无通道的人体活动识别框架，通过结合通道级编码、共享编码器和元数据条件化的后期融合，解决了异构传感器设置下的模型复用难题。

背景: 物联网环境中的HAR面临异构传感器设置，导致传统的通道固定模型难以跨环境复用。

目的: 研究严格的无通道HAR，提出一种不依赖固定通道数量、顺序或语义排列的共享模型。

方法: 提出无通道HAR框架，结合通道级编码与共享编码器，使用元数据条件化的后期融合（条件批归一化）和组合损失进行联合优化。

主要发现: 摘要提到在PAMAP2数据集上进行了实验，并在六个HAR数据集上进行了鲁棒性分析、消融研究、敏感性分析、效率评估和跨数据集迁移学习，但具体发现未在摘要中完整列出。

结论: 模型通过独立处理每个通道处理可变通道配置，元数据帮助恢复结构信息，联合损失鼓励通道判别性和最终融合预测的一致性。

翻译: 物联网环境中的HAR必须应对异构的传感器设置，这些设置在不同数据集、设备、身体位置、传感模态和通道组合上各不相同。这种异构性使得传统的通道固定模型难以跨传感环境复用，因为它们的输入表示与预定义的通道结构紧密耦合。为了解决这个问题，我们研究了严格的无通道HAR，即单个共享模型在不假设输入通道的固定数量、顺序或语义排列的情况下进行推理，也不依赖传感器特定的输入层或数据集特定的通道模板。我们认为融合设计是此设置中的核心问题。因此，我们提出了一种无通道HAR框架，结合通道级编码与共享编码器，通过条件批归一化进行元数据条件化的后期融合，并通过组合损失对通道级和融合预测进行联合优化。所提出的模型独立处理每个通道以处理可变的通道配置，而传感器元数据（如身体位置、模态和轴）有助于恢复通道独立处理无法保留的结构信息。此外，联合损失鼓励单个通道的判别性和最终融合预测的一致性。在PAMAP2上的实验，连同六个HAR数据集上的鲁棒性分析、消融研究、敏感性分析、效率评估和跨数据集迁移学习，证明了三个主要发现...

Abstract

Human activity recognition (HAR) in Internet of Things (IoT) environments must cope with heterogeneous sensor settings that vary across datasets, devices, body locations, sensing modalities, and channel compositions. This heterogeneity makes conventional channel-fixed models difficult to reuse across sensing environments because their input representations are tightly coupled to predefined channel structures. To address this problem, we investigate strict channel-free HAR, in which a single shared model performs inference without assuming a fixed number, order, or semantic arrangement of input channels, and without relying on sensor-specific input layers or dataset-specific channel templates. We argue that fusion design is the central issue in this setting. Accordingly, we propose a channel-free HAR framework that combines channel-wise encoding with a shared encoder, metadata-conditioned late fusion via conditional batch normalization, and joint optimization of channel-level and fused predictions through a combination loss. The proposed model processes each channel independently to handle varying channel configurations, while sensor metadata such as body location, modality, and axis help recover structural information that channel-independent processing alone cannot retain. In addition, the joint loss encourages both the discriminability of individual channels and the consistency of the final fused prediction. Experiments on PAMAP2, together with robustness analysis on six HAR datasets, ablation studies, sensitivity analysis, efficiency evaluation, and cross-dataset transfer learning, demonstrate three main findings...

item.title: Generalizing Numerical Reasoning in Table Data through Operation Sketches and Self-Supervised Learning
item.author: Cho, Hanjun, Yoo, Gahyun, Kim, Hanseong, Lee, Jay-Yoon
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该论文提出了一种名为 TaNOS 的持续预训练框架，旨在解决专家领域表格数值推理在领域转移时的鲁棒性问题。

背景: 专家领域表格上的数值推理通常在特定领域内准确率高，但在领域转移时鲁棒性有限。基于 SFT 的模型往往依赖表头操作捷径而非结构推理。

目的: 通过解耦领域语义和数值操作结构，提高数值推理的迁移能力。

方法: TaNOS 包含三个组件：表头匿名化以减少词汇记忆，提供最小结构线索的操作草图，以及自监督预训练，通过程序优先的方式构建正确性保证的程序-问题对。

主要发现: 在 FinQA 数据集上，使用 10% 训练数据时，TaNOS 达到 80.13% 的执行准确率，优于使用全部训练数据的 SFT 基线以及 GPT-5 和 Gemini-2.5-Pro 等模型。在领域转移实验中，TaNOS 的跨领域差距几乎可以忽略不计，而标准 SFT 的差距超过 10 个百分点。

结论: 结构引导、表头无关表示和正确性保证的自监督方法可以提高跨不同专家领域表格的数值推理鲁棒性。

翻译: Numerical reasoning over expert-domain tables often exhibits high in-domain accuracy but limited robustness to domain shift. Models trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on specific datasets tend to rely on header-operation shortcuts rather than structural reasoning. We introduce TaNOS, a continual pre-training framework comprising three components: (i) header anonymization to reduce lexical memorization, (ii) operation sketches that provide minimal structural cues, and (iii) self-supervised pretraining that constructs correctness-guaranteed program-question pairs from given tables in a program-first manner. By decoupling domain semantics and numerical operation structure, TaNOS improves the transferability of numerical reasoning. Applied to an 8B instruction-tuned model, TaNOS achieves 80.13% execution accuracy on FinQA with only 10% train data, outperforming SFT baseline (73.97%) with full train data and proprietary models such as GPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Pro. Furthermore, in the domain-shift experiments, TaNOS displays nearly-negligible cross-domain gap when standard SFT shows over 10pp gap. These results suggest that structural guidance with operation sketches, header-agnostic representations, and correctness-guaranteed self-supervision can improve the robustness of numerical reasoning across diverse expert-domain tables.

Abstract

Numerical reasoning over expert-domain tables often exhibits high in-domain accuracy but limited robustness to domain shift. Models trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on specific datasets tend to rely on header-operation shortcuts rather than structural reasoning. We introduce TaNOS, a continual pre-training framework comprising three components: (i) header anonymization to reduce lexical memorization, (ii) operation sketches that provide minimal structural cues, and (iii) self-supervised pretraining that constructs correctness-guaranteed program-question pairs from given tables in a program-first manner. By decoupling domain semantics and numerical operation structure, TaNOS improves the transferability of numerical reasoning. Applied to an 8B instruction-tuned model, TaNOS achieves 80.13% execution accuracy on FinQA with only 10% train data, outperforming SFT baseline (73.97%) with full train data and proprietary models such as GPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Pro. Furthermore, in the domain-shift experiments, TaNOS displays nearly-negligible cross-domain gap (<2pp) when standard SFT shows over 10pp gap. These results suggest that structural guidance with operation sketches, header-agnostic representations, and correctness-guaranteed self-supervision can improve the robustness of numerical reasoning across diverse expert-domain tables.

item.title: Sculpt4D: Generating 4D Shapes via Sparse-Attention Diffusion Transformers
item.author: Yin, Minghao, Hu, Wenbo, Xu, Jiale, Shan, Ying, Han, Kai
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Sculpt4D 是一个原生 4D 生成框架，通过块稀疏注意力机制在预训练模型上实现高效的时间建模。

背景: 3D 生成模型在静态形状合成上取得了进展，但高保真动态 4D 生成仍面临时间伪影和计算成本高昂的挑战。

目的: 解决高保真动态 4D 生成中的时间伪影问题，并降低计算需求，同时缓解 4D 训练数据稀缺的问题。

方法: 将高效的时间建模集成到预训练的 3D 扩散 Transformer 中，核心采用块稀疏注意力机制，通过锚定初始帧和利用时间衰减稀疏掩码来捕获运动动态。

主要发现: 该方法忠实地建模了复杂的时空依赖关系，避免了全注意力的二次方开销，并将网络总计算量减少了 56%。

结论: Sculpt4D 在时间连贯的 4D 合成方面建立了新的 SOTA，为高效且可扩展的 4D 生成开辟了道路。

翻译: 3D 生成建模的最新突破在静态形状合成方面取得了显著进展，但高保真动态 4D 生成仍然难以实现，受到时间伪影和 prohibitively 计算需求的阻碍。我们提出了 Sculpt4D，一个原生 4D 生成框架，将高效的时间建模无缝集成到预训练的 3D 扩散 Transformer 中，从而缓解了 4D 训练数据的稀缺性。其核心是一个块稀疏注意力机制，通过锚定初始帧来保持物体身份，同时通过时间衰减稀疏掩码捕获丰富的运动动态。该设计忠实地以高保真度建模复杂的时空依赖关系，同时避开了全注意力的二次方开销，并将网络总计算量减少了 56%。因此，Sculpt4D 在时间连贯的 4D 合成方面建立了新的 SOTA，并为高效且可扩展的 4D 生成开辟了道路。

Abstract

Recent breakthroughs in 3D generative modeling have yielded remarkable progress in static shape synthesis, yet high-fidelity dynamic 4D generation remains elusive, hindered by temporal artifacts and prohibitive computational demand. We present Sculpt4D, a native 4D generative framework that seamlessly integrates efficient temporal modeling into a pretrained 3D Diffusion Transformer (Hunyuan3D 2.1), thereby mitigating the scarcity of 4D training data. At its core lies a Block Sparse Attention mechanism that preserves object identity by anchoring to the initial frame while capturing rich motion dynamics via a time-decaying sparse mask. This design faithfully models complex spatiotemporal dependencies with high fidelity, while sidestepping the quadratic overhead of full attention and reducing network total computation by 56%. Consequently, Sculpt4D establishes a new state-of-the-art in temporally coherent 4D synthesis and charts a path toward efficient and scalable 4D generation.

item.title: Task-specific Subnetwork Discovery in Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Underwater Navigation
item.author: Liu, Yi-Ling, Laux, Melvin, Alvarez, Mariela De Lucas, Kirchner, Frank, Adam, Rebecca
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对水下自主水下航行器的多任务控制问题，分析了预训练多任务强化学习网络的内部结构，发现其仅用少量权重即可区分不同任务。

背景: 水下自主水下航行器需要在动态不确定环境下执行多任务，传统控制器难以应对。虽然强化学习能克服部分局限，但其内部决策过程不透明，缺乏透明度和信任感，阻碍了实际部署。

目的: 分析预训练的多任务强化学习网络的内部结构，理解任务特定专业化，以解决透明度和可解释性问题。

方法: 在 HoloOcean 模拟器中，分析预训练的多任务强化学习网络的内部结构，识别并比较负责导航至不同物种的任务特定子网络。

主要发现: 在相关任务的上下文多任务强化学习设置中，网络仅使用约一点五成的权重来区分任务；其中约八成五的连接用于连接输入层的上下文变量节点与下一隐藏层。

结论: 该方法揭示了共享和专业化网络组件，有助于通过上下文多任务强化学习实现水下监测的高效模型编辑、迁移学习和持续学习。

翻译: 水下自主水下航行器需要在动态、不确定的条件和有限的感知下，以自适应和可解释的方式执行多项任务，这是经典控制器难以应对的挑战。这要求具有稳健、可泛化和内在可解释的控制策略，以进行可靠的长期监测。强化学习，特别是多任务强化学习，通过利用共享表示来促进跨任务和环境的有效适应，克服了这些局限性。然而，尽管此类策略在模拟和受控实验中显示出有希望的结果，但它们仍然不透明，对智能体的内部决策提供有限的洞察，造成了透明度、信任和安全方面的差距，阻碍了现实世界的部署。内部策略结构和任务特定专业化仍然知之甚少。为了解决这些差距，我们在 HoloOcean 模拟器中分析了预训练的多任务强化学习网络的内部结构，通过识别和比较负责导航至不同物种的任务特定子网络，对水下导航进行了研究。我们发现，在具有相关任务的上下文多任务强化学习设置中，网络仅使用约一点五成的权重来区分任务。其中，约八成五的连接将输入层的上下文变量节点连接到下一隐藏层，突出了上下文变量在此类设置中的重要性。我们的方法提供了对共享和专业化网络组件的见解，通过上下文多任务强化学习方法，有助于水下监测的高效模型编辑、迁移学习和持续学习。

Abstract

Autonomous underwater vehicles are required to perform multiple tasks adaptively and in an explainable manner under dynamic, uncertain conditions and limited sensing, challenges that classical controllers struggle to address. This demands robust, generalizable, and inherently interpretable control policies for reliable long-term monitoring. Reinforcement learning, particularly multi-task RL, overcomes these limitations by leveraging shared representations to enable efficient adaptation across tasks and environments. However, while such policies show promising results in simulation and controlled experiments, they yet remain opaque and offer limited insight into the agent's internal decision-making, creating gaps in transparency, trust, and safety that hinder real-world deployment. The internal policy structure and task-specific specialization remain poorly understood. To address these gaps, we analyze the internal structure of a pretrained multi-task reinforcement learning network in the HoloOcean simulator for underwater navigation by identifying and comparing task-specific subnetworks responsible for navigating toward different species. We find that in a contextual multi-task reinforcement learning setting with related tasks, the network uses only about 1.5% of its weights to differentiate between tasks. Of these, approximately 85% connect the context-variable nodes in the input layer to the next hidden layer, highlighting the importance of context variables in such settings. Our approach provides insights into shared and specialized network components, useful for efficient model editing, transfer learning, and continual learning for underwater monitoring through a contextual multi-task reinforcement learning method.

item.title: SemEval-2026 Task 4: Narrative Story Similarity and Narrative Representation Learning
item.author: Hatzel, Hans Ole, Artemova, Ekaterina, Stiemer, Haimo Paul, Gius, Evelyn, Biemann, Chris
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了叙事相似性和叙事表示学习共享任务NSNRL，将叙事相似性定义为二分类问题，并基于新定义收集了超过1000个故事摘要三元组的标注数据，评估了叙事嵌入表示。

背景: 叙事相似性和叙事表示学习领域。

目的: 操作化叙事相似性，评估叙事嵌入表示，并收集标注数据以支持研究。

方法: 将叙事相似性定义为二分类问题，引入兼容叙事理论和直观判断的新定义，收集了超过1000个故事摘要三元组的标注数据，评估叙事嵌入表示，并概述了提交系统的技术和采样标注过程。

主要发现: 在基于三元组的分类设置中，大语言模型集成是得分最高的系统；在嵌入设置中，在预训练嵌入模型上进行预处理和后处理的系统与自定义微调解决方案表现相当；分析表明自动系统在两个赛道上都有改进的潜力。

结论: 自动化系统仍有改进空间，任务网站提供了嵌入可视化和实例级分类结果。

翻译: 我们提出了关于叙事相似性和叙事表示学习的共享任务——NSNRL。该任务将叙事相似性操作化为一个二分类问题：确定两个故事中哪个与锚点故事更相似。我们引入了一种兼容叙事理论和直观判断的叙事相似性新定义。基于在此概念下收集的相似性判断，我们还评估了叙事嵌入表示。我们为超过1000个故事摘要三元组收集了至少两个标注，每个标注都由至少两名达成一致的标注员支持。本文描述了数据集的采样和标注过程；此外，我们概述了提交系统的技术和它们所采用的方法。我们在两个赛道上收到了来自46个团队的71个最终提交。在我们的基于三元组的分类设置中，大语言模型集成构成了许多得分最高的系统，而在嵌入设置中，在预训练嵌入模型上进行预处理的系统与自定义微调解决方案表现相当。我们的分析确定了自动化系统在两个赛道上改进的潜在空间。任务网站包含了嵌入的可视化以及所有团队的实例级分类结果。

Abstract

We present the shared task on narrative similarity and narrative representation learning - NSNRL (pronounced "nass-na-rel"). The task operationalizes narrative similarity as a binary classification problem: determining which of two stories is more similar to an anchor story. We introduce a novel definition of narrative similarity, compatible with both narrative theory and intuitive judgment. Based on the similarity judgments collected under this concept, we also evaluate narrative embedding representations. We collected at least two annotations each for more than 1,000 story summary triples, with each annotation being backed by at least two annotators in agreement. This paper describes the sampling and annotation process for the dataset; further, we give an overview of the submitted systems and the techniques they employ. We received a total of 71 final submissions from 46 teams across our two tracks. In our triple-based classification setup, LLM ensembles make up many of the top-scoring systems, while in the embedding setup, systems with pre- and post-processing on pretrained embedding models perform about on par with custom fine-tuned solutions. Our analysis identifies potential headroom for improvement of automated systems in both tracks. The task website includes visualizations of embeddings alongside instance-level classification results for all teams.

item.title: CRS-LLM: Cooperative Beam Prediction with a GPT-Style Backbone and Switch-Gated Fusion
item.author: Li, Fangzhi, Pan, Cunhua, Ren, Hong, Wang, Dongming, Wang, Jiangzhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的协作波束预测框架，旨在解决V2X场景下毫米波通信的波束跟踪难题。

背景: 毫米波通信依赖高度定向的波束成形，而V2X场景中的快速移动、遮挡和几何变化使得波束跟踪极具挑战性。在协作多基站系统中，传统分层方法通常分离基站选择和波束选择，在波束状态突变时容易产生误差传播。

目的: 提出协作无线电感知大语言模型框架，用于下一步的联合基站和波束预测，避免级联决策错误。

方法: 将波束跟踪转化为联合基站-波束空间的单分类问题。采用双视图CSI分词器通过轻量级CNN前端和时序分词模块提取频域和时延域信道特征。使用截断的GPT风格骨干网络进行时序建模。此外，使用过渡感知开关门控预测器结合稳定分支、残差翻转分支和低秩过渡先验来同时捕捉平滑演化和突变。

主要发现: 仿真结果表明，CRS-LLM在不同信噪比条件下，在Top-1准确率和归一化波束增益方面均优于CSI-Transformer、分层基站-波束以及典型的CNN和RNN基线。此外，它还表现出强大的少样本性能和有前景的零样本迁移能力。

结论: 该方法有效解决了波束跟踪问题，在性能上优于现有基线模型。

翻译: 毫米波通信依赖于高度定向的波束成形，而车辆到万物V2X场景中的快速移动、遮挡和几何形状的快速变化使得波束跟踪具有挑战性。在协作多基站系统中，传统的分层方法通常分离基站选择和波束选择，当波束状态突然变化时，这可能会导致误差传播。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了协作无线电感知大语言模型，这是一种用于下一步联合基站-波束预测的协作波束预测框架。CRS-LLM将波束跟踪转化为联合基站-波束空间上的单分类问题，避免了级联决策错误。为了将信道状态信息适应大语言模型，双视图CSI分词器通过轻量级CNN前端和时序分词模块提取频域和时延域信道特征。然后使用截断的GPT风格骨干网络进行时序建模，并进行参数高效适配。此外，过渡感知开关门控预测器结合了稳定分支、残差翻转分支和低秩过渡先验，以同时捕捉平滑演化和突变。仿真结果表明，CRS-LLM在不同信噪比条件下的Top-1准确率和归一化波束增益方面均优于CSI-Transformer、分层基站-波束以及典型的CNN和RNN基线，同时还表现出强大的少样本性能和有前景的零样本迁移能力。

Abstract

Millimeter-wave (mmWave) communication depends on highly directional beamforming, while fast mobility, blockage, and rapid geometry changes in vehicle-to-everything (V2X) scenarios make beam tracking challenging. In cooperative multi-base-station (BS) systems, conventional hierarchical methods usually separate BS selection and beam selection, which may cause error propagation when beam states change abruptly. To address this issue, this paper proposes Cooperative Radio Sensing with Large Language Models (CRS-LLM), a cooperative beam prediction framework for next-step joint BS-beam prediction. CRS-LLM formulates beam tracking as a single classification problem over the joint BS-beam space, avoiding cascaded decision errors. To adapt channel state information (CSI) to large language models, a dual-view CSI tokenizer extracts frequency-domain and delay-domain channel features through a lightweight CNN front-end and temporal tokenization module. A truncated GPT-style backbone is then used for temporal modeling with parameter-efficient adaptation. In addition, a transition-aware switch-gated predictor combines a stable branch, a residual flip branch, and a low-rank transition prior to capture both smooth evolution and abrupt changes. Simulation results show that CRS-LLM outperforms CSI-Transformer, Hierarchical BS-Beam, and representative CNN- and recurrent-neural-network baselines in Top-1 accuracy and normalized beam gain under different SNR conditions, while also showing strong few-shot performance and promising zero-shot transferability.

item.title: Robust Fusion of Object-Level V2X for Learned 3D Object Detection
item.author: Lukas Ostendorf, Lennart Reiher, Onn Haran, Lutz Eckstein
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究如何将 V2X 信息集成到 3D 目标检测中，并评估系统对现实世界 V2X 缺陷的鲁棒性。

背景: 自动驾驶感知主要依赖车载传感器，受限于视距和视场角，在遮挡或能见度差时可能失效。V2X 协作感知提供了补充信息。

目的: 研究如何将 V2X 信息集成到 3D 目标检测中，并评估系统对现实世界 V2X 缺陷的鲁棒性。

方法: 使用 nuScenes 数据集模拟 V2X 消息，注入噪声和对象丢失以模拟延迟、定位误差和低 V2X 渗透率。将消息转换为 BEV 输入并融合到 BEVFusion 风格的检测器中。提出噪声感知训练策略和显式置信度编码。

主要发现: V2X 信息在理想条件下能显著提高检测性能，但基于理想数据训练的模型变得脆弱且过度依赖 V2X。

结论: 提出的噪声感知训练策略和显式置信度编码增强了鲁棒性，即使在严重噪声和低 V2X 渗透率下也能保持性能增益。

翻译: 自动驾驶感知主要依赖车载传感器，如摄像头和雷达，这些传感器成本低但受限于视距和视场角。这些固有局限性可能导致车载感知在遮挡或能见度差的情况下失效。与此同时，通过车辆与万物通信的协作感知变得越来越普遍，使车辆和基础设施能够共享其自身状态作为补充车载感知的对象级信息。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何将这种 V2X 信息集成到 3D 目标检测中，以及由此产生的系统对现实世界 V2X 缺陷的鲁棒性如何。使用 nuScenes 数据集，我们从真实数据模拟对象级协作感知消息，注入受控的噪声和对象丢失，以模拟延迟、定位误差和低 V2X 渗透率等现实世界条件。我们将这些消息转换为专用的鸟瞰图输入，并将其融合到 BEVFusion 风格的检测器中。我们的结果表明，虽然对象级协作信息可以在有利条件下显著提高检测性能，达到 0.80 的 NDS，但在理想数据上训练的模型变得脆弱且过度依赖 V2X。相反，我们提出的噪声感知训练策略，结合显式置信度编码，增强了鲁棒性，即使在严重噪声和减少的 V2X 渗透率下也能保持性能增益。

深度解读
